title: Senior Analyst Technical Customer Facing Effectiveness
description:
**Job title: Senior Analyst \- Technical Customer Facing Effectiveness**

* Hiring Manager: Group Lead
* Location: Hyderabad

  

About the job

 **Strategic context:**

  

Sanofi has currently the best and most robust pipeline of R\&D and consequent new launches of our history. As new phase of Play\-To\-Win strategy, funding this pipeline and new launches is key to materialize the miracles of the science to improve people lives. Thus, as we enter the next phase, modernization of Sanofi is required as per the recent announcements on DRIVE, and in this respect, we are in the beginning stages of organizing the Go\-to\-Market Capabilities (GTMC) team at global level.

  



The GTMC organization will help us to drive best\-in\-class capabilities across the board and bring value and excellence in our commercial operations. This move is a key part of the aimed modernization of Sanofi and will allow us to focus on our priorities across our products, market and pipeline through the reallocation of resources and realizing the efficiencies of removing silos that exist between our business units, avoiding the duplication and overlapping of resources, standardizing our processes and tools, operating with a One Sanofi approach to accelerate our key capabilities development, and fostering the entrepreneurial spirit by speeding up the decision making.


As a **Senior Analyst – Customer Facing Effectiveness** within our Global Go\-to\-Market Capabilities (GTMC) team, you will support multiple products within the ZAIDYN portfolio. You will be responsible for enhancing, maintaining, and supporting existing solutions to enable ongoing business operations and recurring market requirements.


In this role, you will work closely with business stakeholders, operations teams, and backend engineers to deliver product enhancements, resolve production issues, support system integrations, and identify opportunities for automation and continuous improvement.

**Product Enhancement \& Operation Ownership**

* Support day\-to\-day product operations by troubleshooting product\-related issues, resolving defects, and responding to operational queries.
* Implement and validate cycle\-over\-cycle product enhancements and configuration changes.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications for the engineering team.
* Support backlog refinement by documenting enhancement requests, defects, and business priorities.
* Maintain product configurations, business rules, and technical documentation.
* Track issues through Jira and ensure timely resolution in collaboration with engineering and business teams.
* Participate in testing activities, including functional, regression, and UAT support for product releases.

 **Integration \& Technical Delivery**

* Support integrations between ZAIDYN products and upstream systems such as Workday, Salesforce alignment tools, and HR data sources.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies, integration failures, and production issues.
* Perform data validation and root cause analysis to ensure data accuracy and system reliability.
* Collaborate with backend teams during product upgrades and production deployments.

**Process Improvement \& Operational Excellence**

* Identify opportunities to improve product functionality, automate manual activities, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Contribute to process documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support the adoption of standard operating procedures and best practices across the team.

  

About you

  



* **3–4 years of experience** supporting enterprise applications, preferably within the ZAIDYN product suite (ZICO, ZDL, ZFIR, Awards, etc.).
* Strong understanding of incentive compensation, sales operations, or commercial processes, ideally within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
* Hands\-on experience with SQL, including writing complex queries and stored procedures, along with experience configuring ZICO custom plans and ZFIR reports.
* Good understanding of system integrations, data feeds, APIs, and enterprise application support. (Python, VBA, BI \- good to have)
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with experience working collaboratively across technical and business teams using Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira.

  

Why choose us?

  



* Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future\-focused team.
* Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
* Enjoy a thoughtful, well\-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
* Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high\-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender\-neutral parental leave.
* Play an instrumental part in creating best practice within our Go\-to\-Market Capabilities.

  

Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary

  

Progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. You can be one of those people. Chasing change, embracing new ideas and exploring all the opportunities we have to offer. Let’s pursue progress. And let’s discover extraordinary together.


At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.


Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com!

title: Site HR Operation - Partner
description:
### **Responsibilities**


* Onboarding:



o Support recruitment processes tailored to the site's requirements



o Enabling the Day\-1 onboarding based on document verification in coordination with security



o Coordinate with Admin for Joining Kit distribution based on pre\-shared joining lists



o Ensure IT asset allocation on day of joining by coordinating with the IT team



o Manage the onboarding process to ensure a seamless transition for new hires.



o Administrative support for managing the induction process as designed



o Welcome session with the new joiner and meet \& greet with the Manager \& team


* Contractor Labor Management System:



o Unique contractor ID creation \& update in the CLMS (Kronos) for all contractors



o Enable time and attendance tracking for all workmen at the sites



o Manage the off\-roll workforce management with focus on Legatrix platform and oversee the licenses and RC of labor laws



o On ground coordination with the BU, contractor, security \& other departments in case of offboarding


* Performance and Development:



o Administer performance management systems and work with leaders to ensure regular feedback and development planning.



o Identify training needs and coordinate relevant learning and development initiatives to upskill employees.



o Support GCC Towers in execution of the annual review cycles in order to achieve timely competition


* Compliance and Policy Implementation:



o Ensure adherence to all applicable labor laws and internal policies.



o Review and update HR policies to reflect the dynamic needs of the capability center.



o Managing Labor law related notices, filing of Monthly/ Quarterly/ Half yearly/ Annual returns (Non\-Payroll) (including Apprentice Act)



o Statutory documentation and recordkeeping team is responsible for the document management of all the sites


* Health, Safety, and Wellbeing:



o Coordinates the communication between the Site HR/Cluster HR Head and GCC LEA team whenever needed on employee health \& safety issues



o Support in incident management with coordination between employee/workmen, regional site manager, reporting manager and BU HR



o Logging \& escalating the required incidents to Group IR team over a call/e\-mail in case of critical incidents


* Stakeholder management:



o Cultivate long standing relationships with local departments, regional labor office and other external stakeholders to maintain seamless operations.



o Develop and implement effective communication strategies to engage stakeholders and keep them informed about site activities, changes, and developments.


* Employee Engagement and Culture:



o Organize events, workshops, and activities to foster a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture.



o Support the employee engagement events by coordination with established vendors, procurement and administration teams



o Calendarization of events and designing, communicating and coordinating for all engagement events at the sites


### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree or MBA in HR is advantageous.


* 3\-10 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a management role within a manufacturing unit, plant or similar environment.

title: Supervisor - Operations (ILHBS)
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:**


* Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts
* Operate X\-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check\-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.
* Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X\-ray screening.
* Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.


**Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:**


* Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.
* Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.
* Equipment Maintenance and Pre\-Operational Checks:
* Conduct routine pre\-operational checks of X\-BIS, ETD, CT\-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.
* Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.


**Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:**


* Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.
* Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.


**Time Management and Efficiency:**


* Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.
* Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.


**Workplace Conduct and Decorum:**


* Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.
* Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal:**


* CSO
* Lead Avsec Audit \& Compliance
* Pass Section
* Lead \- ILHBS/ Duty Manager \- ILHBS/ Sr Screener
* Terminal Operations
* IT
* HR Department
* Compliance and Regulatory Teams
* Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)


**Key Stakeholders \- External:**


* Transportation Security Administration (TSA)
* Aircraft Operator
* Airport Authorities
* Passengers
* ASG
* BCAS
* Local Police
* Service Providers
* Law Enforcement Agencies
* Regulatory Bodies
* Industry Associations

### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualifications:**


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Bachelor’s or equivalent degree
* Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center
* NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred


**Work Experience:**


* Freshers or 1\-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.
* Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.


**Physical Qualification:**


* Visual accuracy \- Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /
* lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses
* or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.
* Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for
* frequencies below 2000 Hz.
* Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.
* Movement\-of\-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any
* pronounced speed impediment.
* Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor
* Deportment \& Appearance \- Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,
* deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

title: Duty Manager - Landside Security
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Security Operations Management:**



Oversee day\-to\-day landside security operations during shifts for landside, city side, airport village site, including patrolling, access control, and surveillance activities, to ensure adherence to established policies and procedures.



Act as the primary point of contact for on\-site security teams, providing guidance and addressing any issues that arise promptly to maintain secure and seamless operations.



Conduct regular inspections of landside areas to identify potential risks or deviations from established standards.



Ensure operational readiness of all security equipment, including CCTV systems, access control devices, and communication tools. Coordinate with the Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) for seamless monitoring and response.


**Incident Reporting and Response:**



Coordinate initial response efforts during security incidents, gathering relevant information and ensuring immediate actions are taken to address the situation effectively.



Prepare detailed incident reports for the Lead \- Landside Security, capturing all relevant information and contributing to follow\-up investigations and preventive measures.


**Supervision of Access Control and Traffic Management:**



Oversee access control, Crowd control, Traffic management, loss prevention and asset protections measures for landside areas, including vehicle and personnel access, ensuring compliance with security protocols and addressing any exceptions or irregularities.



Manage traffic flow within landside zones, implementing measures to prevent congestion and maintain a secure environment for all employees, visitors, and vendors.



Ensure round the clock protection to both the tangible and intangible assets.


**Risk Assessment and Mitigation:**



Conduct routine risk assessments of landside operations and recommend mitigation measures.



Monitor local, national, and international developments that may impact landside security operations.



Report potential risks to the Lead \- Landside Security and suggest proactive measures to address them.


**Team Coordination and Scheduling:**



Plan and manage shift schedules for landside security staff, coordinating coverage to ensure all critical areas are monitored and secured at all times.



Facilitate communication within the team, holding regular briefings to discuss daily objectives, key concerns, and any updates to security protocols that need to be followed.



Provide on\-the\-job training and guidance to security staff to improve performance and compliance.



Monitor the performance of outsourced security staff and escalate issues to the vendor management team if needed.


**Compliance and Audit Support:**



Conduct routine audits of landside security operations to identify areas for improvement and ensure full compliance with established standards.



Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and ensuring compliance with findings.



Update staff on new regulations, SOP changes, and directives issued by regulatory agencies.


**Stakeholder Liaison:**



Act as the primary point of contact for landside security issues during the shift.



Collaborate with airport operations, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges.



Address complaints or concerns from passengers, visitors, and employees regarding security matters.


**Reporting and Documentation:**



Review and submit shift reports detailing incidents, operational highlights, and staff performance.



Maintain accurate records of access control activities, visitor management, and incident investigations.



Ensure all documentation is updated and stored securely for audit and compliance purposes.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal:**



Lead \- Landside Security



Operations Team



Facilities Management



Security Control Room Team



Airlines



HR and Training Team


**Key Stakeholders \- External:**



Local Law Enforcement Agencies



Regulatory Bodies (e.g., BCAS)



Third\-Party Security Service Providers



Contractors and Vendors



Community Representatives



Customs



Emergency Response Services (EMS, Fire Services)


### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualifications:**



Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Public Safety, or a related discipline.



AVSEC certification or equivalent airport security certification.



Training in Crisis Management or Incident Response is preferred.


**Work Experience:**



5\-10 (Depending on the site complexity/ requirement) years of experience in a security operations role, with at least 2 years in a supervisory capacity.



Experience in managing daily security operations, handling incidents, and ensuring compliance with security policies and protocols.

description:
### **Responsibilities**


**IDAM Specialist**


**Identity Lifecycle Management:**



Support the administration of identity lifecycle processes, including user provisioning, de\-provisioning, and access reviews.

Assist in maintaining an accurate inventory of user identities and associated access rights across the enterprise.


**Authentication and Authorization Management:**



Implement and manage authentication mechanisms such as Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign\-On (SSO), and other access controls.

Ensure that proper access control mechanisms are in place to provide secure, role\-appropriate access to critical systems and data.


**IAM Tool Support and Maintenance:**



Assist in the configuration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including tools like Okta, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, SailPoint, or similar.



Provide technical support for IAM tools and applications, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating with vendors for escalated issues.



Perform regular system health checks, ensuring IAM tools and systems are performing optimally.


**Access Reviews and Compliance:**



Conduct regular access reviews to ensure compliance with the principle of least privilege and internal security policies.



Assist in ensuring that identity and access management practices are in compliance with relevant regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX).



Prepare reports on user access and permissions for internal audits and compliance requirements.


**Incident Response and Support:**



Assist in investigating and remediating incidents related to identity and access management, such as unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and account compromise.



Support the resolution of identity\-related security incidents, escalating as needed to senior security staff or incident response teams.



Monitor logs and user activity for anomalous behavior, ensuring that any incidents are reported and addressed promptly.


**Policy and Process Support:**



Assist in the development, implementation, and enforcement of identity management policies, including user access management, authentication protocols, and access control rules.



Collaborate with other teams to implement best practices for managing identity across the organization’s IT infrastructure and cloud platforms.


**Collaboration and Stakeholder Communication:**



Work closely with IT, HR, compliance, and application teams to understand their requirements and ensure appropriate identity and access controls are in place.



Provide support and guidance to internal teams regarding identity management processes and policies.



Assist with user training and awareness programs on the importance of strong identity management and secure access controls.


**Continuous Improvement:**



Contribute to the ongoing improvement of identity and access management processes and tools to enhance efficiency, security, and user experience.



Stay up\-to\-date on industry trends and emerging technologies in the identity and access management space.



Participate in regular training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge.


**Key Stakeholders \- Internal**



Head of Identity and Access Management (IDAM)



Business Unit Heads and Department Heads



Information Security and IT teams



IT and Network Operations Teams



Legal and Compliance Teams



Audit Teams



Human Resources (HR)


**Key Stakeholders \- External**



Vendors and service providers of IAM solutions



Regulatory bodies


### **Qualifications**


**Educational Qualification:**



Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.


**Certification:**



Relevant certifications such as Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM)/ CompTIA Security\+, or similar are a plus.



Experience with IAM tools and technologies such as RSA, One Identity, Net IQ, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, Microsoft Azure AD, SailPoint, or similar platforms with industry standards and regulations related to IAM, such as ISO 27001, NIST etc.



Strong knowledge of IAM technologies and best practices, including SSO, privileged access management (PAM), and user provisioning

5\+ years of relevent experience working in Identity and Access Management (IDAM) roles.

description:
### **Responsibilities**


**Mines Manager or Site Head \- Coal Mining**


**Mine Operations \& Production Management:**



Oversee daily mining operations, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining safety, environmental, and regulatory compliance.



Supervise drilling, blasting, excavation, and transportation activities to optimize efficiency and minimize downtime.



Implement cost\-effective measures to enhance operational performance and stay within allocated budgets.



Monitor and evaluate mining equipment performance, ensuring timely maintenance and repairs to prevent delays.



Develop and enforce Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to streamline mining processes.


**Pre\-Construction Planning \& Regulatory Compliance:**



Lead pre\-construction activities, ensuring all statutory clearances, including environmental and forest approvals, are obtained.



Liaise with regulatory bodies such as DGMS, Pollution Control Board, and State Mining Offices to secure necessary permits.



Manage land acquisition challenges and ensure smooth transition processes for mining operations.



Develop and implement a comprehensive Safety Management Plan in compliance with DGMS norms, MMDR Act, and environmental laws.



Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and training programs to ensure a zero\-accident workplace.


**Resource Allocation \& Cost Management:**



Strategically deploy personnel and equipment to maximize efficiency and achieve production goals.



Coordinate preventive maintenance schedules to reduce equipment downtime.



Ensure proper inventory management for spare parts and consumables to avoid disruptions in operations.



Monitor project expenditures, identify cost\-saving opportunities, and ensure financial alignment with budgetary constraints.


**Innovation \& Digital Transformation:**



Drive the adoption of digital tools such as pit\-to\-plant digitization to enhance transparency and decision\-making.



Implement advanced mechanization practices and data analytics to improve operational efficiency.



Collaborate with IT and engineering teams to integrate innovative technologies into mining operations.



Regularly evaluate digital platforms to optimize performance and align with business objectives.


**Stakeholder \& Team Management:**



Liaise with internal teams, including engineering, logistics, finance, and HR, to align operational goals with business strategies.



Manage relationships with external stakeholders such as contractors, regulatory authorities, and community representatives.



Ensure clear communication and periodic updates on project progress and operational challenges.



Resolve disputes and monitor contractor performance to maintain adherence to project timelines.


**Safety \& Environmental Governance:**



Promote a strong safety culture by enforcing adherence to safety protocols and industry best practices.



Lead incident investigations and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.



Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, including waste management, air quality monitoring, and sustainability initiatives.



Stay updated on the latest regulatory developments affecting mining operations.

description:
**About the Role:** 




  





 We are looking for an
 **experienced HR Operations Manager** 
 to own
 **end\-to\-end HR operations** 
 for our
 **Employer of Record (EOR) business** 
 — full employee lifecycle across multiple client companies. Statutory compliance execution sits with an
 **external compliance partner** 
 ; the candidate needs
 **strong working knowledge of the process to manage that relationship and hold the partner accountable, not to file directly** 
 . Leads a small HR ops team (
 **maker/checker model** 
 ) and is the
 **primary point of contact for client\-side HR and compliance matters** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**\-HR Operations** 




  




* Own the
 **employee lifecycle for EOR employees across clients** 
 — onboarding, documentation, HRMS data, attendance/leave, nominee \& insurance records, offboarding.
* Manage
 **HRMS (greytHR or equivalent)** 
 : employee master data, attendance automation, insurance integration.
* Run a
 **maker/checker structure** 
 across onboarding, payroll, compliance, and offboarding.
* Track core ops metrics (
 **FAT, onboarding/offboarding TAT** 
 ) and report to leadership.
* Manage and mentor the
 **HR ops team** 
 ; own their
 **KRAs/KPIs** 
 .
* Issue
 **board/employer authorisation letters, offer letters, and related employment documentation** 
 for client companies.



  





**\-Statutory Compliance ( via Compliance Partner)** 




  




* Working knowledge of
 **PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Gratuity, Bonus, and other labour law compliance** 
 — enough to review and question the partner's work.
* Own the relationship with the
 **external compliance partner** 
 : inputs, deliverables, and follow\-up on filings, registrations, renewals, closures.
* Maintain
 **compliance calendars** 
 and hold the partner to
 **statutory deadlines** 
 across clients/locations.
* Coordinate between the partner and
 **government departments, labour authorities, and auditors** 
 as needed.
* Review the partner's
 **records, registers, and statutory reports** 
 for accuracy.
* Coordinate documentation for
 **internal/external/statutory audits** 
 .
* Track compliance status via the partner's
 **MIS/dashboards** 
 and flag risks to management.
* Sanity\-check the partner's coverage of
 **Central and State\-specific labour legislation** 
 across client locations.
* Stay current enough on
 **labour law changes** 
 to hold the partner accountable for implementation.
* Join periodic
 **compliance reviews and risk assessments** 
 ; drive corrective action internally.



  





**\-Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




  




* **Single point of contact for client companies** 
 on HR ops and compliance under the EOR arrangement.
* Coordinate with
 **payroll, HR, and client ops teams** 
 for accurate processing and reporting.
* Handle client queries on
 **labour law and compliance matters** 
 .



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in
 **Commerce, Law, HR, Business Administration, or related field** 
 (Master's/MBA in HR a plus).
* **7–10 years in HR operations and statutory compliance** 
 , incl.
 **2–3 years managing a team** 
 .
* Prior experience in an
 **EOR, staffing, payroll outsourcing, or HR/compliance consulting firm** 
 strongly preferred.
* Good working knowledge of
 **PF, ESI, PT, LWF, Shops \& Establishment Act, CLRA, Factories Act, Minimum Wages Act, Bonus Act** 
 — enough to manage and audit a compliance partner, not necessarily to file directly.
* Experience working with
 **third\-party compliance vendors** 
 .
* Hands\-on with
 **HRMS platforms (greytHR or equivalent)** 
 .
* Experience managing
 **multi\-client, multi\-state operations simultaneously** 
 .
* Demonstrated team management, including
 **maker/checker or QC workflows** 
 .
* Proficient in
 **MS Excel and dashboarding/KPI tracking** 
 .
* Strong stakeholder communication — comfortable representing the business with
 **client HR/compliance counterparts** 
 .

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Associate - Founder's Office
description:
**THE ROLE IN ONE LINE** 




 You get dropped into a team that has a number which is not moving. You use AI to move it. Six weeks. Then you rotate to the next one.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Embed with one function for six weeks: sales operations, marketing measurement, cost and efficiency, or delivery. One named sponsor, one signed outcome.
* Spend week one watching the real work. Sit on demo calls. Sit beside an Account Director for a full call block. Pull the data yourself. You will not diagnose a business from a dashboard.
* Build the thing that fixes it. An agent, a workflow, a scoring model, an automation that removes fifteen hours a week. You build it, not a vendor and not the engineering team.
* Get it adopted. Sit next to the people using it until they use it without you in the room.
* Hand it over with a named owner and a runbook, then write a one\-page memo carrying a rupee number that your sponsor and Finance both sign.
* Rotate. Roughly six of these a year.



  





**WHAT YOU WILL HAVE DONE BY YEAR ONE** 



* Day 30: one automation live that removes 10 or more hours a week of manual work.
* Day 90: two functions worked, ₹40 lakh of annualised, counter\-signed impact.
* Month 12: six projects shipped, verified impact of at least six times your cost, and function heads asking for you by name.



  





**WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 



* An engineering degree from a Tier 1 institute, 0 to 2 years out.
* Ex\-product, ex\-consulting, or someone who has run an AI\-led initiative end to end. Any of the three works.
* Something you have shipped with AI that another person used repeatedly. Not drafts and summaries. A workflow, an agent, a scoring model, an internal tool. Send the link; we will ask you to walk us through the decisions you made building it.
* SQL and spreadsheets at working fluency. You get your own data. You do not raise a ticket to answer a question.
* Clear, short writing. The one\-page memo is the actual product of this job.
* Comfort with being the most junior person in the room, telling a function head that their process is the problem, and being welcome there afterwards.



  





**DO NOT APPLY IF** 



* Your AI experience is prompting a chatbot for drafts and summaries.
* You need a fully specified brief before you can start.
* You want to work on strategy without pulling data or shipping anything.
* You cannot name a specific number you moved and explain how it was measured.



  





***HOW TO APPLY***




 Send a link to something you have built, along with your CV. Applications without a link will not be reviewed.

title: Data Engineer
description:

**About Us**
 Data is the lifeblood of our platform. We are scaling a high\-velocity technology company where every product decision, recommendation, and growth loop relies on clean, real\-time data pipelines. Our engineering culture values data integrity, high\-throughput architecture, and clean modeling. If you love taming messy datasets and building reliable pipelines that power business intelligence and AI workflows, you will thrive here.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 We are seeking a sharp and proactive
 **Data Engineer** 
 to design, build, and optimize our data infrastructure. You will architect scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, manage our data warehouse, and ensure that our analytics, product, and AI/ML teams have seamless access to high\-quality, structured data. You won't just move data; you will build the foundational architecture that drives our next stage of growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* ETL/ELT Pipeline Development: Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Python and SQL.
* Data Warehouse Management: Architect and optimize our cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift) for performance and cost efficiency.
* Data Modeling \& Quality: Design clean dimensional data models, implement automated data quality checks, and ensure schema evolution without breaking downstream consumers.
* AI \& Analytics Collaboration: Provision clean, feature\-rich datasets to support data scientists, ML engineers building RAG/LLM pipelines, and business analysts.
* Performance \& Monitoring: Monitor pipeline execution, troubleshoot data drift, and optimize query performance across large datasets.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 2\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, building production data pipelines in modern cloud environments.
* Coding Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Python and advanced SQL (window functions, query tuning, indexing).
* Data Stack Mastery: Hands\-on experience with modern data orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster) and cloud data warehouses.
* Big Data \& Streaming: Familiarity with distributed data processing or streaming frameworks (Kafka, Spark, or DBT).
* Database \& Cloud Knowledge: Solid grasp of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).


 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive Compensation: Attractive base salary paired with performance bonuses and equity options.
* Modern Stack: Full ownership to design and scale next\-generation data architecture from the ground up.
* Learning \& Growth: Dedicated annual stipend for data engineering certifications and technical conferences.
* Flexibility \& Wellness: Remote\-friendly work environment and comprehensive health coverage.


 Our Hiring Process
   

  

* Initial Screening: 30\-minute introductory chat with our recruitment team.
* Technical Assessment: Practical SQL and Python data pipeline coding challenge.
* Architecture Deep Dive: Discussion on data modeling, pipeline failures, and scaling strategies with our lead engineers.
* Final Chat \& Offer: Closing alignment and welcome aboard!

description:
**👩 💻 The role** 




 We're looking for a sharp, hungry analyst to join the data team at Headout. This is a foundational role, you'll work closely with senior analysts and leadership to build the reports, dashboards, and automations that power decisions across the company.
 



  





 Depending on where the need is greatest and where your strengths lie, you could find yourself working on growth and marketing analytics, product analytics, operations and supply\-side problems, or a mix of all three. The common thread: you'll be embedded in the business, working on problems that matter.
 



  





 This isn't about crunching numbers in a corner. You'll understand how our marketplace works, why metrics move, and what levers actually drive outcomes. You'll ship real work within your first week, and own meaningful workstreams within your first few months.
 



  





 If you're someone who gets restless when you're not learning, who'd rather figure things out than wait for instructions, and who cares about craft, this is for you.
 



  





**🤩 What makes this role special?** 



* **Real problems, not busywork** 
 : Headout is a global marketplace operating across dozens of cities, thousands of experiences, multiple currencies, real\-time inventory, and dynamic pricing. Whether you're analyzing conversion funnels, attribution models, supplier economics, or product experiments, the problems here are genuinely hard.
* **Breadth of exposure** 
 : You won't be siloed into one corner of the business. You'll see how growth, product, operations, and finance interconnect and build the analytical muscle to work across all of them.
* **Learn fast by doing** 
 : You'll pair with senior analysts on complex projects, get direct feedback from leadership, and see your work influence actual decisions. The feedback loops are tight, and the growth curve is steep.
* **A team that gives a damn** 
 : We care about speed and pragmatism over perfection, but we don't ship sloppy work. Feedback is direct and frequent. We document what we learn. We help each other get better.
* **A product you can care about** 
 : Headout helps people experience the best of every city they visit. There's something satisfying about working on a product where the output is someone having a great day somewhere new.



  





**💝 What skills \& experience do you need?** 



* 1 \- 3 years in an analytics, BI, or data science role
* Strong SQL skills, you can write complex joins, window functions, CTEs without hand\-holding. You know how to debug a slow query.

description:
Cybersecurity Researcher — AI\-Powered VAPT
 
**SecNinjaz Technologies LLP** 




**Experience:** 
 1–2 years; maximum 2 years
 



**Certification:** 
 OSCP mandatory
 



**Department:** 
 Internal Research \& Product Development
 



**Compensation:** 
 Based on skills and experience, within a fixed approved budget
 


 About SecNinjaz Technologies
 
 SecNinjaz Technologies LLP is a New Delhi\-headquartered cybersecurity and technology company working across cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, IT engineering, and product engineering. The company develops security and technology solutions for enterprises, governments, and environments where security and operational control are essential. Its capabilities include offensive security, AI/LLM security testing, AI red teaming, and AI workflow automation. About SecNinjaz
 



 Its product portfolio includes
 **Kaalix AI** 
 , an AI\-powered VAPT platform designed to bring together attack planning, adaptive testing, controlled exploitation, security\-tool integration, and reporting. This opening supports our internal work in AI\-powered offensive security research and product development. Explore Kaalix AI
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for an
 **OSCP\-certified cybersecurity professional** 
 who enjoys penetration testing, investigating vulnerabilities, and exploring how AI can support security research.
 



 You will help develop and evaluate AI\-powered VAPT capabilities by testing internal systems, building lab scenarios, validating exploitation techniques, and collaborating with AI and engineering teams.
 



**This is an internal research and product development role. Responsibilities are limited to our products, internal systems, and approved testing environments. The position does not involve client\-facing VAPT delivery or consulting assignments.** 



 Key Responsibilities
 * Perform hands\-on penetration testing and black\-box assessments across internal applications, APIs, networks, and lab machines.
* Research vulnerabilities, exploitation techniques, privilege escalation, and attack chains.
* Explore how AI can interpret reconnaissance results, identify potential weaknesses, select testing steps, and adapt to results.
* Build controlled lab scenarios and reproducible proof\-of\-concept tests for evaluating AI\-assisted exploitation.
* Validate AI\-generated findings and attack paths, identifying false positives, missed vulnerabilities, and unsupported conclusions.
* Collaborate with developers to turn manual penetration testing methods into repeatable product workflows.
* Develop scripts and integrate security tools to support testing and research.
* Document experiments, evidence, limitations, and recommendations for product improvement.


 Mandatory Requirements
 * **OSCP certification is a minimum requirement. Candidates without OSCP will not be considered.**
* **1–2 years of relevant hands\-on cybersecurity experience, with a maximum of 2 years.**
* Practical knowledge of vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, exploitation, and privilege escalation.
* Understanding of Linux, Windows, networking, HTTP, web applications, and APIs.
* Familiarity with tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, and common command\-line security utilities.
* Basic scripting ability in Python, Bash, or PowerShell.
* Strong interest in
 **AI\-powered cybersecurity, security research, VAPT automation, and AI\-assisted red teaming** 
 .
* Ability to investigate independently, reproduce findings, and explain technical results clearly.
* Discipline to conduct all testing within authorized scope.



**Prior professional AI or machine\-learning experience is not required. Strong security fundamentals and a willingness to learn are essential.** 



 Good to Have
 * Active participation in Hack The Box, TryHackMe, CTFs, or personal security labs.
* Research write\-ups, responsible disclosures, security scripts, or relevant GitHub projects.
* Exposure to LLMs, AI agents, tool calling, APIs, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with Git and basic software development practices.
* Interest in testing the security and reliability of AI systems themselves.


 What You Will Learn at SecNinjaz
 
 Through hands\-on contributions to internal research and product development, you will gain experience in:
 


* **AI\-assisted penetration testing:** 
 Understanding how AI agents use tools, interpret results, and decide what to test next.
* **Exploitation research:** 
 Investigating why exploits succeed or fail and reproducing attack chains in controlled environments.
* **AI evaluation:** 
 Comparing AI\-driven testing with manual results and measuring accuracy, coverage, and reproducibility.
* **Security automation:** 
 Connecting scripts, APIs, and testing tools into repeatable workflows.
* **Product engineering:** 
 Translating research findings into features, test cases, and improvements to a security product.
* **Technical research communication:** 
 Producing clear documentation that helps engineers understand and act on security findings.


 Who Should Apply?
 
 This role is suited to someone who enjoys solving challenging lab machines, understanding how vulnerabilities work, and experimenting beyond standard testing checklists. You should be curious about how AI can reason through security problems and motivated to help build and improve an AI\-powered cybersecurity product.
 


 Application Requirements
 
 Please share:
 


* Your updated CV and OSCP certification details.
* Relevant research, lab write\-ups, scripts, or GitHub links, if available.
* A brief note explaining your interest in AI\-powered cybersecurity research.
* Your expected compensation and notice period or availability.

title: Network Operations – Multiple Openings
description:
Hiring – Network Operations Team (9 Openings) \| Network Engineer to Network Ops Manager \| L2–L5 \| Immediate Onboarding
 



  





 We are expanding our Network Operations function and are hiring across
 **9 positions spanning 5 role levels** 
 , from Network Engineer to Network Operations Manager/Lead. This is an opportunity to join a growing technical team working on enterprise routing/switching, network security (NGFW, ZTNA, IPS/IDS), SD\-WAN, cloud networking (Azure/AWS), automation (Python/Ansible/API), and network tooling/observability platforms. All roles report into the Network Operations function
 



**Open Roles:** 




  





**L5\-Network Operations Manager / Lead – Network \& Network Security Operations\- 1 Opening** 




**L4\- Network Lead Engineer – Network and Security Operations\- 2 Opening** 




**L3–L4 \- Senior Network Engineer – Network and Security Operations\- 2 Opening** 




**L2 \- Network Engineer – Network and Security Operations\- 3 Opening** 




**L2\- Network Tooling and Performance Specialist\- 1 Opening** 




  





**Role Summary:** 
 We are looking for Network Operations professionals across multiple experience levels to manage, secure, and optimize our enterprise network infrastructure. Responsibilities scale by level — from hands\-on engineering and troubleshooting (L2\) to team leadership, vendor/stakeholder management, and strategic network security ownership (L5\).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities (scales with seniority):** 



* Manage day\-to\-day network operations: routing, switching, WLAN, SD\-WAN, and network security (NGFW, IPS/IDS, VPN, ZTNA, segmentation)
* Support/lead cloud networking initiatives (Azure/AWS)
* Drive automation using Python, Ansible, and API\-driven operations
* Monitor network performance using observability/dashboard tools; report on service assurance and compliance
* Manage vendor ecosystems, technical escalations, and stakeholder communication
* For senior levels: lead distributed/international technical teams, own supplier and contract negotiations, and drive service management (ITIL) practices



  





**Required Skills \& Experience (varies by level – see table below):** 



* 3 to 7\+ years of network operations/engineering experience depending on level
* Strong routing \& switching fundamentals; at least one major firewall ecosystem
* SD\-WAN and cloud networking exposure
* Monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting skills across network/security/connectivity layers



  





**Preferred Certifications/Skills (varies by level):** 




  




* CCNA / CCNP / CCIE (Routing \& Switching)
* CCSP, PCNSE, NSE (security certifications)
* Azure/AWS networking or security certifications
* ITIL Foundation
* Tooling exposure: SolarWinds, Splunk, Panorama, FortiManager, Meraki, Cisco ISE, Ekahau, ServiceNow, Power BI

title: Marketing Intern – Startup
description:
FXN (Fashion eXchange Network) is an **early\-stage, pre\-MVP fashion technology startup** building a hyperlocal fashion rental platform to make fashion more accessible, affordable, and sustainable.

We are looking for a **Marketing Intern (Content \& Growth)** who is creative, proactive, and willing to take ownership. Since we are currently in the **pre\-MVP stage**, you will have the opportunity to work on marketing from the ground up and contribute to how FXN builds its brand, reaches its target customers, and prepares for launch.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist in planning and executing social media and digital marketing activities.
* Create ideas and content for Instagram, including reels, posts, stories, and campaigns.
* Research fashion trends, competitors, target customers, and relevant market opportunities.
* Assist in developing marketing strategies for brand awareness and customer acquisition.
* Identify potential influencers, creators, communities, and collaboration opportunities.
* Support influencer and creator outreach when required.
* Write captions, promotional content, and other marketing communications.
* Assist with building FXN's social media presence and brand identity from the pre\-MVP stage.
* Track basic marketing performance and identify what is working and what is not.
* Test new marketing ideas and document results.
* Work closely with the founder and team on ongoing marketing and growth initiatives.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and complete them within deadlines.

**Requirements**

* Good communication and writing skills.
* Strong interest in marketing, branding, social media, fashion, or startups.
* Creative thinking and ability to generate practical marketing ideas.
* Basic knowledge of Instagram and social media platforms.
* Basic knowledge of Canva or similar tools is preferred.
* Ability to research independently and present information clearly.
* Willingness to learn, experiment, and take ownership.
* Students and freshers are welcome to apply.

**What You'll Gain**

* Hands\-on experience working with a **pre\-MVP startup from the ground up**.
* Direct exposure to marketing, branding, customer acquisition, and growth.
* Opportunity to work directly with the founder.
* Practical experience in social media, content creation, market research, and campaign planning.
* Opportunity to contribute to building the marketing foundation of a new startup.
* Exposure to real startup decision\-making and experimentation.
* High\-performing interns may be considered for an extension or future opportunities with FXN.

**Internship Details**

* **Duration:** 1\.5 Months
* **Stipend:** ₹4,000 per month
* **Work Mode:** Hybrid / Remote
* **Location:** Ernakulam, Kerala
* **Extension:** May be extended based on performance and business requirements.

We are looking for someone who wants to **build, experiment, and learn from the ground up**. This is a pre\-MVP startup, so the role will involve ambiguity, experimentation, and taking initiative rather than simply following predefined processes.

If you're excited about marketing and want to understand what it takes to build a brand **before it launches**, we'd love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹4,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala

title: US IT Recruiter
description:
**Job Summary:**
* We are looking for US IT Recruiters who can source, engage, screen, and coordinate with candidates, consultants, clients, and staffing partners to support recruitment and staffing requirements.
* The role involves candidate sourcing, requirement analysis, screening, interview coordination, consultant marketing, database management, follow\-ups, and maintaining strong professional relationships.
* Freshers with strong communication skills, a willingness to learn, and an interest in recruitment are also encouraged to apply.

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Source candidates through job portals, professional networks, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Understand job requirements and identify suitable candidates.
* Screen candidates based on skills, experience, qualifications, and job requirements.
* Coordinate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Schedule interviews and follow up with candidates and clients.
* Maintain and update candidate databases and recruitment records.
* For Bench Sales roles, market available consultants to suitable client requirements and staffing vendors.
* Coordinate with vendors and clients regarding consultant profiles and requirements.
* Follow up on submissions, interviews, and placements.
* Meet individual and team recruitment targets.
* Maintain professional communication with candidates, clients, and vendors.
* Stay updated on market requirements, recruitment trends, and relevant technologies.

**Required Skills:**
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and convincing abilities.
* Good sourcing and candidate\-screening skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
* Good follow\-up and coordination skills.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office and internet\-based recruitment tools.
* Willingness to learn and grow in the staffing industry.

**Educational Qualifications:**  

**For Semi\-IT / US IT Recruitment:**
* B.Tech / B.E. preferred.
* Candidates with relevant technical knowledge and strong communication skills are encouraged to apply.

**For Non\-IT / Pharma Recruitment:**
* Any Degree preferred.
* MBA candidates, especially those specializing in HR, are preferred.

**Experience:**
* 1 3 years of experience in Semi\-IT recruitment, US IT recruitment, Bench Sales, staffing, or a related field.
* Freshers are eligible and will be considered based on communication skills, learning ability, and interest in recruitment.

**What we Offer:**
* Opportunity to build a career in the Staffing \& Recruitment Industry.
* Exposure to Semi\-IT, US IT, Pharma, and Non\-IT recruitment.
* Learning and development opportunities.
* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance.

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**  

We are looking for candidates who are:
* Passionate about recruitment and staffing.
* Confident communicators.
* Comfortable working in a target\-oriented environment.
* Good at building professional relationships.
* Quick learners with a positive attitude.
* Willing to work from Vijayawada, Guntur, or Narasaraopet.

title: Sr. Sales Officer
description:

We're a growing security \& surveillance solutions company (CCTV, access control, attendance systems, POS) looking for a B2B Sales Executive to build our client base across Mohali and nearby business hubs. You'll manage the full sales cycle — from first contact to closed deal — meeting clients, understanding their needs, and offering the right solution.

**What You'll Do**

* Find and approach new business clients — offices, construction sites, industrial areas, and via LinkedIn/trade contacts
* Meet clients, understand their requirements, and share quotes/estimates
* Handle client questions and negotiate to close deals

* Coordinate with our operations team for order delivery and invoicing

* Familiarity with SAP or ERP systems

* **₹15,000 – ₹25,000/month \+ Performance Incentives**

A subject matter expert (SME) is the definitive source of knowledge, technique, or expertise in a specific subject area, such as Title Search. The SME functions as the organizational ambassador for his knowledge area, and he applies his expertise to support an organization’s vision and strategic direction.

**Competencies**:

* Key players in the title insurance industry and their approaches Guiding teams on the nature of the domain and providing domain insights related to the day to day work of the Post\-Production process
* Guiding teams on the working of the product and optimal usage of them. Resolving problems and identifying opportunities for improvement on usage of these products

* Guiding teams on the end to end scanning process
* Taking decisions on complex scanning documents and historical documents
* Different types of maps provided for the city and/ or county for recording of the property. Rules and regulations of each state to understand the mapping difference

* FAST, Eagle Pro, Eagle Search Product, ArcGis/ICO Maps and Deed Plotter, etc.
* Data Tree, Data Trace, RDRI, Title Scan, etc.

Minimum of 13 years of formal education – Graduate


Professional work experience of 2 to 5 years

title: System Administrator / IT Infrastructure Intern
description:
**Job Description – System Administrator / IT Infrastructure Intern**
=====================================================================

**Job Title:** System Administrator / IT Infrastructure Intern – Intern to Hire**Location:** Brookefield, Bangalore**Work Mode:** Work from Office**Internship Duration:** 6 Months**Stipend:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month**Experience:** Fresher / 0–1 Year**Employment Type:** Internship with Full\-Time Conversion Opportunity**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday – Alternate Saturdays Off**Joining:** Immediate Joiners Preferred**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for a motivated **System Administrator / IT Infrastructure Intern** who is interested in building a career in **System Administration, Networking, Server Management and IT Infrastructure**.
The intern will work with the IT/Infrastructure team and gain practical experience in managing **laptops, desktops, servers, network devices, internet connectivity, user accounts, backups and day\-to\-day IT support**.
Based on performance during the internship, the candidate may be considered for a **full\-time System Administrator / IT Infrastructure position**.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Laptop \& Desktop Support**

* Install, configure and troubleshoot laptops and desktops.
* Install and maintain Windows/Linux operating systems.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, printer and peripheral issues.
* Configure applications, drivers, antivirus and system updates.
* Provide technical support to employees.
* Maintain IT asset and laptop allocation records.

### **Networking**

* Support office LAN, Wi\-Fi and internet connectivity.
* Understand **TCP/IP, IP addressing, DNS and DHCP**.
* Assist with routers, switches and access points.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity using Ping, Traceroute and other basic tools.
* Assist with firewall and VPN\-related issues.
* Coordinate with ISP and network vendors when required.

### **Server Administration**

* Assist with **Windows and Linux server** administration.
* Monitor server CPU, memory, storage and availability.
* Assist with server updates, patching and configuration.
* Manage basic user accounts, permissions and shared folders.
* Assist in troubleshooting server issues and reviewing logs.

### **Backup \& IT Security**

* Assist with regular system and server backups.
* Monitor backup status and report failures.
* Support basic backup and restore activities.
* Assist with antivirus and endpoint security.
* Follow company IT security and access\-control policies.

### **IT Asset Management**

* Maintain inventory of laptops, desktops, monitors, printers and other IT assets.
* Track asset allocation, return and maintenance.
* Maintain software and license records.
* Keep IT infrastructure documentation updated.

### **Technical Support**

* Handle day\-to\-day employee IT support requests.
* Identify and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Escalate complex problems to senior infrastructure team members.
* Document incidents and resolutions.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* Computer Hardware \& Troubleshooting
* Windows OS
* Basic Linux
* Networking Fundamentals
* TCP/IP
* LAN/WAN
* DNS \& DHCP
* Routers \& Switches
* Wi\-Fi
* VPN Basics
* Server Fundamentals
* Backup \& Recovery
* Basic IT Security

**Good to Have**
----------------

* Windows Server
* Active Directory
* Linux command line
* VMware / VirtualBox / Hyper\-V
* AWS / Azure basics
* Firewall configuration
* CCNA / CompTIA A\+ / Network\+ certification
* PowerShell / Bash basics

**Eligibility**
---------------

* B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. Computer Science / IT or related qualification.
* Freshers and recent graduates can apply.
* Candidates with practical knowledge of **networking, hardware and troubleshooting** will be preferred.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to work from the **Brookefield, Bangalore office**.

**Internship \& Conversion**
----------------------------

**Internship Duration:** 6 Months**Monthly Stipend:** ₹15,000 – ₹20,000, based on skills and interview performance**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday, **Alternate Saturdays Off**
During the internship, candidates will receive hands\-on exposure to:**Laptops Networking Servers Windows/Linux Backup Security IT Support Infrastructure Management**
Upon successful completion of the **6\-month internship**, candidates may be considered for **full\-time employment** based on technical performance, learning ability, troubleshooting skills, ownership, discipline and business requirements.

**Job Description – System Administrator / IT Infrastructure Intern**
**Job Title:** 
 System Administrator / IT Infrastructure Intern – Intern to Hire
   

  

**Location:** 
 Brookefield, Bangalore
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Office
   

  

**Internship Duration:** 
 6 Months
   

  

**Stipend:** 
 ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Fresher / 0–1 Year
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Internship with Full\-Time Conversion Opportunity
   

  

**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday – Alternate Saturdays Off
   

  

**Joining:** 
 Immediate Joiners Preferred
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a motivated
 **System Administrator / IT Infrastructure Intern** 
 who is interested in building a career in
 **System Administration, Networking, Server Management and IT Infrastructure** 
 .
   

  

 The intern will work with the IT/Infrastructure team and gain practical experience in managing
 **laptops, desktops, servers, network devices, internet connectivity, user accounts, backups and day\-to\-day IT support** 
 .
   

  

 Based on performance during the internship, the candidate may be considered for a
 **full\-time System Administrator / IT Infrastructure position** 
 .
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Laptop \& Desktop Support
   

  

* Install, configure and troubleshoot laptops and desktops.
* Install and maintain Windows/Linux operating systems.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, printer and peripheral issues.
* Configure applications, drivers, antivirus and system updates.
* Provide technical support to employees.
* Maintain IT asset and laptop allocation records.


 Networking
   

  

* Support office LAN, Wi\-Fi and internet connectivity.
* Understand TCP/IP, IP addressing, DNS and DHCP.
* Assist with routers, switches and access points.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity using Ping, Traceroute and other basic tools.
* Assist with firewall and VPN\-related issues.
* Coordinate with ISP and network vendors when required.


 Server Administration
   

  

* Assist with Windows and Linux server administration.
* Monitor server CPU, memory, storage and availability.
* Assist with server updates, patching and configuration.
* Manage basic user accounts, permissions and shared folders.
* Assist in troubleshooting server issues and reviewing logs.


 Backup \& IT Security
   

  

* Assist with regular system and server backups.
* Monitor backup status and report failures.
* Support basic backup and restore activities.
* Assist with antivirus and endpoint security.
* Follow company IT security and access\-control policies.


 IT Asset Management
   

  

* Maintain inventory of laptops, desktops, monitors, printers and other IT assets.
* Track asset allocation, return and maintenance.
* Maintain software and license records.
* Keep IT infrastructure documentation updated.


 Technical Support
   

  

* Handle day\-to\-day employee IT support requests.
* Identify and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Escalate complex problems to senior infrastructure team members.
* Document incidents and resolutions.


**Required Skills**
* Computer Hardware \& Troubleshooting
* Windows OS
* Basic Linux
* Networking Fundamentals
* TCP/IP
* LAN/WAN
* DNS \& DHCP
* Routers \& Switches
* Wi\-Fi
* VPN Basics
* Server Fundamentals
* Backup \& Recovery
* Basic IT Security


 Good to Have
   

  

* Windows Server
* Active Directory
* Linux command line
* VMware / VirtualBox / Hyper\-V
* AWS / Azure basics
* Firewall configuration
* CCNA / CompTIA A\+ / Network\+ certification
* PowerShell / Bash basics


 Eligibility
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. Computer Science / IT or related qualification.
* Freshers and recent graduates can apply.
* Candidates with practical knowledge of networking, hardware and troubleshooting will be preferred.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to work from the Brookefield, Bangalore office.


 Internship \& Conversion
   

  

**Internship Duration:** 
 6 Months
   

  

**Monthly Stipend:** 
 ₹15,000 – ₹20,000, based on skills and interview performance
   

  

**Working Days:** 
 Monday to Saturday,
 **Alternate Saturdays Off**
**During The Internship, Candidates Will Receive Hands\-on Exposure To**
**Laptops → Networking → Servers → Windows/Linux → Backup → Security → IT Support → Infrastructure Management**
 Upon successful completion of the
 **6\-month internship** 
 , candidates may be considered for
 **full\-time employment** 
 based on technical performance, learning ability, troubleshooting skills, ownership, discipline and business requirements.

title: Network Development Engineer I, Operations Network Engineering Core
job_function: Quality Assurance, Information Technology, and Engineering
description:
**Description**
 Do you have experience in automating network administration using Python or other programming languages ? If yes, please keep reading...
   

  

 The Operation Networking Engineering ONE\- Core team builds next\-generation LAN infrastructure that powers Amazon's global fulfillment and operations network. The team manages LAN reliability, availability and automation for over 2,700 sites worldwide, assisting Amazon Operations and Grocery businesses.
   

  

 We are seeking a Network Development Engineer I to design and implement horizontally scalable LAN architecture. You will work on initiatives that will help to automate the reliability work, improving the LAN availability and work on building automation for self remediation of network events across thousands of devices. Your work will directly impact the improvement of complete LAN infrastructure.
   

  

 The team is focused on automating networks from multiple diverse vendors, maximizing reliability while minimizing human touch in deployment and maintenance activities. We collaborate closely with IT support teams to ensure that simplicity in our product designs translate to supportability in the field. Information security rigor is at the core of everything we do. You will tackle challenging, novel situations every day and have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with the idea of solving problems that haven't been solved at scale before. It is expected that you will be technically strong, while at the same time being balanced and pragmatic in your approach. Along the way, we guarantee that you will learn a lot and make a positive impact on millions of people.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an NDE I on the Core team, you will:
   

  

* Solve complex technical problems involving Cisco switching technology, network automation, and automating the manual tasks.
* Design solutions that are scalable, testable, maintainable, and efficient. Network reliability and automation are fundamental to your approach.
* Work on major portions of LAN network technology implementation, applying best practices while making pragmatic trade\-offs that consider both short\-term operational needs and long\-term business requirements.
* Operate the largest fulfillment network in the world, working with technologies including Cisco and other vendor network devices, config management, network automation tools, and configuration management systems.
* Leverage AI\-powered tools to enhance network operations, diagnostics, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with customers and stakeholders to develop project ideas into project plans, participate actively in design reviews and operational reviews, and mentor team members.
* Driving root cause resolution of network events most impactful to the business.


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role you will operate the largest fulfillment centre and grocery network in the world, and provide guidance to and mentoring to network support teams to develop their skills and reinforce best practices. Network reliability is critical to Amazon Operations, and your responsibilities will include driving root cause resolution of network events most impact\-full to the business.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The ONE\-Core Networking organisation supports multiple business globally, from the smallest delivery stations in emerging markets to the most advanced automated fulfillment centers in North America, Japan, and Europe. As a result, this group enjoys a variety of both tactical and strategic projects. This is a unique opportunity that will enable you to grow your skills as an engineer and have a lasting impact on Amazon’s fulfillment networks for years to come.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 2\+ years experience in a network focused hands\-on technical role working with IP routing protocols/technologies and experience designing and operating large\-scale production networks
* 2\+ or more years of experience with major routing protocols, specifically BGP and OSPF
* 2\+ or more years of experience with routing and switching hardware from major vendors including Cisco and Juniper
* Demonstrated ability to design, implement, and operate network solutions that are secure, stable, testable, and maintainable
* Strong documentation skills with proven methodology for creating clear technical documentation
* Experience building or enhancing tools, developing best practices, refining operational procedures, and thinking proactively with innovation
* 2\+ years experience in a technical on\-call capacity, responding to customer impacting events, mitigating and root cause analysis of those events.
* 1\+ years of experience in automation via Bash/shell scripting and Perl/Python programming.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of automation scripting using Python, Bash, Shell and/or Perl experience
* 2\+ years of major internet routing protocols experience
* 2\+ years of hands on experience in working on Linux/Unix
* A Masters in Computer Science, MBA, or equivalent experience.
* Senior Engineer experience at other organizations.
* Expert\-level certifications (e.g. CCIE, JNCIE) a plus.
* Scripting and or automation skills in a network environment.
* Software development/programming skills are a plus.


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Graviton:** 
 Graviton Research Capital is one of the largest quantitative trading firms emerging out of APAC, with a strong footprint across 40\+ global exchanges and a rapidly growing presence across Europe and the USA. We’re privately funded, long\-term focused, and deeply invested in building high\-performance teams that operate at scale in some of the most competitive markets globally.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot low\-latency network infrastructure used by trading firms.
* Manage connectivity to global stock exchanges, brokers, market\-data providers, and ISPs.
* Build and maintain colocation infrastructure including routers, switches, Layer\-1 devices (added advantage), structured cabling and cross connects.
* Configure and support Cisco Nexus, Arista and similar platform devices.
* Design and troubleshoot Layer 2 and Layer 3 networks including: VLANs, VRFs, BGP, OSPF, Static routing, PIM, IGMP, Multicast, SSM, ACLs and QoS.
* Troubleshoot packet loss, multicast issues, duplicate packets, IGMP/PIM and multicast/BGP routing.
* Monitor and optimize latency, jitter, packet loss, interface errors, congestion, and network performance.
* Work with ultra\-low\-latency technologies including: Cut\-through switching, Layer\-1 switches, FPGA\-based network devices, Kernel\-bypass networking, ExaNIC/Solarflare NICs, Hardware timestamping.
* Configure and troubleshoot PTP and clock synchronization infrastructure.
* Perform server and network equipment installation in exchange and third\-party data centres.
* Manage rack layout, patching, cable optimization, optics, DACs, cross\-connects, and inventory.
* Coordinate network changes with exchanges, telecom providers, brokers, vendors, and data\-centre teams.
* Plan and execute production changes during approved maintenance windows.
* Perform pre\-change validation, change implementation, post\-change testing, rollback planning, and documentation.
* Maintain network diagrams, IP\-address inventory, rack documentation, port mappings, circuit information, and SOPs.
* Automate repetitive operational and validation tasks using Python, Bash, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for network incidents and implement permanent corrective actions.
* Maintain high availability and redundancy for critical trading infrastructure.



  





**Qualifications** 




 The ideal candidate will have 3\+ years of experience with
 


* Strong hands\-on knowledge of TCP/IP networking, Ethernet, ARP, VLAN, STP, LACP, VRF
* Knowledge of routing protocols including static routing, BGP and OSPF.
* Experience with multicast configuration IGMPv2/IGMPv3, PIM\-SM
* Knowledge of QoS, ACLs, NAT
* Knowledge of network design, network operation or network automation and Network troubleshooting
* Good understanding of TCP and UDP behaviour, Market\-data multicast, Exchange connectivity, Low\-latency network architecture
* Understanding of Optical networking, SFP/SFP\+/QSFP optics, Single\-mode and multimode fibre
* Knowledge of datacenter installation and cabling standards, DAC/AOC cabling, PTP



  





**Why Join Graviton?** 



* Work in a high\-performance, data\-driven trading and engineering environment.
* Collaborate with some of the brightest minds in quantitative finance and technology.
* Competitive compensation, benefits and opportunities for professional growth.

title: Full Stack Engineer

Through products like Invoice Discounting and Amplio Wealth, we empower investors and founders with accessible, technology\-driven financial opportunities.
 



 Built on the principles of innovation, transparency, and customer\-centricity, Amplio is committed to creating long\-term value and simplifying access to modern investment solutions.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer who enjoys building scalable backend systems and intuitive frontend applications. You will work across modern technologies including Golang, Node.js, React.js, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
 



 This role is ideal for someone who likes hands\-on development, solving real engineering problems, and taking ownership beyond just task execution.
 



  





**Location**
 : Mumbai (On\-site)

* Build and maintain backend services using Golang and/or Node.js
* Develop responsive frontend applications using React.js
* Design and integrate REST APIs
* Work with PostgreSQL as the primary database and MongoDB for selected use cases
* Optimize application performance and scalability
* Debug and resolve production issues efficiently
* Collaborate with DevOps and product teams for deployments and feature releases
* Write clean, maintainable, and production\-ready code



  





**Required Skills**




 Backend
 


* Strong proficiency in Golang or Node.js (experience with both is a plus)
* Experience building REST APIs
* Understanding of concurrency concepts, especially in Go



 Frontend
 


* Hands\-on experience with React.js
* Familiarity with hooks, state management, and API integration
* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles



 Database
 


* Strong fundamentals of PostgreSQL (queries, joins, indexing basics)
* Understanding of schema design
* Basic knowledge of MongoDB (CRUD operations, collections, indexing awareness)



 General
 


* Git and version control
* Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills
* Basic understanding of system design concepts
