title: Robotics Simulation Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 What if the physics simulations you build could teach the next generation of robots how to walk, grasp, and navigate the real world? We're looking for Robotics Simulation Engineers in Bangalore to design, build, and optimize high\-fidelity physical simulations that bridge the gap between virtual environments and real\-world robotic systems.
   

  

 Bangalore's deep engineering talent and growing robotics ecosystem make it an ideal base for this work. You'll work at the intersection of robotics, physics, and software engineering — creating simulation pipelines that power robot learning, controls development, and hardware validation.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No corporate red tape — just meaningful, technical work on problems that matter.
   

  

* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design and implement high\-fidelity robot models (URDF/MJCF) with accurate kinematics, dynamics, and contact properties
* Build and maintain simulation environments using MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and/or Gazebo
* Develop end\-to\-end simulation pipelines for robot training, testing, and validation
* Tune physics parameters — friction, damping, inertia, actuator models — to maximize sim\-to\-real transfer
* Integrate simulations with ROS2 for perception, planning, and control workflows
* Write clean, performant code in Python and/or C\+\+ to support simulation infrastructure
* Collaborate asynchronously with robotics researchers and engineers on model accuracy and environment design
* Profile and optimize simulation performance for large\-scale or parallelized runs
* Document simulation configurations, model parameters, and pipeline architecture


**Who You Are**
* Strong hands\-on experience with at least one major robotics simulator: MuJoCo, NVIDIA Isaac Sim, or Gazebo
* Proficient in Python and/or C\+\+ in a robotics or scientific computing context
* Solid understanding of rigid\-body dynamics, contact mechanics, and control theory
* Experience creating and validating robot models (URDF, MJCF, or SDF formats)
* Familiarity with ROS2 and its integration with simulation environments
* Comfortable working with simulation pipelines — from environment setup to data collection and evaluation
* Self\-directed, detail\-oriented, and effective when working independently
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and a drive to close the sim\-to\-real gap


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with domain randomization, sim\-to\-real transfer techniques, or reinforcement learning in simulation
* Familiarity with GPU\-accelerated simulation (e.g., Isaac Gym, MuJoCo MJX)
* Background in legged locomotion, manipulation, or multi\-body systems
* Experience with CI/CD for simulation testing and automated validation
* Knowledge of sensor simulation — cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, force/torque sensors
* Contributions to open\-source robotics or simulation projects
* Graduate\-level coursework or research in robotics, controls, or computational physics


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge robotics simulation projects that directly impact how robots learn and perform
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where you're most productive
* Freelance autonomy with technically challenging, meaningful work
* Collaborate with a global community of robotics and AI professionals
* Gain exposure to state\-of\-the\-art simulation frameworks and research\-grade problems
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Intern Learning Experience Designer-STEM
description:
**About the role:** 




 You will build hands\-on robotics and electronics projects and convert them into beginner\-friendly manuals that teachers and students can actually follow. This is a hands\-on role focused on making builds reliable, repeatable, and easy to troubleshoot in real classroom conditions.
 



 Your work will combine three things:
 


* Building and validating projects end\-to\-end
* Documenting each step with clean, consistent photos
* Writing practical troubleshooting that solves common failure cases fast
* You will collaborate with lesson and manual designers so your build steps align with the learning flow.



  





  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



1. **Build and validate projects**


* Assemble robotics and electronics builds using common components used in school labs.
* Run each build multiple times to confirm it works reliably, not just once.
* Maintain a simple validation checklist so projects hold up in a classroom setting.


1. **Create step\-by\-step photo manuals**


* Capture clear photos for each build step (wiring, orientation, connections, safety).
* Keep photos consistent so learners can match what they see to what they are building.
* Organize assets with clean file naming and version updates.


1. **Create troubleshooting guides based on real failure cases**


* Identify common learner mistakes and failure patterns.
* Recreate mistakes intentionally and capture what goes wrong.
* Write fixes in a simple format: symptom, likely cause, quick fix.


1. **Support clarity and safety**


* Add short notes explaining what a component is doing and what students should observe.
* Include basic safety callouts in student\-friendly language.
* Suggest simple checks students can do before asking for help.


1. **Collaborate and iterate**


* Work closely with learning design and content reviewers to align build steps with lesson flow.
* Accept feedback and revise documentation quickly.
* Share short build status updates so the team knows what is ready and what is blocked.


1. **Use AI tools responsibly**


* Use AI to draft troubleshooting text, check clarity, and generate checklists.
* Verify everything by testing and ensuring the documentation matches reality.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* **Education:** 
 B.Tech/B.E. graduate or final\-year student
* **Specialization:** 
 Computer Science (CS), Electronics, or related engineering disciplines



  





**Must\-have skills:** 



* Hands\-on comfort with robotics and basic electronics used in school lab projects.
* Confidence working with breadboards, wiring, resistors, LEDs, sensors, basic actuators, and power handling basics.
* Calm, systematic debugging when something fails.
* Close attention to detail in wiring, steps, and documentation.
* Ability to take clear process photos that show orientation and connections.
* Comfort using AI tools with discipline to verify and correct outputs.



  





**Preferred skills:** 



* Personal or club project portfolio with build photos or videos.
* Ability to create simple diagrams or markups to highlight key parts.
* Awareness of school lab constraints (time, missing parts, repeated handling).
* Used ChatGPT Codex/Claude Code or other AI tools to create interactive modules/apps/games/htmls
* A student can complete the physical and digital build with minimal help.
* Photos are clear, consistent, and focus on the details that matter.
* Troubleshooting resolves common failures quickly.
* Builds are stable enough for repeated classroom use.
* Documentation is clean, reusable, and easy for others to maintain.



  





**How to Apply:** 




 Please share your personal/college project/competition/hackathon details to stand out from the crowd through this link
 


* Resume
* Links to your projects (photos, videos, write\-ups, or GitHub)
* 1\-page sample: explain how to build a simple circuit or robotics build, plus 3 common mistakes and how to fix them

description:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic B.Sc. Chemistry fresher to join our Quality Control / Laboratory team at our food manufacturing plant. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of chemistry, good observation skills, willingness to learn, and the ability to work in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities1\. Laboratory Testing \& Analysis

* Assist in testing parameters such as pH, acidity, moisture, fat, and other applicable quality parameters.
* Handle laboratory instruments and equipment carefully as per standard procedures.
* Ensure proper sampling, labelling, and storage of samples.

2\. Quality Control

* Assist the QC team in checking the quality of incoming raw materials and finished products.
* Support quality checks during different stages of production.
* Report abnormal test results or deviations to the concerned senior.
* Follow approved SOPs, quality procedures, and food safety guidelines.
* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in the laboratory and assigned work areas.

3\. Documentation \& Records

* Maintain daily laboratory testing records and registers.
* Record test results accurately and ensure proper documentation.
* Assist in preparing quality reports and maintaining sample records.
* Support the team in maintaining calibration and equipment usage records.
* Ensure laboratory documents are updated and properly maintained.

4\. Safety \& Compliance

* Follow laboratory safety procedures while handling chemicals and equipment.
* Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Handle chemicals, glassware, and laboratory instruments responsibly.
* Follow company policies, GMP, hygiene, and food safety practices.
* Report any laboratory safety concerns to the reporting manager.

5\. Learning \& Development

* Learn laboratory testing methods and food quality parameters.
* Develop practical knowledge of dairy and food product quality testing.
* Assist senior team members in investigations of quality deviations.
* Participate in training related to quality control, food safety, and laboratory practices.

Eligibility Criteria

* B.Sc. in Chemistry from a recognized university.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Basic knowledge of Organic, Inorganic, and Analytical Chemistry.
* Basic understanding of laboratory testing and chemical handling.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and MS Word.
* Willingness to work in a food manufacturing plant and learn laboratory operations.

* Ability to follow instructions and SOPs.

* Teamwork and discipline.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to work in rotational shifts
* Candidates are required to stay close to the plant.

 As a PM you would be managing a specific product (Flight / Hotel / Holiday etc) and be responsible for delivering Business KPIs (GMV /Revenue / Growth / Retention). To do well in the role, one needs to:
 



  




* Be a CEO of the product (business) and drive business results by working with business /marketing / content etc teams.

* Get into details to create detailed product documentation and user stories for tech.



  





**You Want to** 




  




* Improve your business acumen
* Drive results \& projects from ideation to execution
* Build things yourself instead of only specifying them, treat AI as leverage to move from "product manager" to someone who ships working software independently



  





**This role is not ideal for someone who is** 




  




* Not excited about working closely with tech and business teams to executelooking for a role to drive "strategy." We are a startup. Execution is everything
* Not comfortable with long working hours.
* Not excited about working on Saturdays (6 days a week). Yes Product is 6 days working (but
* Tech is not) as Product is expected to solve business challenges /grow the business

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
****Lyzr, in a minute****
 Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents software that handles real tasks on its own to work in their everyday operations. Most companies' AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day\-to\-day use. Today, 500\+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.
   

  

 Agentic software has no settled design language yet. How a person delegates work to an agent, follows what it did, and decides whether to trust the result are questions the industry is still answering. This role sits directly on those questions.
   

  

****The role****
 You will design the surfaces enterprise teams use to build, run, and supervise AI agents. This is a product design role, not a visual execution role: you will be handed problems, not specifications, and you will be expected to frame them before you open Figma.
   

  

 You will join a small design team, which means real scope from week one and no queue between you and the product decisions that matter.
   

  

* Team: Product
* Experience: 2–4 years
* Location \& work mode: Bengaluru, hybrid


****What will make you win this role****
 These are the core requirements the substance of the job.
   

  

* 2–4 years in product design, UI/UX, or interaction design. Shipped product work, not concept work. We will look at what went live and what changed because of it.
* Product thinking, evidenced. You can walk us through a problem you were given, how you framed it, the options you rejected, and why the version that shipped was the right one. Craft matters; judgement matters more.
* B2B SaaS, enterprise, or AI product experience. You have designed for users who are doing their job in your product, under constraints permissions, workflows, data density, edge cases not for consumers browsing.
* Interaction design and information architecture depth. Complex systems, dense states, and multi\-step flows are where you are strongest. You think in systems, not screens.
* Fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools. Figma at a production standard, plus whatever you use to make an idea feel real before it is built.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging interaction patterns. You have opinions about how people should work with agents, and you are actively forming them.


****Cherry on top****
 Not screening criteria but they will make your first 90 days smoother.
   

  

* AI\-native product design. You have designed agents, copilots, chat, or automation workflows and know where the usual patterns break.
* AI in your own design process. You use it to move faster and explore wider, and you can show where it helped and where it did not.
* 0→1 experience. You have built something from nothing inside a startup or a new product line.
* Design systems. You have built or scaled one, and you understand the maintenance cost as well as the leverage.
* A view on AI trust and transparency. Agent behaviour, explainability, human\-in\-the\-loop control you have thought about what earns a user's confidence.


****Life at Lyzr****
* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company\-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem\-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.


****How to apply****
 Apply through our careers page at careers.lyzr.ai, or send your resume to hiring@lyzr.ai. Send your portfolio with it we read those first. Two or three case studies you can defend end to end will tell us more than a gallery of screens.

title: Product Design Intern
description:
Description
 


 Cravv is building the brain for the kitchen. A device that understands what is happening while you cook and guides you through it as it happens. We are a Tier 1 funded hardware startup in Bengaluru, and the first units are going into real homes. Nobody has built this before, so there is no product to reference and no template to follow. Everything you design here is the first version of it.
 





 The product is three things at once. A device, a mobile app, and an AI layer that reads the kitchen and decides what to say next. Very few designers get to work across all three, and almost nobody gets to this early.
 





 We move fast. We are in active testing, work goes live most weeks, and a decision takes one conversation.
 





 We are looking for a product design intern to help us figure it out.
 




 What you will actually work on
 


 Not moodboards. Not assisting a senior designer. Real parts of the product, owned end to end and shipped.
 



* **The device, and the app around it.** 

 Two surfaces with very different rules. Most designers do not get near hardware until much later, if ever.
* **An AI that sometimes gets it wrong.** 

 You decide what it says, when it stays quiet, and how it recovers from a bad guess. The hardest problem here, and the most interesting.
* **A design system you build, not inherit.** 

 You name things and decide what scales, then watch it hold up or break.
* **Features from zero.** 

 Talk to users, work out what they actually need, design the answer.
* **Work that ships.** 

 Feedback comes back in hours, not quarters. What you draw this morning can be in a kitchen tonight.
* **Real kitchens, not personas.** 

 Watch someone struggle with something you made, work out why, and fix it.
* **The small stuff.** 

 Components, states, micro\-interactions, motion. The details that decide whether it feels good.



 Who you will be working with
 


 A small, young team that ships every week. Average age is closer to yours than to your professor’s.
 





 No hierarchy, no design committee, no six\-week approvals. You show the work, we talk about it, it ships. You will be in the room where the decision gets made, not the one where it gets announced.
 





 We argue about details.
 




 What you get out of it
 

**Three to four months here is worth about two years elsewhere.** 

 A big company gives you one surface, one release a quarter, and a senior designer between you and the decision. Here you get three surfaces, a release most weeks, and the founders in the room. You will make more decisions and ship more work in a few months than most designers do in two years.
 




**A skillset almost nobody your age has.** 

 Hardware, mobile and AI in one product. You will leave able to say you have designed a physical interface, an app and an AI experience, with shipped work behind each.
 




**A stipend at par with industry standards.** 

 Paid monthly, on time. Exposure is not a currency.
 




**A recommendation letter from the founders,** 

 if things go well, based on work you actually shipped.
 




**A full\-time offer at the end,** 

 if the fit is right.
 




**Ownership that usually takes years to earn.** 

 Your name is on the thing. So are your mistakes. Both are useful.
 




**A portfolio piece nobody else has.** 

 Your case study starts with ‘I designed for a category that did not exist yet.’ It will be the first thing every future interviewer asks about.
 




 What we are looking for
 


 High agency, above everything else. You see something broken and you fix it without being asked. You do not wait for a brief, and nobody has to chase you. When something is unclear, you go and find out.
 





 After that:
 



* A portfolio with your best work. This is the main thing we look at
* Comfort when there is no obvious right answer
* Curiosity about people and about how things work
* Figma fluency and product thinking




 Interest in hardware or AI helps, but it is not a requirement. We can teach that part.
 





 We do not care about your college, your CGPA, or whether design was your original degree.
 




 To apply
 


 Send your portfolio to careers@cravv.in . Tell us briefly what you would want to work on here and why.
 





 More about us at www.cravv.in

description:
💻 Position: Enterprise Implementation Consultant
 



 📍Location: Gurugram
 



 🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturday \- half day)
 



 📌 Experience Required: 1\-3 years
 



  





 In\-Office \+ Client Site \| Enterprise SaaS \| Construction Tech
 



 About Our Client
 



 Construction is a $13 trillion global industry — and one of the least digitised. Projects routinely overrun budgets and timelines because execution data lives in spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and the heads of site engineers. The cost of this opacity runs into millions on every project.
 



 Our Client is an AI\-powered Construction Management System that gives construction and infrastructure companies real\-time control, visibility, and predictability over project execution.
 



 Credentials:
 


* Backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners \& Zacua Ventures
* RICS SEA PropTech of the Year — 2024 \& 2025, ET Realty PropTech of the Year 2024, 2026
* Reference Customers: Amazon (India \& UAE), JSW Homes, The Fitout, LivSpace, Semac Construction, Blinkit, Table Space, Fortes Education,



 The Role
 



 We are hiring Enterprise Implementation Consultants to serve as the primary client\-facing interface for Our Client deployments at some of India’s most complex construction and infrastructure organisations.
 



**This is not a back\-office coordination role.** 




 You will be embedded on\-prem at enterprise client sites — operating inside organisations like Amazon, JSW, LivSpace, Blinkit, Table Space etc. Working under the direction of an experienced EIC Lead, your mandate is to translate client workflows into structured Our Client implementations, drive user adoption from Day 1, and serve as the trusted consultant bridging client operations and the Our Client product team.
 



 You will own on\-the\-ground execution: stakeholder engagement, training delivery, adoption tracking, process documentation, and continuous improvement — with direct support from a seasoned EIC Lead throughout.
 



 What You Will Own
 


* Client\-side implementation support — conducting workflow discovery sessions, mapping organisation structures, and assisting in configuring approval hierarchies and SOPs within Our Client
* Stakeholder engagement across department heads and on\-ground teams — building credibility, facilitating alignment, and maintaining momentum across the deployment lifecycle
* Training programme delivery — executing department\-wise and role\-specific training sessions, producing structured training materials, and driving hands\-on adoption from Day 1
* Adoption monitoring and reporting — tracking usage dashboards, auditing system activity, producing weekly adoption reports, and escalating non\-compliance to the EIC Lead with clear documentation
* Process documentation — preparing MOMs, SOPs, training schedules, and audit reports that are acted upon by client stakeholders
* Data coordination — supporting the migration and structuring of client data including BOQs, vendor masters, and rate contracts into Our Client
* Internal coordination — channelling client feedback and field observations to the EIC Lead and Our Client product team with clarity and context
* Continuous improvement — identifying workflow gaps and proposing improvements that increase platform utilisation and client ROI



 Who Should Apply
 


* 0–2 years of experience in client\-facing roles — SaaS implementation, customer success, technology consulting, or enterprise onboarding
* Exposure to construction, infrastructure, real estate, or asset\-heavy industries is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to engage independently with senior client stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments
* Strong first\-principles thinking — you break problems into components, ask the right questions, and adapt when plans meet reality
* Excellent communication and documentation skills — your MOMs, SOPs, and training materials are clear, structured, and acted upon
* Data literacy and comfort with technology — advanced Excel, familiarity with dashboarding tools, and openness to learning SQL and Python
* High ownership and bias for action — you move fast, flag blockers early, and do not wait for instructions



 Ideal prior backgrounds include:
 


* Campus placements, internships, or early\-career stints in enterprise SaaS, management consulting, or technology services
* Operations, project coordination, or EIC support roles in construction, EPC, real estate, or field\-operations environments
* Customer\-facing roles in B2B product companies with structured onboarding or implementation components



 What This Role Is Not
 



 We want to be transparent about fit:
 


* This is not a remote or hybrid position. You will be deployed at client sites and Our Client offices across India. Domestic travel is a core part of the role.
* This is not a passive support role. You are not logging tickets or forwarding requests — you are accountable for the success of enterprise implementations on the ground.
* This is not a pure training or coordination role. You will engage directly with CXO and VP\-level stakeholders and be expected to hold your own in consultative conversations.
* This requires maturity, independence, and comfort operating in ambiguity — particularly when deploying software inside organisations where digital maturity is being built from scratch.



 Skills \& Competencies
 



 Must\-Have
 


* Client\-facing presence and communication — ability to run structured discovery sessions, present confidently to department heads, and maintain professional relationships on\-prem
* Documentation capability — MOMs, SOPs, training schedules, audit reports, and adoption dashboards that are clear and immediately usable
* Data literacy — advanced Excel, ability to structure and interpret operational data, and comfort working with reporting tools
* Organisational rigour — managing parallel workstreams across multiple stakeholders without dropping threads
* Escalation discipline — knowing when and how to surface blockers to the EIC Lead and client leadership with the right context



 Strong Advantages
 


* SQL proficiency and ability to run basic analytical queries
* Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Grafana, Metabase, or Power BI
* Exposure to workflow automation, AI agents, or no\-code/low\-code platforms
* Understanding of construction workflows: BOQ management, DPR, procurement cycles, vendor coordination, and site operations

* Ability to design and document end\-to\-end operational workflows — mapping process steps, decision nodes, roles, and system touchpoints with precision; experience translating client workflows into structured platform configurations is a strong plus

description:
**Job description** 




 As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will be responsible for delivering high\-quality firmware for next\-generation embedded products in the Internal Combustion Engine (ICE)/Electrical Vehicle (EV) domain. You will work on crucial firmware engineering problems, including real\-time application development and profiling, serial driver development for a variety of specialized ICs, and the development of key abstractions allowing for deeper integration with cloud platform. Software engineers help bridge the gap between hardware engineers and controls engineers, leveraging proven profiling, test, and debugging techniques to optimize compute and memory overhead. Join a team of knowledgeable and passionate engineers striving to build robust embedded systems to solve the most relevant problems in mobility. Being on the Intangles’ Embedded team means building the future of innovation and growth through cutting edge AI infused hardware platform.
 



  





  





**The minimum requirements we seek** 




  




* B.E/B.Tech or M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering or equivalent degree.
* A minimum of 2\-5 years’ experience in developing firmware with a focus on Linux\-based system
* Proficient in C/C\+\+ programming languages and scripting languages like Python
* Strong understanding of Linux kernel, device drivers, and real\-time operating systems, including schedulers, concurrency, and memory management
* Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C, UART, TCP/IP, Modbus, Ethernet.
* Familiarity with common electronic components and comfort reading circuit design schematics and contributing to hardware design discussions
* Expertise with bench electrical engineering tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and debuggers.
* Experience with Yocto Project or other build systems for embedded Linux.
* Knowledge of security principles in embedded systems.
* Ability to work in a collaborative, cross\-functional team environment.

* Experience with automotive safety standards (ISO 26262\)

* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and issue tracking tools
* Understanding of software development lifecycle and agile methodologies
* Strong communication skills and the ability to document technical designs and solutions
* A system approach to design and development with the desire and curiosity to strive for exceptional delivery execution and continuous improvement
* Deliver high\-quality embedded C code in a real\-time safety\-rated environment
* Design, develop, and maintain embedded Linux software solutions for automotive applications
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define software requirements and specifications
* Implement and optimize device drivers, kernel modules, and middleware components for embedded systems
* Ensure compliance with coding standards and automotive industry regulations
* Debug and bring up hardware prototypes using debuggers, logic analyzers, and custom tooling. Troubleshoot software issues, providing timely resolutions

title: Project & Operations Associate
description:
We are an early\-stage healthcare\-technology venture building digital products in partnership with a hospital. We’re hiring a versatile, hands\-on **Project \& Operations Associate** to be based on\-site and act as our eyes, ears and hands on the ground — coordinating between the doctors, the hospital’s local IT team, and our remote product and engineering team.

This is a **generalist role that will grow with the company.** In a given week you might be gathering requirements from doctors, coordinating a rollout, troubleshooting a tech issue, testing a new app feature, or documenting a process. We’re looking for someone smart, reliable and eager to learn — the mix of work and your responsibilities will expand as the venture scales. If you want a ground\-floor role with real ownership and fast growth, this is for you.

What you’ll do

* Act as the single point of contact between the doctors, hospital staff, local IT team, and our remote team — coordinate, schedule and follow up so everyone stays aligned.

* Handle first\-line IT troubleshooting — networking/Wi\-Fi, devices, app logins, payments, and general PC/mobile issues — fixing what you can and escalating the rest with clear notes.
* Test new versions of our apps and report bugs with clear steps and screenshots.

* Take on new responsibilities as the venture and product portfolio grow.

What we’re looking for

* Strong at organizing and following up — someone who closes loops without being reminded.

* A rare chance to grow quickly into a broader operations/product/technology role as we scale.
* Training and full support provided.

* Direct Sales
* Fundraising

 We’re hiring an
 **Intern, Talent Acquisition** 
 to work closely with our TA team and own hiring processes end to end across multiple roles. You’ll get hands\-on exposure to the entire recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening candidates to candidate communication, interview management, stakeholder coordination, and offer negotiation.
 



  





 You’ll also work on improving how we hire by experimenting with AI tools, automations, and new ways of working.
 



  





 If you want to build a strong foundation in Talent Acquisition while getting exposure to real hiring problems, fast\-paced teams, and global talent, this is the role for you.

* **Own hiring end to end:** 
 Take ownership of roles across the recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to candidate management, interviews, stakeholder coordination, and offers.

 of experience in recruiting, HR, operations, or a fast\-paced startup environment is preferred. Relevant internships or project experience are a plus.

 You enjoy breaking down ambiguous problems and finding practical ways to solve them.

* **Adaptability:** 
 You’re comfortable switching between different roles, priorities, and problem statements in a fast\-moving environment.

title: Assistant Manager - Business HR
description:
**Broad outline of the Role**


* Responsible for implementation of HR initiatives, policies and processes related to recruitment, employee engagement, learning and development, and talent management and to improve business outcome. This is an operational role, responsible for delivering results that have direct impact on the achievement of results within the business.

* 2\-7 years of experience in HR

* Ability to understand the business and key requirements.

* Initiate and manage HR projects and initiatives, monitor progress, and make course corrections if required.

* Partner with HR COE to drive implementation of talent management practices.

* hr business partner
* hrbp
* talent management
* employee engagement
* succession planning
* performance management
* business requirements
* hr policy

title: Factory Account Executive
description:
**Job title:** Factory Account Executive — Garment Industry SaaS Sales (Gurugram)

**Job type:** Full\-time, Permanent **Schedule:** Day shift, Monday–Saturday **Pay:** ₹32,000 – ₹65,000 a month **Pay detail:** Fixed ₹32,000/month \+ uncapped commission, ₹30,000/month on target **Location:** Gurugram, Haryana — field role, factory visits across NCR

About SilaiLink

SilaiLink gives garment and textile factories a verified wage ledger and a verified pool of workers to hire from. Subscriptions run ₹2,499 to ₹19,999 a month. The accounts you close are yours to own, grow and earn from for as long as they stay.

What you'll do

* Own factory acquisition in your territory: get to the owner or the production head, run the demo on the floor, close the subscription
* Take each account live — jobs posted, seats accepted, QC entry actually running on the line
* Stay the account owner after the sale. Your commission is recurring and tied to retention, so churn is your problem and your upside.
* Grow accounts: more job seats, higher tier, more AI tech\-pack usage
* Work with the field officer team so every job your factory posts gets filled with verified workers

Garment trade experience — required

You will be sitting across from garment factory owners and production heads. They decide in the first two minutes whether you know the business.

* **Minimum 2 years selling to, or working inside, garment/apparel/textile manufacturing** — B2B sales into garment units, or a production/merchandising/IE/HR/compliance role you are moving out of into sales
* You can hold a real conversation about order delivery dates, line balancing, labour shortage before a shipment, piece\-rate wage sheets, contractor labour, and buyer social compliance audits (SEDEX, BSCI, SA8000 type) that demand clean wage and attendance records
* You know how NCR garment units are structured — own roll versus contractor labour, job\-work units, buying house pressure, the peak\-season scramble for tailors
* You are comfortable walking a production floor, not just a conference room
* Existing relationships in NCR garment units are a serious advantage and will be discussed in the interview

What you'll earn

* **Fixed ₹32,000/month**
* **₹1,500 per factory converted to paid** (on first payment received)
* **5% of subscription revenue from your own accounts, every month, for as long as they stay** — plus 5% of their AI usage spend
* **₹5 per worker** whose first verified job is at your account; **₹2 per job seat accepted** at your accounts
* Realistic at 20 Professional accounts: ₹62,000–77,000/month, with the recurring share growing every month you retain

Also required

* 1–4 years in B2B field sales, with a closing record you can talk through
* Fluent Hindi and working English
* Own vehicle, and a smartphone or laptop

What we offer

* Fixed salary on the 1st, uncapped recurring commission
* Employee stock options — every employee holds equity by Series A
* Provident Fund, ESI, travel allowance
* Health insurance from our next funding round
* Path to Ops Lead / Hub Manager (₹6–9 LPA \+ ESOP \+ hub bonus)
* Single\-digit employee number on the commercial team. What you build, you own.

**Work Location:** In person

Screening questions

* How many years have you sold to, or worked inside, garment/apparel/textile manufacturing?
* Name the kinds of garment units you have worked with and roughly how many.
* Have you sold a software or subscription product to businesses? What was the average monthly ticket size?
* Which NCR garment clusters do you already have contacts in?
* What is your current fixed salary and your current on\-target earning?
* Do you have your own vehicle?

Pay: ₹32,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Field Officer
description:
**Job title:** Field Officer — Garment Worker Onboarding (Gurugram)

**Job type:** Full\-time, Permanent **Schedule:** Day shift, Monday–Saturday **Pay:** ₹20,000 – ₹35,000 a month **Pay detail:** Fixed ₹20,000/month \+ performance incentive up to ₹15,000/month **Location:** Gurugram, Haryana — field role, travel within assigned garment cluster

About SilaiLink

SilaiLink runs a verified wage ledger for garment and textile factories. Every worker gets a permanent record of the jobs they did and the money they earned. Every factory gets a verified pool of tailors, checkers and finishers it can hire from. We are building the NCR network cluster by cluster.

What you'll do

* Sign up garment workers in your cluster onto the SilaiLink app — Aadhaar and bank/UPI verification, done correctly the first time
* Get each new worker through their first job on the platform so their earnings actually start
* Own a pod of 100–500 workers as their personal account manager. You are the person they call when a payment or a job is in question.
* Keep the pod active: monthly check\-ins, resolving wage queries, bringing back workers who go quiet
* Visit units in your cluster with the account team when a factory's job posts need filling
* Log every visit and signup in the app the same day. No paper, no backdating.

Garment trade experience — required

This role is only open to people who already know the garment line. You should be able to walk into a stitching unit and know what you are looking at.

* **Minimum 1 year working in or around garment/apparel/textile manufacturing** in NCR — as a supervisor, line in\-charge, jobber, master, checker, production or HR/time\-office assistant, contractor's coordinator, or in field recruitment for garment units
* You know the operations by name: cutting, stitching (single needle, overlock, flatlock), checking, thread cutting, ironing, finishing, packing
* You understand how garment workers are actually paid — piece rate, daily wage, monthly, and how contractor (thekedari) labour differs from a factory's own roll
* You are already comfortable in Udyog Vihar, Sector 37, Kapashera, Okhla, Faridabad or Noida Phase 2 type clusters, and in the worker colonies around them
* You can speak to a tailor about their rate and their attendance without them feeling sold to

If you have sold loans, insurance or SIM cards but have never been on a garment floor, this role is not the right fit. Apply to our Factory Account Executive posting instead if you have B2B sales experience.

What you'll earn

* **Fixed ₹20,000/month**, paid on the 1st, every month. Your rent and food never depend on incentive.
* **₹50 per activated worker** — ₹20 on verified signup (Aadhaar \+ bank/UPI), ₹30 when they finish their first verified job within 30 days
* **₹3 per active worker in your pod, every month** — 500 active workers \= ₹1,500/month, recurring, on a pod you have already built. This rate rises as platform revenue per worker grows.
* **₹1 per verified job** completed by a worker you recruited

**Job type:** Full\-time, Permanent **Schedule:** Day shift, Monday–Saturday **Pay:** ₹20,000 – ₹35,000 a month **Pay detail:** Fixed ₹20,000/month \+ performance incentive up to ₹15,000/month **Location:** Gurugram, Haryana — field role, travel within assigned garment cluster

About SilaiLink

SilaiLink runs a verified wage ledger for garment and textile factories. Every worker gets a permanent record of the jobs they did and the money they earned. Every factory gets a verified pool of tailors, checkers and finishers it can hire from. We are building the NCR network cluster by cluster.

What you'll do

* Sign up garment workers in your cluster onto the SilaiLink app — Aadhaar and bank/UPI verification, done correctly the first time
* Get each new worker through their first job on the platform so their earnings actually start
* Own a pod of 100–500 workers as their personal account manager. You are the person they call when a payment or a job is in question.
* Keep the pod active: monthly check\-ins, resolving wage queries, bringing back workers who go quiet
* Visit units in your cluster with the account team when a factory's job posts need filling
* Log every visit and signup in the app the same day. No paper, no backdating.

Garment trade experience — required

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Role Purpose

To build, manage, and retain a high\-performing clinic team by owning recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, performance support, attendance, documentation, and staff coordination. The HR ensures smooth people operations, strong discipline, and a professional workplace culture that supports patient experience and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment \& Workforce Planning

\- Handle end\-to\-end hiring for clinical and non\-clinical roles: doctors, therapists, nurses, counselors, receptionists, sales staff, support staff, and coordinators.

\- Work with management to forecast manpower needs and plan hiring timelines

\- Source candidates via job portals, social media, references, WhatsApp groups, and local networks.

\- Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, coordinate final interviews, and manage offer discussions

\- Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future vacancies.

2\. Onboarding \& Induction

\- Manage joining formalities, documentation, and employee file creation

\- Conduct structured onboarding: clinic tour, role briefing, SOP introduction, team introduction, and basic training coordination.

\- Ensure new hires receive ID, access, uniform, and required tools on Day 1\.

\- Conduct onboarding check\-ins in the first 30–60 days to improve retention.

3\. Employee Records, Attendance \& Compliance

\- Maintain accurate employee files, attendance, leave records, and HR trackers.

\- Ensure proper documentation for compliance and internal audits.

\- Coordinate payroll inputs, incentive records, and F\&F settlements with finance/operations.

\- Enforce HR policies, SOPs, and workplace rules consistently.

4\. Performance, Discipline \& Employee Relations

\- Support managers in tracking performance, KRAs/KPIs, and workplace conduct.

\- Handle grievances, conflicts, counseling, warning letters, PIPs, and disciplinary matters professionally.

\- Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition trends to reduce turnover.

\- Promote a culture of trust, accountability, and respect across the team.

5\. Training, Engagement \& Retention

\- Identify training needs and coordinate skill development sessions for staff.

\- Support engagement activities: recognition, milestones, team meetings, and morale\-building initiatives.

\- Work with management on retention strategies, incentives, and career\-path discussions.

6\. HR Reporting \& Coordination

\- Prepare monthly HR reports: hiring status, attrition, attendance summary, open positions, and recruitment pipeline.

\- Act as the main HR point of contact for staff and managers.

\- Collaborate with operations, sales, and clinical heads for smooth workforce planning.

Required Skills \& Qualities

\- Strong recruitment and screening skills with good judgment of attitude and fit.

\- Excellent communication, coordination, and follow\-up ability.

\- Confident handling of staff issues, discipline, and sensitive matters.

\- Organized, detail\-oriented, and able to maintain accurate records.

\- Professional, mature, and able to work in a fast\-paced clinic environment.

Preferred Experience

\- 3 years\+ of HR and recruitment/administration experience.

\- Experience in clinic, hospital, salon, wellness, dermatology, or service industry is a strong plus.

\- Graduate in any stream; HR background preferred.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Work from home

 LENS Corporation is an AI, Computer Vision, and Biometrics company building enterprise\-grade platforms deployed across government, defence, infrastructure, smart cities, and large enterprises.

**Role Overview**




  





 We are looking for a QA Engineer who can take ownership of product quality, stability, and release confidence across complex, multi\-module platforms.
 



 This role goes beyond basic test execution.
 



 You will work closely with product, engineering, business analysts, and support teams to ensure features behave correctly in real\-world, large\-scale deployments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




  





 Functional \& Regression Testing
 



 Perform functional testing across:
 


* Web platforms (VMS, ICCC, UNMS, SAFER)
* Mobile applications (Android \& iOS)
* Execute regression testing before every release.
* Validate fixes, enhancements, and configuration changes.



 Release \& Stability Ownership
 


* Participate in release planning and pre\-release sanity testing.
* Ensure critical workflows remain stable across updates.
* Identify edge cases related to scale, permissions, roles, and configurations.



 Test Design \& Documentation
 



 Create and maintain:
 


* Test cases
* Test scenarios
* Bug reports with clear reproduction steps
* Work closely with Business Analysts to align test coverage with functional requirements.



 Cross\-Team Collaboration
 


* Coordinate with developers to explain issues clearly and verify fixes.
* Support internal teams during deployments and demos when required.
* Help ensure production issues are minimized through strong pre\-release validation.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience**



* 2–5 years of experience as a QA Engineer in a product or enterprise tech environment.



  





**Strong understanding of:** 



* Functional testing
* Regression testing
* Release validation
* Experience testing web\-based platforms and mobile applications.
* Ability to think in terms of real\-world usage, workflows, and failure scenarios.
* Clear communication and structured bug reporting.

* Exposure to VMS, AI/ML systems, Surveillance, IoT, GovTech, or Smart City platforms.

* Not a manual testing\-only checkbox role.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  




**Description**
 We are looking for an early\-career Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to help us build and maintain the automated tests that keep our products reliable. You will work alongside developers and senior SDETs to write test automation, expand our regression coverage, and investigate failures in our CI pipelines. This is a hands\-on engineering role: you will spend most of your time writing code, not clicking through screens.
   

 It is an ideal role for someone who enjoys breaking things on purpose, is comfortable in a codebase, and wants to grow into a strong quality engineer with a solid automation foundation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Write, execute, and maintain automated API tests using Playwright and Robot Framework.
* Review requirements and user stories, design and document test cases covering functional and non\-functional scenarios.
* Execute manual exploratory testing on new features where automation coverage does not yet exist, and convert repeatable checks into automated tests.
* Triage failing tests in CI/CD pipelines, distinguish genuine product defects from flaky or environment\-related failures, and escalate appropriately.
* Log clear, well\-evidenced defects with reproduction steps, logs, and screenshots, and track them through to closure.
* Use Git for day\-to\-day version control\- branching, pull requests, and responding to code review feedback on your test code.
* Contribute to test data setup, environment configuration, and small automation utilities that reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with developers and product managers on quality risks.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 0\-2 years of experience in software testing, test automation, or software development
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language \- Python preferred.
* Exposure to an automation framework such as PyTest, Playwright, or Robot Framework, through work, coursework, or personal projects.
* Understanding of REST API concepts (HTTP methods, status codes, JSON) and familiarity with a tool such as Postman or the requests library.
* Familiarity with Git and basic branching workflows.
* Solid grasp of software testing fundamentals: test case design, defect lifecycle, regression testing, and the difference between functional and non\-functional testing.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with clear written and verbal communication.
* Willingness to learn quickly and take direction from senior engineers.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 
* Hands\-on experience with PyTest, Playwright (TypeScript or Python bindings) or Robot Framework.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Concourse, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Awareness of Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as Jira.
* Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or Locust.

Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.

Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.

title: Executive, IPQA
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The role is responsible for ensuring day\-to\-day compliance with global GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) during manufacturing, packing, and dispensing activities at the site. The role provides on\-floor quality assurance support, ensuring operations are performed as per approved procedures, validated processes, and regulatory expectations. The role performs line clearance, in\-process checks, routine area monitoring, and documentation review, ensuring data integrity, product quality, and patient safety. The position supports cleaning validation, process validation, and aseptic process simulations, and assists in deviation management and inspection readiness, contributing to consistent, compliant, and right\-first\-time pharmaceutical manufacturing.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Perform IPQA (In\-Process Quality Assurance) activities during manufacturing and packing operations
* Oversee calibration of IPQA instruments
* Review of and release of Batch
* Review the in\-process and finished product COA before batch release
* Keeping records \& review of equipment’s logbooks, dispensing logs, housekeeping records, environmental monitoring records, calibration record, batch records
* Execute Line Clearance and Readiness for manufacturing, packing, and dispensing areas
* Conduct routine In\-Process Checks and coordinate with IPQC (In\-Process Quality Control)
* Ensure compliance with 21 CFR Part 210 \& 211 (Code of Federal Regulations – Current Good Manufacturing Practice for Drugs)
* Review BMR (Batch Manufacturing Record) and BPR (Batch Packing Record) for accuracy
* Perform Environmental Monitoring and routine monitoring of manufacturing areas
* Ensure assurance of cleaning, sterilization, and aseptic manipulations
* Support Sampling of Cleaning Validation and record compilation
* Assist in Process Validation Reports (PVR – Process Validation Report) activities
* Support Aseptic Process Simulation (Media Fill) monitoring
* Ensure Good Documentation Practices (GDP – Good Documentation Practices) compliance
* Participate in Routine GMP Inspections and quality record reviews


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Real\-time Monitoring and Compliance Reporting.
* Participation in Investigations.
* Provide on\-the\-job training to shop floor personnel on GMP practices, quality standards, and documentation practices.
* Maintain IPQA\-related documents and records in a state of audit readiness.
* To have good written and verbal communication skills in English language.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
* B. Pharm B. Pharm \- Required
* M. Pharm M. Pharm \- Preferred

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Platform Engineer based in India.**
 This role focuses on maintaining reliable, scalable, and highly available technology platforms in a fast\-paced operational environment.
   

  

 You will work across Kubernetes, containerization, Linux, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, and cloud technologies to support system stability.
   

  

 The position combines proactive monitoring, incident response, troubleshooting, automation, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will help reduce operational dependencies by strengthening runbooks, automation, monitoring, and self\-service capabilities.
   

  

 The role requires close collaboration with technical partners while maintaining service levels and responding quickly to production incidents.
   

  

 You will work with distributed systems and modern deployment strategies, with opportunities to improve platform resilience and delivery processes.
   

  

 The position is suited to engineers who enjoy hands\-on technical problem solving and are comfortable working rotational shifts.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Work with a proactive platform operations team to maintain system stability, minimize incidents, consistently achieve service\-level targets, and improve capacity and operational performance through metrics and best practices.
* Resolve Tier\-1 incidents using established runbooks, including system restarts, network connectivity checks, model resets, data\-flow checks, alert reprocessing, environment verification, and other standard operational fixes.
* Monitor systems and alerting channels continuously, review operational metrics, provide immediate incident response, and prepare daily and weekly reports covering system performance, incidents, and key indicators.
* Review root\-cause analysis and resolution requests, execute documented runbook procedures, and escalate issues to L2/L3 support when they involve model, hardware, security, or other issues beyond the defined operational scope.
* Maintain strong adherence to SLAs by prioritizing incidents according to severity and ensuring timely response, resolution, escalation, and communication throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Perform regular operational checks, including server environments, real\-time overlays, security desk systems, PagerDuty alerts, Redis database cron jobs, and other platform health indicators.
* Schedule and coordinate system downtime for updates and maintenance activities while minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.
* Improve platform operations by reducing manual and people\-dependent processes, strengthening automation, and moving recurring workflows toward more reliable and self\-sufficient operation.
* Maintain consistent communication and collaboration with internal and external technical partners, ensuring operational status, incidents, escalations, and required actions are clearly communicated.


**Requirements**
* Have 1–6 years of relevant professional experience in platform engineering, DevOps, backend development, infrastructure operations, or a related technical discipline.
* Demonstrate strong Kubernetes expertise, ideally supported by the Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification or comparable practical knowledge.
* Have hands\-on experience creating and maintaining container infrastructure and scalable Kubernetes environments, including Deployments, Pods, Jobs, StatefulSets, ConfigMaps, Services, NodePort, Ingress, Volumes, and Custom Resource Definitions.
* Be highly proficient with Linux and Docker, including container maintenance, troubleshooting, container logs, health checks, probes, and Linux shell operations.
* Have experience with Helm Charts, multi\-container pod designs using sidecar and init containers, distributed\-system design patterns, and Kubernetes deployment strategies such as blue/green, canary, and rolling updates.
* Demonstrate strong DevOps and CI/CD knowledge, including continuous integration, deployment automation, monitoring, alerting, troubleshooting, and production reliability practices.
* Possess strong Python development skills, including iterators, exception handling, file handling, data types and structures, object\-oriented programming, and production\-grade software development rather than scripting alone.
* Have practical experience with web frameworks such as Flask and Gunicorn, along with strong understanding of software design patterns, database integration, streaming pipelines, and multiprocessing architectures.
* Demonstrate strong Git and GitHub knowledge and experience working with technologies such as Redis and Kafka for data integration or streaming workflows.
* Experience with GStreamer, FFmpeg, and OpenCV for video streaming or image processing is highly valued, along with knowledge of cloud services and hybrid cloud environments.
* Be comfortable troubleshooting complex technical issues, working with operational metrics, following structured incident procedures, and communicating clearly with technical stakeholders.
* Be available to work rotational shifts: Shift A from 6 AM–2 PM IST, Shift B from 2 PM–10 PM IST, or Shift C from 10 PM–6 AM IST, with two consecutive days off each week.
* Be comfortable joining immediately and working remotely from a base location associated with Mumbai, Bangalore, or Trivandrum.


**Benefits**
* Full\-time remote work opportunity based in India, with Mumbai, Bangalore, and Trivandrum identified as base locations.
* Exposure to modern platform engineering technologies including Kubernetes, Docker, Python, CI/CD, cloud services, distributed systems, and production monitoring.
* Opportunity to work on highly scalable infrastructure and contribute to platform stability, automation, reliability, and operational efficiency.
* Hands\-on experience with incident management, deployment strategies, observability, and production\-grade engineering practices.
* A collaborative environment focused on transparency, diversity, integrity, continuous learning, and professional growth.
* Rotational shift schedule with two consecutive days off each week.
* Opportunities to work alongside proactive technical teams and collaborate with partners across a dynamic technology environment.
* The source description does not specify a salary range, healthcare coverage, or additional financial benefits.

 Join a technology\-driven environment where platform reliability, automation, and scalable infrastructure are central to delivering high\-quality digital solutions. In this role, you will help maintain stable and resilient systems while responding proactively to incidents and operational challenges. You will work across Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and backend technologies. The position combines hands\-on troubleshooting with continuous improvements to monitoring, deployment, and support processes. You will collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to meet demanding service levels and minimize operational dependencies. This is an opportunity to deepen your platform engineering expertise while contributing to highly automated, production\-grade environments.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Monitor production environments, system performance, alerts, and operational metrics to maintain stability and meet defined service levels.
* Resolve Tier\-1 incidents using established runbooks, including system restarts, network connectivity checks, model resets, data\-flow checks, alert reprocessing, and other standard fixes.
* Continuously monitor PagerDuty alerts and respond to incidents according to documented procedures, escalating unresolved issues to L2/L3 teams when required.
* Perform regular server and infrastructure checks, including Redis cron jobs, security systems, real\-time overlays, and other operational components.
* Review root\-cause analyses and resolution requests, document incident outcomes, and ensure appropriate follow\-up actions are completed.
* Create, maintain, and execute runbooks for recurring incidents while identifying opportunities to reduce manual intervention and move systems toward greater automation.
* Support SLA management by prioritizing incidents according to severity and ensuring timely response and resolution.

* Troubleshoot Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, networking, and distributed\-system issues across production environments.
* Develop and maintain production\-grade Python applications and services, including web applications, database integrations, and streaming pipelines.
* Support technologies such as Flask, Gunicorn, Redis, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, and Linux shell environments.
* Provide regular daily and weekly reporting on incidents, system performance, service levels, and key operational metrics.
* Coordinate planned system downtime, upgrades, and maintenance activities while minimizing disruption to operations.

**Requirements**

* Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes resources including Deployments, Pods, Jobs, StatefulSets, ConfigMaps, Services, NodePort, Ingress, Volumes, and Custom Resource Definitions.
* Experience creating and maintaining scalable Kubernetes architectures and using Helm Charts to template deployments.
* Knowledge of multi\-container pod architectures, including sidecar and init containers, as well as probes and health checks.
* Strong understanding of CI/CD implementation and deployment strategies such as Blue/Green, Canary, and rolling deployments.

* Experience developing production\-grade Python applications rather than scripts, with knowledge of Flask and Gunicorn.
* Understanding of database integrations and streaming technologies such as Redis and Kafka.
* Experience with multiprocessing architectures and strong Git/GitHub knowledge.
* Familiarity with video streaming and image\-processing technologies such as GStreamer, FFmpeg, and OpenCV is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of cloud services and Linux shell scripting.
* Kubernetes certification such as CKAD is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot incidents methodically and work effectively under operational pressure.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive approach to incident management and stakeholder coordination.

description:
**Cloud Security Analyst (AI Training)**
**About The Role**
 We're partnering with the world's leading AI research teams to build smarter, safer AI systems — and we need practitioners who truly understand how cloud environments fail in the real world.
   

  

 If you've spent time in the trenches of AWS, GCP, or Azure and you know what a misconfigured IAM policy or an exposed storage bucket actually means for a business, this role was built for you. Your expertise will directly shape how AI reasons about cloud security — making these systems more accurate, more realistic, and more useful.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Analyze cloud security scenarios across AWS, GCP, and Azure to identify risks and realistic failure patterns
* Review IAM configurations, network architectures, storage permissions, and container security setups
* Classify security gaps, misconfigurations, and cloud incidents based on real\-world impact and blast radius
* Validate and improve AI\-generated security reasoning so it reflects how cloud incidents actually unfold
* Help build datasets and evaluations that push the frontier of AI security capabilities


**Who You Are**
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience working with cloud environments in production
* Solid understanding of cloud IAM, networking, storage, and container security across major providers
* Familiar with real\-world misconfigurations and how they escalate into incidents
* Able to reason clearly about blast radius, risk exposure, and business impact
* Self\-directed and comfortable working asynchronously on task\-based assignments


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with cloud security tooling (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, AWS Security Hub)
* Background in penetration testing, red teaming, or incident response
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as CIS Benchmarks, SOC 2, or NIST
* Security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CCSP, CISSP, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly on frontier AI systems with top research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule
* Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and global collaboration
* Meaningful work that improves how AI understands real\-world security
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Marketing Executive

About Tightknot

Tightknot is a community\-focused technology platform that connects people, businesses and government within their area.

It brings together local information, news, events, offers, promotions, businesses, community conversations and civic engagement in one platform.

We are looking for a hands\-on Marketing Manager who can build the Tightknot brand and drive user adoption from the ground up.

Role Overview

The Marketing Manager will be responsible for developing and executing Tightknot’s user acquisition, brand, field marketing and community growth strategy.

This is a highly execution\-oriented role. The candidate should be comfortable going into the market, meeting businesses, colleges, associations, influencers and communities, and converting marketing ideas into measurable user growth.

Key Responsibilities

1\. User Acquisition

* Develop strategies to acquire new Tightknot users.
* Drive app installations and active\-user growth.
* Plan area\-wise launch and user\-acquisition campaigns.
* Develop innovative installation campaigns through shops, colleges, events and community partners.
* Track CAC, installations, activation and retention.

2\. Local \& Field Marketing

* Plan and execute campaigns in selected cities, towns and localities.
* Build partnerships with supermarkets, restaurants, retailers, real\-estate companies, associations and other local businesses.
* Create campaigns such as:
* Install Tightknot \& get an instant offer.
* Local business promotional campaigns.
* Community referral campaigns.
* College ambassador programs.
* Local events and activation campaigns.

3\. College \& Youth Marketing

* Build relationships with colleges and student communities.
* Establish a campus ambassador network.
* Organize competitions, hackathons, technology challenges and promotional activities.
* Develop Gen\-Z focused campaigns and content.

4\. Influencer \& Creator Marketing

* Identify and onboard local influencers and content creators.
* Develop influencer campaigns for Tightknot.
* Build city\-wise/locality\-wise creator networks.
* Measure installs and engagement generated by influencers.

5\. Business \& Commercial Marketing

* Work closely with the sales team to create marketing packages for local businesses.
* Develop promotional campaigns for shops and businesses.
* Create attractive offers that encourage users to install and actively use Tightknot.
* Support revenue generation through local advertising and promotional campaigns.

6\. Brand Building

* Develop Tightknot’s brand positioning and communication.
* Manage campaigns across social media, digital, print, radio, outdoor and local events.
* Create campaign concepts around:
* “What’s happening around you?”
* Local news
* Local offers
* Events
* Community
* People helping people

7\. Marketing Analytics

* Track:
* App installations
* Cost per acquisition
* Daily/Monthly active users
* Campaign conversion
* Retention
* Referral growth
* Influencer performance
* Business leads and revenue
* Use data to continuously improve campaigns.

Requirements

* Experience in marketing, growth marketing, consumer apps, startups, FMCG, retail, telecom or similar industries.
* Strong understanding of digital and field marketing.
* Experience in user acquisition and campaign execution.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to build partnerships with businesses, colleges, influencers and associations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel and work in the field.
* Startup mindset – build, test, learn and execute quickly.

Preferred

Experience in:

* Consumer mobile applications
* Social media
* Local commerce
* EdTech/FinTech/Consumer\-tech startups
* College marketing
* Influencer marketing
* Retail marketing
* Community activation

Marketing executive

We are looking for energetic Marketing Executives who can take Tightknot directly into communities and drive app adoption.

Role Overview

The Marketing Executive will be responsible for field marketing, app installations, business onboarding, college outreach, events and community activation.

This is ideal for someone who enjoys meeting people, travelling, creating relationships and working in a fast\-moving startup environment.

Key Responsibilities

1\. App Installation \& User Acquisition

* Visit shops, colleges, residential communities and public locations.
* Explain Tightknot to potential users.
* Drive app installations and registrations.
* Conduct installation campaigns and promotional activities.
* Encourage users to become active users.

2\. Business Onboarding

* Visit local shops and businesses.
* Explain Tightknot’s advertising and promotional opportunities.
* Help businesses create offers and promotions.
* Generate qualified business leads for the sales team.
* Maintain relationships with onboarded businesses.

3\. College Marketing

* Visit colleges and student communities.
* Identify and onboard campus ambassadors.
* Promote Tightknot among students.
* Coordinate college campaigns, competitions and events.

4\. Community Marketing

* Work with apartment associations, resident groups, local associations and community organizations.
* Conduct local activation campaigns.
* Promote Tightknot through events and community activities.

5\. Influencer Outreach

* Identify local influencers and content creators.
* Contact and onboard influencers.
* Coordinate promotional campaigns.
* Track leads and installations generated through campaigns.

6\. Campaign Execution

* Execute marketing campaigns planned by the Marketing Manager.
* Distribute promotional material and QR codes.
* Conduct on\-ground activations.
* Collect customer/user feedback.
* Report campaign results daily.

Daily Activities May Include

* Visit 5–10 businesses per day.
* Approach potential Tightknot users.
* Generate app installations.
* Meet college representatives and students.
* Meet associations and community leaders.
* Onboard businesses.
* Promote active offers and campaigns.
* Submit daily activity and performance reports.

Requirements

* 0–3 years of experience in sales, marketing, field marketing, business development or customer acquisition.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills are welcome.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable speaking with business owners, students and members of the public.
* Willingness to travel locally.
* Basic knowledge of smartphones and social media.
* Self\-motivated and target\-oriented.
* Ability to work independently.

Preferred Skills

* Sales and negotiation
* Digital marketing
* Social media
* College outreach
* Event management
* Field marketing
* Local business development

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote
