title: Human Resources Manager/ Assistant Human Resources Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
HR Manager – Talent Acquisition

**Location:** Corporate Office, Mumbai  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Reporting To:** General Manager – Corporate HR / Senior HR Leadership  
**Scope:** Corporate Office \& Hotels across India

Position Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and result\-oriented **HR Manager – Talent Acquisition** to lead the recruitment function at the Corporate Office and support hiring requirements across all hotels and business units in India.

The role will be responsible for managing the **end\-to\-end recruitment process**, developing talent pipelines, handling critical and leadership\-level positions, partnering with General Managers and Unit HR teams, and ensuring timely closure of vacancies in line with approved manpower budgets.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **hospitality recruitment**, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to source and close quality candidates within defined timelines.

Key Responsibilities1\. Talent Acquisition Strategy

* Develop and execute the overall Talent Acquisition strategy for the group.
* Understand manpower requirements across hotels and Corporate Office and plan recruitment accordingly.
* Develop recruitment strategies for critical, specialized, and hard\-to\-fill positions.
* Build a strong and sustainable talent pipeline for current and future requirements.
* Continuously evaluate and improve recruitment processes, turnaround time, and candidate quality.

2\. End\-to\-End Recruitment

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from **manpower requisition to candidate joining**.
* Handle sourcing, screening, interviewing, salary negotiation, selection, reference checks, documentation, and offer coordination.
* Ensure positions are closed within the agreed recruitment timelines.
* Maintain regular follow\-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience at every stage.

3\. Leadership \& Critical Hiring

* Lead recruitment for **HOD, senior management, corporate, and other critical positions**.
* Partner with GMs, Corporate Heads, and Senior Management to understand leadership requirements.
* Identify and approach passive candidates for senior and niche positions.
* Build a strong database of experienced hospitality professionals for future requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality while handling senior\-level recruitment.

4\. Coordination with Unit HR Teams

* Work closely with Unit HR Managers across all hotels to understand vacancies and manpower requirements.
* Ensure all recruitment requests are properly approved before initiating the hiring process.
* Guide Unit HR teams on recruitment processes, sourcing methods, interview standards, and documentation.
* Monitor recruitment progress and vacancy status across properties.
* Follow up with Unit HR teams and hiring managers for timely feedback and closure.

5\. Recruitment Sources \& Vendor Management

* Develop and maintain effective recruitment channels including:
* Job portals
* LinkedIn
* Employee referrals
* Hospitality institutes
* Recruitment agencies
* Social media
* Internal talent database
* Professional networks
* Manage recruitment consultants and agencies where required.
* Negotiate and monitor recruitment agency terms and performance.
* Evaluate the effectiveness and cost of different recruitment channels.

6\. Campus \& Institute Recruitment

* Develop relationships with hotel management institutes, colleges, and hospitality schools across India.
* Coordinate campus recruitment drives for freshers, trainees, and management development programs.
* Build a pipeline of young hospitality talent for future requirements.
* Coordinate internship and management trainee recruitment where applicable.

7\. Employer Branding

* Support and develop the organization's employer branding initiatives.
* Promote career opportunities through LinkedIn, social media, job portals, and other platforms.
* Create attractive and professional job advertisements.
* Highlight career growth, learning opportunities, employee benefits, and organizational culture.
* Strengthen the company's presence among hospitality professionals and potential candidates.

8\. Recruitment MIS \& Analytics

* Maintain accurate recruitment dashboards and MIS.
* Track:
* Total vacancies
* Open positions
* Positions closed
* Time\-to\-fill
* Source of hire
* Candidate pipeline
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio
* Recruitment cost
* Agency performance
* Position\-wise recruitment status
* Present regular recruitment reports to Corporate HR leadership.
* Identify recruitment trends and recommend corrective actions.

9\. Manpower Planning \& Budget Coordination

* Coordinate with Corporate HR, Unit HR, GMs, and Finance regarding approved manpower requirements.
* Ensure recruitment is aligned with approved manpower budgets.
* Monitor vacancies against sanctioned positions.
* Avoid recruitment outside approved manpower plans without appropriate authorization.
* Support workforce planning for new hotel openings, expansions, and business requirements.

10\. Interview \& Selection Process

* Establish structured recruitment and interview processes.
* Conduct initial screening and competency\-based interviews for relevant positions.
* Coordinate interviews with GMs, HODs, Corporate Heads, and Senior Management.
* Ensure proper interview feedback is received within defined timelines.
* Maintain candidate evaluation records and recruitment documentation.

11\. Offer \& Joining Management

* Coordinate salary discussions and offer approvals.
* Ensure offers are released only after the required internal approvals.
* Coordinate pre\-employment documentation and background/reference checks where applicable.
* Track candidates from offer acceptance until joining.
* Identify reasons for offer dropouts and improve offer\-to\-joining conversion.

12\. Talent Pool \& Database Management

* Develop and maintain a centralized talent database for hospitality professionals.
* Create talent pools for key functions such as:
* Front Office
* Food \& Beverage
* Food Production
* Housekeeping
* Engineering
* Finance
* Sales \& Marketing
* Human Resources
* IT
* Corporate functions
* Maintain a pipeline of potential candidates for recurring and future requirements.

13\. New Hotel / Pre\-Opening Recruitment

* Lead recruitment planning for new hotel openings and business expansions.
* Prepare recruitment timelines and manpower hiring plans.
* Coordinate bulk recruitment drives where required.
* Ensure critical positions are closed well ahead of the opening date.
* Work closely with the pre\-opening team and property leadership.

14\. Recruitment Process Improvement

* Regularly review recruitment processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Improve recruitment turnaround time and candidate quality.
* Introduce structured interview and assessment processes.
* Explore technology and recruitment tools to improve sourcing and tracking.
* Develop standard recruitment SOPs and guidelines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The HR Manager – Talent Acquisition will be measured on:

* Vacancy closure within defined timelines.
* Quality of hires.
* Time\-to\-fill.
* Offer\-to\-joining ratio.
* Recruitment cost per hire.
* Candidate retention after joining.
* Effectiveness of recruitment sources.
* Leadership and critical\-position closure.
* Hiring against approved manpower budgets.
* Recruitment MIS accuracy and timeliness.
* Agency/vendor performance.
* Candidate experience.
* Talent pipeline strength.

Candidate ProfileEducation

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* Hotel Management qualification will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **8–12 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment**, preferably within the hospitality industry.
* Experience handling recruitment across **multiple hotels/properties or a large organization**.
* Experience in hiring HODs, senior management, corporate positions, and operational hospitality roles.
* Strong experience in LinkedIn recruitment, job portals, direct sourcing, and recruitment agencies.

Required Skills

* Strong end\-to\-end recruitment expertise.
* Excellent sourcing and headhunting skills.
* Strong knowledge of hospitality talent markets.
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Strong networking and relationship\-building abilities.
* Good knowledge of recruitment technology and HRMS/ATS.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet aggressive recruitment deadlines.

Key Competencies

* Talent Acquisition
* Strategic Sourcing
* Stakeholder Management
* Interview \& Selection
* Negotiation
* Candidate Experience
* Employer Branding
* Recruitment Analytics
* Team Management
* Problem Solving

We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**


  

The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


**Job Purpose:**


  

To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**


  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations**

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence**

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management**

* Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance**

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security**

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility**

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.

**Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation**

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

**Team Collaboration**

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**


  

**Education**:


* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

**Experience**:

* Fresher or up to **2 years** of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* Minimum age **18 years.**
* Valid **Two\-Wheeler** or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Skills \& Capabilities:**


  

**Technical Skills:**

* Pickup \& Delivery Operations
* Shipment Handling
* Cash Collection (COD)
* Proof of Delivery (POD)
* Mobile Device / Scanner Usage
* Route Familiarity
* Basic Computer \& Mobile Application Skills
* Basic English Reading \& Understanding

**Key Competencies:**

* Customer Focus
* Integrity
* Reliability
* Safety Consciousness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time Management
* Accountability
* Positive Attitude
* Professional Appearance


**Key Performance Indicators:**


  

**KRAs**

  

**KPIs**

  

  

Delivery \& Pickup Performance

  

On\-Time Delivery • Pickup Adherence • Delivery Productivity

  

  

Service Quality

  

First Attempt Delivery • Shipment Handling Accuracy • Customer Satisfaction

  

  

COD \& Documentation

  

COD Collection Accuracy • POD Completion • Zero Documentation Errors

  

  

Safety \& Compliance

  

Safe Driving • SOP Adherence • Uniform \& Grooming Compliance

  

  

Operational Productivity

  

Shipments Delivered/Picked Up • Scanner Compliance • Route Efficiency


  

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**


  

When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.


Here’s what makes us stand out:

* **Great Place to Work® Certified**—a testament to our people\-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well\-being.
* **Competitive pay** and performance\-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, **global exposure**, and on\-the\-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* **Best\-in\-class benefits**—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates **diversity, innovation, and bold thinking**—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* **Global career paths** across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220\+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with **India’s most awarded logistics brand**, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work. **Come grow with us.**

**Disclaimer:**  

At Blue Dart Express Limited, all recruitment is conducted through a fair, transparent, and merit\-based process aligned with our commitments to Human Rights and Diversity, Equity, Inclusion \& Belonging (DEIB).


Blue Dart does not request or accept any fees, deposits, or payments from candidates at any stage of the recruitment or onboarding process. Any such request is fraudulent and unauthorized.


Blue Dart shall not be responsible for any loss arising from such fraudulent activity. For verification, candidates may write to bdjobs@bluedart.com.

**Shipment Processing \& Operations*** Receive, segregate, sort and process inbound and outbound shipments accurately.

* Ensure timely movement of shipments through various operational stages to meet defined service commitments.
* Assist in shipment reconciliation and manifest verification activities.

* Support peak volume operations and contingency requirements.
* Ensure operational workstations remain organised and ready for processing activities.
* Perform additional operational tasks as assigned by the reporting manager.

* Adhere to Blue Dart's safety, security and quality standards at all times.
* Handle customer shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Report unsafe conditions, operational incidents or security concerns immediately.
* Ensure proper usage of personal protective equipment (PPE) wherever applicable.

* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.

* Participate in operational briefings, safety meetings and training programmes.
* Share ideas for improving operational efficiency and workplace safety.
* Support implementation of new operational processes and initiatives.
* Contribute towards maintaining a positive and productive work environment.

**Education**:
* Minimum **10th Standard Pass**.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.

* Positive attitude, willingness to learn and ability to work in a team environment.

description:

 This is a high\-visibility customer\-facing role supporting an enterprise AI platform designed to transform supply chain decision\-making.
   

  

 You will resolve Level 1 and Level 2 customer issues while developing deep expertise across a technically sophisticated SaaS environment.
   

  

 The role combines hands\-on troubleshooting with opportunities to improve support processes, documentation, automation, and knowledge management.
   

  

 You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Content, and Customer\-facing teams to ensure issues are resolved accurately and efficiently.
   

  

 As part of a 12\-month rotational program, you will gain broad exposure to Customer Success, Professional Services, and AI\-focused support.
   

  

 The position is ideal for a curious, analytical professional who enjoys solving complex problems and turning recurring challenges into scalable solutions.
   

  

 It also provides a strong foundation for future growth into technical, customer\-facing, and professional services roles within a high\-growth technology environment.
   

  

 Accountabilities
   

  

* Handle Level 1 and Level 2 customer support tickets, investigating issues and delivering accurate, timely, and structured resolutions.
* Develop strong platform expertise to troubleshoot increasingly complex customer questions with precision and confidence.
* Communicate clearly with customers, translating technical concepts and findings into accessible, professional responses.
* Monitor support requests for recurring issues, trends, and patterns that could indicate opportunities for product, process, or documentation improvements.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support activities and help develop scalable workflows that improve efficiency and customer experience.
* Create, maintain, and improve knowledge resources, documentation, and support processes to make issue resolution more consistent.

* Take ownership of customer issues from initial investigation through resolution, escalation, and follow\-up when required.

* Demonstrated ability to investigate and resolve complex technical issues accurately, efficiently, and with a strong customer focus.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to provide structured responses and translate technical information into clear, accessible language.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, combined with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
* Proactive mindset with the ability to identify recurring problems and recommend scalable solutions through automation, documentation, or workflow improvements.
* Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with Engineering, Product, Content, and other cross\-functional teams.

* Familiarity with AI\-powered tools and technologies is an advantage.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.

description:
**About Chargebee:** 




 Chargebee is a subscription billing and revenue management platform powering some of the fastest\-growing brands around the world today, including Lambda.ai, Zapier, Condé Nast, Pret\-a\-Manger, Freshworks, Okta, Study.com, and others. Thousands of SaaS and subscription\-first businesses process billions of dollars in revenue every year through the Chargebee platform.
 



 Headquartered in San Francisco, USA, our 1000\+ team members work remotely throughout the world, including India, the Netherlands, Paris, Spain, Australia, and the USA.
 



 Chargebee has raised over $480 million in capital and is funded by Accel, Tiger Global, Insight Partners, Sequoia Capital, Steadview Capital, and Sapphire Ventures. And we’re on a mission to push the boundaries of subscription revenue operations. Not just ours, but every customer and prospective business on a recurring revenue model.
 



**Advanced Solutions Engineer** 




  





**Role Summary** 




 Advanced Solutions Engineer acts as the critical bridge between Customer Success and Core Engineering. You are a
 **code\-literate investigator** 
 responsible for diagnosing complex architectural issues, identifying root causes in the codebase, and ensuring high\-severity incidents are resolved. This is a role for a developer who loves the "puzzle" of debugging more than the "construction" of new features.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Deep\-Dive Debugging:** 
 Go beyond log analysis; navigate the Java/J2EE source code to pinpoint logic flaws or integration bottlenecks.
* **Incident Triage:** 
 Lead the technical response for High\-Priority/Severity incidents, providing real\-time updates and technical workarounds.
* **API \& Integration Mastery:** 
 Troubleshoot third\-party ecosystem failures (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.) by analyzing REST API payloads and authentication flows.
* **Documentation \& Tooling:** 
 Build internal diagnostic tools or scripts and author "Root Cause Analysis" (RCA) reports to prevent recurring issues.
* **Knowledge Transfer:** 
 Mentor front\-line support teams and translate complex engineering fixes into digestible knowledge base articles.
* **Operational Readiness:** 
 Participate in a 24/7 rotational shift schedule to ensure global platform stability.



  





**Technical Requirements** 



* **Experience:** 
 1–3 years in Technical Support, Sustaining Engineering, or Software Development.
* **Core Programming:** 
 Proficiency in
 **Java** 
 is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong coding skills in
 **Python, Go** 
 who are willing to pivot to a Java environment.
* **Web Stack:** 
 Strong grasp of HTML5, CSS, and modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue).
* **Data \& APIs:** 
 Expert level in
 **SQL** 
 (complex joins/query optimization) and deep familiarity with
 **RESTful APIs** 
 and JSON/XML.
* **Observability:** 
 Hands\-on experience with logging and monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, ELK Stack, Datadog, New Relic).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* **The Dev Edge:** 
 2\+ years of professional Software Development experience.
* **SaaS Background:** 
 Experience supporting multi\-tenant cloud environments.
* **Domain Expertise:** 
 Prior experience managing complex integrations with Financial (NetSuite/Xero) or CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) platforms.



  





**What makes us who we are:** 




 \-
 **We are Globally Local** 
 : With a diverse team across four continents and customers in over 60 countries, you get to work closely with a global perspective right from your own neighborhood.
 



  





 \-
 **We value Curiosity** 
 : We believe the next great idea might just be around the corner. Perhaps it’s that random thought you had ten minutes ago. We believe in creating an ecosystem that fosters a desire to seek out hard questions, figure out answers to them, and foster a continuous learning environment
 



  





 \-

 : Everything we do is driven towards enabling our customers’ growth. This means no matter what you do, you will always be adding real value to a real business problem. It’s a lot of responsibility, but also a lot of fun.
 



 If you resonate with Chargebee, have a deep intellectual curiosity, and an insatiable urge to learn and build new things, we’re waiting for you!
 



 We value people from all backgrounds and are dedicated to hiring and employing a diverse and inclusive workplace.
 



  





**Come be a part of the Chargebee tribe!**

* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.

 Most backend roles ask you to build dashboards and CRUD APIs. This one is different.
 



  





 You will be working on a mission\-critical Workforce Management Platform deployed in
 



 high\-security, access\-controlled environments, where the software directly governs who
 



 enters, who is tracked, and who is accountable at any given moment. The system
 



 integrates with physical infrastructure: biometric devices, RFID systems, IP cameras,
 



 RTSP streams, face recognition engines, and access control hardware. When it works, it
 



 is invisible. When it doesn't, operations stop.
 



  





 This is a live, production platform used in demanding operational environments. You
 



 will be enhancing and scaling it, not greenfielding, which means your decisions carry
 



 real consequences for real deployments.
 



  





 You will work directly with a founding team member. No layers, no ticket queues. Fast
 



 decisions, high ownership.

* Backend services and business logic in Node.js and TypeScript
* REST API design, enhancement, and reliability at scale
* Integrations with hardware and real\-world device ecosystems — RFID, biometrics, IP cameras, RTSP streams, face recognition, and access control systems
* Database architecture and query performance on MySQL
* Containerised deployment and environment management via Docker
* Diagnosing and resolving integration and production issues — you are the last line of defence
* Occasional frontend contributions where the backend\-frontend boundary



 demands it

**Must\-have** 



* 4\+ years of backend or backend\-heavy full stack development
* Production\-grade Node.js and TypeScript, not tutorials, actual shipped systems
* REST API design experience at scale
* Strong MySQL — schema design, query optimisation, not just ORM usage
* Docker and containerised environments
* A genuine instinct for debugging — you find things others miss



  





**Strong advantage** 



* Prior work with hardware integrations — RFID, biometrics, CCTV/IP cameras, RTSP, IoT, or access control systems

 You are not looking for a role where requirements are handed to you fully formed. You
 



 want to understand the system end to end, take ownership of hard problems, and see
 



 your work running in production environments where it genuinely matters. You are
 



 comfortable with ambiguity, rigorous under pressure, and faster than average at figuring
 



 things out.
 



  





**Why Cidroy** 




 Cidroy builds software for environments where failure is not an option — defence\-adjacent, industrial, and high\-security deployments across India. You will be working on systems that interact with the physical world, not just the browser. The founding team is technical, the feedback loop is short, and the problems are real.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable speaking with **School Principals, Directors, Administrators and Management**, understand their operational challenges, and be capable of converting qualified school leads into customers.

* Understand and address basic objections and concerns.
* Coordinate internally to resolve product or commercial queries.
* Maintain a clear pipeline of **Lead → Qualified → Demo → Proposal → Negotiation → Closed**.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying schools.

4\. School Onboarding Coordination

* Coordinate with the internal team once a school confirms.
* Ensure required information and documents are collected from the school.
* Maintain communication with the school until the service is successfully initiated.
* Hand over the account properly to the relevant implementation/support team.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Confident and articulate on phone calls**
* Comfortable speaking with senior school authorities
* Persistent with follow\-ups without being pushy
* Good at understanding customer problems rather than simply pitching a product
* Strong in relationship building
* Comfortable with **B2B sales**
* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated
* Organized in maintaining lead and follow\-up records
* Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, Google Sheets/CRM and basic sales tools

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* School ERP / EdTech sales
* SaaS sales
* B2B sales
* Education\-sector sales
* Selling services to schools
* Inside sales / tele\-sales
* Banking, insurance or other consultative sales roles

**Freshers with excellent communication and strong sales aptitude may also be considered.**

The candidate will be evaluated primarily on:

**Activity**

* Outbound calls
* New schools contacted
* Decision\-makers connected

**Pipeline**

* Qualified leads generated
* Demos/meetings scheduled
* Proposals shared
* Active opportunities

**Conversion**

* Schools converted
* Conversion rate
* Revenue generated
* Customer acquisition cost

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a passive telecalling job where the executive simply makes calls from a list.

The Sales Executive will be expected to **own the sales cycle from first contact to conversion**, including understanding the school's requirement, maintaining the relationship, following up, handling objections and coordinating the closure.

**Exodus Tech** is a software technology company focused on building practical digital products and software solutions for businesses.

Our products include:

* **Billing Software**
* **Gym Management Software**
* **E\-commerce Software**

We are a growing, remote\-first technology company looking for a motivated **Tech Sales Executive / Business Development Executive** who can take ownership of the complete sales process.

About the Role

We are looking for a **sales\-oriented, confident and hardworking person** who is willing to actively generate business for Exodus Tech.

This is **not just a lead\-generation position**.

The selected candidate will be responsible for the complete sales cycle:

**Lead Generation → Cold Calling → Cold DM → Customer Discussion → Product Demo → Follow\-up → Negotiation → Closing → Sale**

The position is primarily **Work From Home**, but occasional customer visits may be required when a business owner has an urgent requirement, requests an in\-person meeting, or when a face\-to\-face meeting can help close an important sales opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate new business leads through online research, cold calling and social media.

* Contact potential customers through WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email and other channels.
* Speak directly with business owners and decision\-makers.
* Understand customer requirements and business problems.
* Explain our software products and their benefits.
* Arrange and conduct online product demonstrations.
* Follow up consistently with interested prospects.
* Prepare and share quotations/proposals when required.
* Handle customer questions and sales objections.
* Negotiate within company guidelines.
* Convert prospects into paying customers.
* Take ownership of the sales process until the deal is closed.
* Maintain accurate lead and follow\-up records.
* Achieve assigned sales and activity targets.
* Provide feedback about customer requirements and market demand.

Customer Meetings

This is primarily a **Work From Home / Remote position**.

However, the candidate must be comfortable with **occasional local customer meetings**.

For example, the candidate may need to meet a business owner when:

* The customer has an urgent requirement.
* The prospect requests a face\-to\-face meeting.
* An important/high\-value sales opportunity requires an in\-person discussion.
* An in\-person product demonstration is required.
* A customer meeting can significantly improve the chance of closing the deal.

**Regular office attendance is not required. This is not a regular field\-sales position.**

Products

The candidate will learn and sell Exodus Tech's software products, including:

Billing Software

Business billing, invoicing and management solutions.

Gym Management Software

Solutions for managing gym members, memberships, attendance, payments and daily operations.

E\-commerce Software

Solutions for businesses looking to establish and manage their online selling operations.

Future Products

As Exodus Tech launches new software products, the candidate will also be expected to learn and sell those products.

**Product training will be provided.**

Freshers Welcome

**Freshers are encouraged to apply.**

Previous software\-sales experience is not mandatory.

We are primarily looking for someone with:

* Good communication skills
* Confidence
* Willingness to make cold calls
* Strong follow\-up ability
* Interest in sales
* Ability to learn software products
* Target\-oriented mindset
* Ability to handle rejection
* Self\-discipline while working from home

Candidates with experience in **telecalling, inside sales, business development, lead generation, SaaS sales, IT sales or B2B sales** are also welcome.

Work From Home Requirements

The candidate should have:

* Laptop or desktop
* Reliable internet connection
* Smartphone
* WhatsApp
* Quiet environment for professional calls
* Basic computer knowledge
* Ability to attend online meetings
* Ability to work independently

Compensation

**₹10,000 per month \+ Performance\-Based Incentives**

The role is highly performance\-oriented.

Additional incentives will be provided for successful sales based on the company's incentive structure.

Sales targets, performance expectations and incentive terms will be clearly explained during the selection process and documented in the employment terms.

Performance Expectations

The candidate is expected to consistently work on:

**Daily Prospecting → Cold Calls → Cold DMs → Qualified Leads → Product Demos → Follow\-ups → Sales**

Performance may be evaluated based on:

* Number of quality prospects generated
* Outbound calls
* Meaningful customer conversations
* Qualified leads
* Product demonstrations
* Follow\-ups
* Proposals
* Successful conversions
* Revenue generated

The ultimate goal is **not simply to make calls — it is to generate customers and revenue for Exodus Tech.**

Career Growth

High\-performing employees will have opportunities to grow with the company.

Possible career progression:

**Tech Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Senior Tech Sales Executive**  
↓  
**Business Development Executive**  
↓  
**Sales Team Leader**  
↓  
**Sales Manager**

Performance\-based increases in compensation and incentives may also be provided as the company grows.

Required SkillsMust Have

* Sales
* Lead Generation
* Cold Calling
* Business Development
* Communication Skills
* Customer Handling
* Follow\-up
* Basic Computer Skills
* Willingness to Learn

Good to Have

* SaaS Sales
* IT Sales
* B2B Sales
* Telecalling
* Inside Sales
* WhatsApp Business
* LinkedIn Outreach
* CRM
* Negotiation
* Product Demonstration

Who Should Apply?

This position is ideal for someone who is willing to:

**Find prospects → Make calls → Start conversations → Understand problems → Explain software → Conduct demos → Follow up → Close deals.**

If you are a fresher with strong communication skills and a serious interest in sales, you are welcome to apply.

Who Should Not Apply?

Please do not apply if you:

* Are uncomfortable with cold calling.
* Do not want sales targets.
* Do not want to speak with business owners.
* Do not want to follow up with prospects.
* Are looking for a non\-target\-based/passive role.

Important

You will be expected to actively generate business through:

**Cold Calls \+ Cold DMs \+ Lead Generation \+ Product Demos \+ Follow\-ups \+ Customer Meetings \+ Closing**

We are looking for someone who is **hungry to learn, comfortable with rejection, consistent with daily outreach and focused on generating real sales.**

Apply Now

title: Technical Product Manager(AI Products)
description:
**About the Job** 




**Experience Required:** 
 4\-5 years of overall professional experience, including 2\-3 years in a product\-facing role (Product Manager, Associate PM, Product Analyst, or similar). Prior B2B/enterprise product experience is a plus.
 



**About the Role** 




 We're looking for a versatile, product\-minded professional to join our AI product team. This role blends light program operations with substantial product responsibility. You’ll help ensure execution runs smoothly day\-to\-day, but your primary focus will be developing product judgment: understanding users, defining what to build, and using data to make decisions. Over time, your scope will grow into full ownership of product areas within our AI offerings, with mentorship and support along the way.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner closely with product leadership to understand customer needs, market context, and the unique considerations of building AI\-driven products
* Help define and refine product requirements, working with design and engineering to translate ideas into shippable features
* Own analytics for assigned product areas : defining success metrics, building dashboards, and using data to identify opportunities and risks
* Evaluate AI/model behavior from a product lens : understanding accuracy, edge cases, customer trust, and where the product needs guardrails or improvements
* Conduct or support user/customer research, gather feedback, and synthesize insights into actionable product decisions
* Help prioritize the roadmap using frameworks like RICE or JTBD, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and business goals
* Collaborate with sales, customer success, and account teams (where relevant) to understand client pain points and translate them into product requirements
* Maintain light program coordination as needed : tracking key deliverables, flagging risks, and keeping cross\-functional stakeholders aligned
* Take ownership of product areas or features with increasing autonomy as scope expands
* Stay current on AI product trends, competitor offerings, and emerging best practices in building with AI/ML



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 4\-5 years of overall professional experience, with 2\-3 years specifically in product management or product\-adjacent roles
* Strong analytical mindset, comfortable with data, spreadsheets, SQL, and drawing insights from numbers
* Technical fluency: able to understand AI/ML systems, read technical docs, and communicate credibly with engineers and data scientists
* Demonstrated product thinking \- track record of defining requirements, prioritizing roadmaps, and making tradeoffs
* Genuine interest in AI products specifically, curiosity about how models behave, where they fail, and how to design around those limitations
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* High ownership mentality \- proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, doesn't wait to be told what to do



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Prior experience in B2B/enterprise product management : understanding of multiple stakeholders, longer sales cycles, and enterprise requirements (security, compliance, integrations, etc.)
* Prior exposure to analytics or product tools (Looker, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Figma, etc.)
* Experience or projects related to AI/ML products specifically
* Experience in a startup or fast\-paced environment requiring wearing multiple hats
* Familiarity with product management frameworks (e.g., JTBD, RICE prioritization)



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Someone with solid product fundamentals who's excited to specialize in the AI space which means understanding not just "what users want" but "what's possible and trustworthy with AI today." B2B experience is a strong plus, but we care most about product judgment and analytical rigor.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**Role:** 

 Software Development Engineer (SDE) – Frontend Focused
 




**Location:** 

 Hyderabad, India \- Onsite
 




**Type:** 

 Full time, Paid
 




  





**Minimum requirements:** 

 You have at least 1–2 years of production frontend experience, you have shipped scalable React / TypeScript (Next.js preferred) interfaces, and you can point us to live, deployed products that show your UI craft \- not only a repository.
 




  





**Who We Are** 





 Steps AI is a product company building intelligent, AI\-powered software for modern businesses. We design and ship production systems that combine strong user experience, reliable backends, and data\-driven intelligence. We work with real customers, deploy to both cloud and on\-premises environments, and move from prototype to production with a high bar for security, access control, and operational quality.
 




  






 We are growing, shipping every week, and looking for engineers who can own a problem end to end \- interface, API, data, security, and deployment \- rather than a single layer of the stack.
 




  





**The Role** 





 We are hiring a Frontend\-focused SDE to own the quality of the product experience: structure, visual clarity, interaction, and performance. You will spend most of your time on the interface, but you will not throw work over the wall. You will integrate with real APIs, respect authentication and role\-based visibility, and help take a working demo to a polished, deployable product.
 




  






 You will work with full\-stack peers on the API and data model. You should be comfortable reading backend contracts, flagging when the UI needs a different API shape, and making design decisions when there is no finished Figma file.
 




  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**Core Frontend Development** 



* Build production\-grade applications using React, TypeScript, and modern CSS (Tailwind or equivalent). Next.js (App Router) is strongly preferred.
* Create reusable components and a consistent design language: type, spacing, density, and interaction states.
* Implement application shells, navigation, filters, tables, forms, and empty / error / loading states that hold up in daily use.
* Optimize performance: code\-splitting, list virtualization where needed, caching, and careful rendering.
* Ship responsive, accessible interfaces across common devices and browsers.



  





**Product UI \- Dashboards and Workflows** 



* Build complex operational UIs: dashboards, data\-heavy tables, charts, and interactive workflows.
* Implement map or location\-aware views when the product needs them, with clear legend, hover, and drill\-through behaviour.
* Build AI\-assisted surfaces when required (chat or assistant panels, streaming text, citations, structured actions) without sacrificing clarity.
* Ensure every view respects role\-based visibility: what a user can see and click must match their permissions.



  





**Design Responsibility** 



* Translate requirements and rough sketches into a coherent interface. Pixel\-perfect when a design exists; disciplined taste when it does not.
* Own visual consistency across the product. You are accountable for the look and feel, not only for “making it work”.
* Use industry\-standard UI tools (Figma or equivalent) to communicate proposals when that saves engineering time.
* Raise issues early when a workflow is confusing, overcrowded, or unsafe (for example, a destructive action without confirmation).



  





**APIs, Auth, and Working With the Rest of the Stack** 



* Integrate with REST APIs from Node or Python services. Handle pagination, errors, and stale data correctly.
* Work with session or JWT authentication and render the product differently by role without leaking privileged UI.
* Use TanStack Query (or equivalent) for server state and a small, explicit store for client state.
* Partner with backend engineers on contract changes. You should be able to read an OpenAPI spec or a FastAPI router and reason about it.
* Contribute to the last mile of deployment: environment\-specific configuration, build pipelines, and verifying the UI on staging and on\-premises installs.



  





**Engineering Quality** 



* Write maintainable TypeScript. Prefer explicit types and small components over large files.
* Participate in code review and keep the frontend testable (component tests and critical\-path E2E).
* Instrument the UI enough to debug production issues (meaningful errors, not silent empty screens).
* Travel occasionally to client or on\-premises locations in Hyderabad for UAT, go\-live support, or on\-site reviews.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's in Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–2\+ years of production frontend experience (more is welcome).
* Strong React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
* Confidence with CSS layout and a utility or design\-token approach (Tailwind or equivalent).
* Experience integrating authenticated APIs and handling real\-world data, not only mock JSON.
* A portfolio that shows visual judgement: spacing, hierarchy, and polish you personally shipped.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Hyderabad and to travel to client or on\-premises sites as required.



  





**Location, Work Mode, and Travel** 





 This is a full\-time, on\-site role in Hyderabad, India. You will work in person with the engineering team.
 





 Occasional travel is required. This includes travel to on\-premises deployment locations and travel to client sites in Hyderabad for implementation, go\-live, reviews, or production support. Travel is typically short\-duration and planned; willingness to travel within Hyderabad (and occasionally nearby) is a condition of the role.
 
 ﻿
 





  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive salary with a clear growth path. Add salary range at posting.
* High\-ownership work: you will influence architecture, security, and how the product is shipped.
* Exposure to AI\-assisted products, enterprise\-grade access control, and real production deployments.
* Fast execution cycles and a culture that values demonstrated capability over credentials alone.
* Learning budget for courses and certifications.
* Collaborative in\-office engineering culture in Hyderabad.

That’s where you come in.

We’re looking for an Android Developer who’s passionate about building high performance apps and learning fast.


You’ll work with our product and engineering teams to create smooth, scalable, and intuitive experiences that bring grassroots cricket closer to the digital world.


###### **Your mission?**
Turn everyday matches into unforgettable experiences, powered by clean code and creative problem solving.

* Fresher with a strong interest in Android development.

description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a iOS Developer based in India.**
 This role offers the opportunity to build high\-quality iOS applications that support engaging, customer\-centric digital travel experiences.
   

  

 You will design and develop mobile solutions used by a global customer base while considering both universal needs and regional nuances.
   

  

 The position combines hands\-on development with close collaboration across product, design, and other technical teams.
   

  

 You will contribute to new features while continuously improving application performance, reliability, security, and usability.
   

  

 The role provides an environment where developers can explore emerging technologies, improve engineering practices, and solve complex technical challenges.
   

  

 You will have ownership of impactful features and help shape scalable, maintainable mobile products from development through deployment.
   

  

 This is a collaborative opportunity for an iOS professional who values clean code, thoughtful architecture, strong user experiences, and continuous learning.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* iOS Application Development: Design and build advanced applications for the iOS platform, delivering reliable and engaging mobile experiences aligned with product and customer needs.
* Feature Delivery: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define, design, develop, and ship new features while taking ownership of assigned functionality and product outcomes.
* Codebase Improvement: Maintain and continuously improve the existing codebase, applying sound engineering practices and supporting effective continuous integration and deployment strategies.
* Performance and Quality: Identify and resolve bugs while improving application performance, responsiveness, stability, and overall quality across supported devices and use cases.
* Integrations: Integrate third\-party libraries and APIs to ensure seamless application functionality and reliable connections with external services.
* User Experience: Partner with design teams to implement strong UI/UX practices and create intuitive, usable, and visually polished mobile interfaces.
* Security: Identify and address security vulnerabilities while contributing to a secure application environment and maintaining appropriate development practices.
* Technology Evolution: Stay current with mobile development trends, architectural approaches, frameworks, and emerging technologies, evaluating and implementing improvements that can increase development efficiency.


**Requirements**
* Professional Experience: 2–6 years of overall software design and development experience, including at least 2 years of hands\-on mobile development experience.
* Swift and iOS: Strong practical experience building mobile applications with Swift, along with a solid understanding of iOS design principles, development patterns, and best practices.
* Architecture: Good knowledge of architectural patterns such as MVVM and MVP, with proven ability to build modular and scalable application architectures.
* Dependency Management: Experience using CocoaPods for dependency management within iOS applications.
* Testing and Code Quality: Strong commitment to clean, readable, flexible, and maintainable code, with experience using testing strategies such as unit and snapshot testing.
* Mobile Design Patterns: Understanding of common mobile development patterns, including dependency injection, observers, and other approaches that support robust application design.
* User\-Centric Mindset: Strong appreciation for user interaction, usability, and interface quality, with the ability to translate design principles into polished mobile experiences.
* Ownership and Problem\-Solving: Ability to take ownership of development initiatives, think critically about implementation decisions, and drive the delivery of meaningful and impactful features.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working as part of a collaborative technical team, sharing knowledge, exploring new technologies, and contributing to solutions for complex engineering challenges.
* Growth Mindset: Genuine enthusiasm for software development and a willingness to continuously improve frameworks, processes, technical skills, and engineering practices.


**Benefits**
* Hybrid Work: Flexible hybrid arrangement combining work from home and office\-based collaboration.
* Annual Leave: 26 calendar days of annual leave.
* Health Insurance: Health insurance coverage as part of the benefits package.
* Paid Maternity Leave: Six months of paid maternity leave.
* Paid Paternity Leave: 15 days of paid paternity leave.
* Career and Technical Growth: Opportunity to work on innovative digital products, explore emerging technologies, and collaborate with experienced technical and cross\-functional teams.
* Global Environment: Exposure to international customers, products, and teams within a growing global organization.

 Company: Crossing Infotech
 



 Job Type: Full\-time Internship
 



 Work Mode: Virtual / Remote
 



 Location: India
 



 Internship Duration: 1–3 months
 



 Stipend: ₹16,500/month
 



 Application Deadline: 20 September 2026
 



  





 About the opportunity
 



  





 Crossing Infotech is offering a Healthcare Data Analyst Internship for freshers and entry\-level candidates interested in healthcare data, analytics, reporting, SQL, Excel, and business intelligence.
 



  





 This internship provides practical exposure to healthcare data\-analysis workflows through structured datasets, reporting assignments, data validation, dashboard preparation, and operational analysis under appropriate guidance. The role focuses on data and reporting activities and does not involve diagnosing patients or making clinical decisions.
 



  





 Key responsibilities
 



  





 • Collect, organize, and prepare assigned healthcare\-related datasets for analysis.
 



 • Clean and validate structured healthcare data using Excel and other tools.
 



 • Write basic SQL queries to retrieve and analyze data.
 



 • Prepare recurring healthcare and operational reports.
 



 • Create dashboards and visual summaries using Power BI or similar tools.
 



 • Analyze trends, patterns, and key performance indicators in healthcare datasets.
 



 • Identify missing, duplicate, or inconsistent data.
 



 • Perform basic data\-quality and reconciliation checks.
 



 • Maintain data trackers, reporting templates, and documentation.
 



 • Assist with healthcare operations and performance analysis.
 



 • Prepare charts, tables, and summaries for internal reporting.
 



 • Document analytical findings and observations clearly.
 



 • Support data requests from relevant internal teams.
 



 • Follow established data\-handling and confidentiality procedures.
 



 • Participate in quality reviews and process\-improvement activities.
 



  





 Who can apply
 



  





 • Freshers and recent graduates.
 



 • Candidates pursuing or having completed B.Sc., BCA, B.Tech, B.E., B.Com, Statistics, Mathematics, Life Sciences, Healthcare Management, Data Science, or related programs.
 



 • Candidates interested in healthcare analytics and data\-driven operations.
 



 • Candidates with academic or personal data\-analysis projects.
 



  





 Required skills
 



  





 • Basic knowledge of Excel or Google Sheets.
 



 • Basic understanding of SQL.
 



 • Good analytical and numerical ability.
 



 • Attention to detail and data accuracy.
 



 • Basic understanding of data cleaning and validation.
 



 • Ability to work with structured datasets.
 



 • Good written and verbal communication.
 



 • Willingness to learn healthcare data and reporting processes.
 



  





 Preferred skills
 



  





 • Familiarity with Power BI.
 



 • Knowledge of Excel formulas and PivotTables.
 



 • Understanding of SQL joins, filtering, grouping, and aggregation.
 



 • Basic knowledge of statistics.
 



 • Familiarity with healthcare data concepts.
 



 • Basic knowledge of Python and Pandas is an advantage.
 



 • Experience with academic analytics or healthcare\-related projects.
 



 • Familiarity with data visualization.
 



  





 What you will learn
 



  





 • Healthcare data\-analysis fundamentals.
 



 • Healthcare reporting and KPI analysis.
 



 • Data cleaning and validation techniques.
 



 • SQL\-based healthcare data analysis.
 



 • Excel and Power BI reporting.
 



 • Dashboard and data\-visualization fundamentals.
 



 • Data\-quality and reconciliation practices.
 



 • Healthcare operations and analytical workflows.
 



 • Professional handling of sensitive business and healthcare information.
 



  





 Ideal candidate profile
 



  





 We are looking for candidates who are:
 



  





 • Interested in building a career in healthcare analytics or data analysis.
 



 • Comfortable working with numbers and structured datasets.
 



 • Detail\-oriented and focused on data accuracy.
 



 • Curious about using data to understand healthcare operations.
 



 • Willing to learn analytical tools and reporting techniques.
 



 • Responsible when handling confidential information.
 



 • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
 



  





 Why join Crossing Infotech?
 



  





 • Remote internship opportunity.
 



 • Practical exposure to healthcare data analytics.
 



 • Opportunity to strengthen Excel, SQL, and Power BI skills.
 



 • Experience with healthcare reporting and data\-quality processes.
 



 • Project\-based learning suitable for freshers.
 



 • Opportunity to develop skills relevant to healthcare analytics and data careers.
 



  





 Application deadline: 20 September 2026
 



  





 If you are a fresher interested in healthcare data, analytics, SQL, Excel, and Power BI, this internship provides an opportunity to develop practical analytical skills through structured healthcare datasets and supervised reporting projects.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Company Description:** 
 Protectol Healthcare is a pharmaceutical company operating across conventional medicines, nutraceuticals, nutrients, and business safety solutions. The company is structured into dedicated Pharma, Technology, Nutraceuticals, Nutriments, and Industrial Safety divisions, each focused on targeted research and development. Protectol Healthcare aims to advance health and safety outcomes through innovation, quality, and multidisciplinary expertise. Team members collaborate with professionals across these divisions, contributing to products and services that support well\-being in diverse markets. The organization values scientific rigor, compliance, and sustainable growth.
 



  





**Role Description:** 
 The Human Resources Manager at Protectol Healthcare is a full\-time, on\-site role based in
 
 Kochi, India
 
 . This position is responsible for leading the overall HR function, driving talent acquisition, workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, compensation \& benefits, employee relations, statutory compliance, and organizational development. Partner with senior management to align HR strategy with business objectives and support business growth, transformation, and workforce effectiveness, preferably within the Pharma, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Medical Devices, or FMCG sector. The role requires close collaboration with cross\-functional teams to build a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing workplace.
 



  





**Location:** 
 Kochi, Kerala
 



**Experience:** 
 15 – 20 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-Time
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy in alignment with the organization's business objectives and long\-term growth plans.
* Act as a strategic HR business partner to senior management and department heads on organizational and people\-related matters.
* Lead the overall HR function and provide direction to the HR team across recruitment, employee relations, performance management, learning and development, compensation, and HR operations.
* Develop long\-term workforce strategies, manpower plans, succession plans, and talent pipelines aligned with business expansion.
* Lead senior\-level and critical talent acquisition initiatives across corporate, sales, operations, manufacturing, and support functions.
* Establish effective talent management and retention strategies for key and high\-performing employees.
* Drive organizational restructuring, workforce optimization, change management, and HR transformation initiatives when required.
* Establish and oversee a robust performance management framework, including KPIs, KRAs, goal setting, performance reviews, and development plans.
* Develop and implement leadership development, succession planning, and career progression frameworks.
* Lead employee engagement and organizational culture initiatives to strengthen employee commitment and retention.
* Provide strategic guidance on complex employee relations matters, grievances, disciplinary actions, conflict resolution, and workplace issues.
* Oversee compensation and benefits strategy, including salary structures, benchmarking, annual increments, incentives, and benefits programs.
* Ensure the organization's compensation practices remain competitive, equitable, and aligned with market standards.
* Establish and maintain HR policies, processes, and governance frameworks in line with business requirements and applicable laws.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws and statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Gratuity, Shops \& Establishments Act, and other relevant regulations.
* Partner with management on workforce cost optimization, productivity improvement, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish HR metrics and dashboards to monitor workforce trends, employee turnover, recruitment effectiveness, absenteeism, manpower costs, and employee engagement.
* Present strategic HR reports, workforce analytics, and recommendations to senior management.
* Identify organizational capability gaps and lead initiatives to strengthen workforce competencies.
* Oversee learning and development strategies, including leadership development, technical training, behavioral development, and competency\-building programs.
* Build a strong performance\-oriented and employee\-focused organizational culture.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies and best practices across departments and locations.
* Mentor, develop, and build the capability of the HR team.
* Provide leadership during organizational changes, business expansion, restructuring, and other strategic initiatives.
* Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment while handling sensitive employee and organizational matters.



  





**Requirements** 




**﻿**



* MBA in Human Resources / Human Resource Management is mandatory.
* Bachelor's degree from a recognized university.
* 15–20 years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience in senior HR management roles.
* Strong experience in the Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Medical Devices, or FMCG industry is required.
* Proven experience in independently leading and managing the overall HR function.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance, and HR governance.
* Demonstrated experience in strategic HR planning, organizational development, talent management, and workforce planning.
* Proven track record of managing senior stakeholders and partnering with business leadership.
* Experience in leading and developing HR teams.
* Strong exposure to compensation strategy, performance management, succession planning, employee engagement, and organizational transformation.
* Experience in managing HR for multiple departments, business functions, or locations will be an advantage.
* Strong proficiency in HRMS/HRIS, HR analytics, and Microsoft Office.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, decision\-making, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




  




* Candidates with extensive experience in
 **Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, Medical Devices, Nutraceutical, Consumer Healthcare, or FMCG** 
 organizations will be preferred.
* Candidates who have worked in organizations undergoing significant growth, expansion, restructuring, or transformation will be preferred.
* Experience working directly with CEOs, Directors, senior management, and business leadership teams is highly desirable.
* Strong commercial understanding and the ability to connect HR strategy with business performance will be an advantage.
* Experience managing large and diverse workforces across multiple functions or locations will be preferred.

description:
Job Description – HR Executive (U.S. HR Operations)
 



  





 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Shift: Evening Shift / U.S. Business Hours
 



 Department: Human Resources
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Manage end\-to\-end employee onboarding, including collection and verification of new\-hire documentation, orientation, HR system updates, and completion of joining formalities.
 



 Support U.S. HR compliance activities and maintain employee documentation in accordance with company policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
 



 Coordinate employee benefits enrollment, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and other company\-sponsored benefit programs.
 



 Assist employees with benefits\-related questions, enrollment changes, qualifying life events, and annual/open enrollment activities.
 



 Maintain accurate and confidential employee personnel files, HR records, benefit records, and employee information within HRIS/HR management systems.
 



 Coordinate employment eligibility and onboarding documentation, including Form I\-9 and other required employment records, and maintain documentation for compliance and audit purposes.
 



 Work closely with U.S. HR management, payroll teams, benefits providers, insurance carriers, and other external vendors to ensure timely completion of HR activities.
 



 Support payroll administration by providing employee updates relating to new hires, terminations, benefits deductions, compensation changes, leave, and other employee transactions.
 



 Monitor HR compliance requirements and maintain appropriate trackers, reports, supporting documents, and records for internal and external audits.
 



 Respond to employee inquiries regarding onboarding, company policies, benefits, payroll\-related matters, leave, and other HR processes in a professional and timely manner.
 



 Coordinate employee lifecycle activities, including transfers, promotions, employee information changes, leave administration, benefits changes, and offboarding/exit formalities.
 



 Prepare and maintain HR reports and dashboards and provide administrative and operational support to U.S. HR leadership as required.
 



  





 Eligibility \& Qualifications
 



  





 Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline is required.
 



 MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a related specialization is preferred.
 



 Knowledge or experience in U.S. HR operations, employee onboarding, HR compliance, and benefits administration is preferred.
 



 Good written and verbal English communication skills.
 



 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook; familiarity with HRIS/HRMS platforms is an advantage.
 



 Strong attention to detail, confidentiality, organizational skills, and ability to coordinate with U.S.\-based employees and management.
 



  





 Important Terms \& Conditions :
 



**1\-Year Employment Bond / Agreement is mandatory** 
 for all new joiners.
 



 Selected candidates must commit to a
 **minimum of 1 year** 
 with the company.
 



 Candidates must submit their
 **SSC memo or higher\-education memo/certificate** 
 for verification during the joining process.
 



  





  





 Must be willing to work from Hyderabad during evening/U.S.\-aligned business hours.

title: HRBP - Global Support Functions & Talent
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
   

  

 Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
   

  

 Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The incumbent will act as a strategic HR Business Partner for Global Support Functions and as the Talent, Learning \& OD lead for the Operating unit ISC. As HRBP for Functions, the role will partner functional leaders on structure, manning, workforce planning, and talent strategies to enable business priorities and build future\-ready capabilities.
   

  

 From a Talent, Learning \& OD perspective, the role will assess organization\-wide learning and development needs, design strategic capability\-building programs, and drive OD interventions that strengthen leadership depth, employee growth, and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

 This role requires a strong blend of strategic business partnering, talent management, learning strategy, and organizational development expertise. The incumbent will work closely with business leaders, HRBPs and leadership teams to translate business priorities into people plans and enterprise\-wide learning interventions.
   

  

**Role Responsibilities**
* Partner with functional leaders on organization structure, manning plans, and workforce strategies to ensure the right capabilities and capacity are in place to deliver business outcomes.
* Develop and execute talent strategies for functions, including succession planning, critical role mapping, talent reviews, capability assessment, and career development interventions.
* Lead people initiatives for the functions aligned to organizational and functional priorities.
* Lead the performance and talent cycles for global support functions.
* Coach and advise leaders and managers on engagement and people development.
* Manage complex people queries from function leaders, requiring HR intervention.
* Partner with TA team and managers on recruitment and talent attraction efforts, to ensure right and timely resourcing.
* Identify organization\-wide learning and development needs through business priorities, talent insights, and capability gaps, and translate them into a structured annual learning agenda.
* Design and deliver strategic learning and leadership development programs that build enterprise capability, strengthen leadership pipeline, and support future growth priorities.
* Lead OD interventions across the organization, including capability building, change enablement, culture initiatives, team effectiveness, and organization design support.
* Collaborate with HRBPs and functional stakeholders to address talent gaps, improve internal movement, and support speed and quality in hiring for critical roles.
* Act as a change champion, managing the people side of transformation efforts and enabling smooth transitions during periods of growth, restructuring, or expansion.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong stakeholder management skills and experience in working with senior stakeholders.
* Experience in working in a matrix organization and with global teams.
* Experience in conceptualizing and executing organization wide capability programs across different seniority
* Strong business acumen and strategic partnering experience with functions.


***Why you?***
**Basic Qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in Human Resources, preferably from an institute of repute.
* 8\+ years of experience across HR business partnering, talent management, learning and development, and organizational development roles.
* Strong understanding of organization structure, manning, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent strategy.
* Experience in diagnosing learning needs and designing strategic learning, leadership development, and capability\-building programs at an organization\-wide level.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and change management skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to measure program effectiveness and use talent and learning insights to drive decisions.


 Location – this role is based in: Gurgaon
   

  

**Job Posting End Date**
 2026\-10\-11
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
   

  

 During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
   

  

 The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
   

  

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
 If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.
   

  

**Note to candidates**
 The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.
