* Experience implementing security controls within DevSecOps and CI/CD environments.

title: Platform Compliance Engineer
description:
**Overview**
 We're looking for a Platform Compliance Engineer to own the security posture of our Enterprise Linux and Windows systems. You'll ensure our infrastructure stays aligned with CIS Benchmark recommendations and drive a disciplined, risk\-based patching program \- moving fast on critical vulnerabilities and maintaining a predictable cadence for everything else. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and security, requiring close collaboration with both Windows/Linux platform teams and the security organization.
   

  

 You'll work closely with platform and security teams based in both Mumbai and Sydney, so strong written and verbal communication across time zones is important.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Compliance \& Hardening**
* Assess and maintain Enterprise Linux and Windows systems against current CIS Benchmark standards
* Develop, update, and maintain hardening baselines and compliance policies as CIS recommendations evolve
* Run regular compliance scans, track drift, and report on compliance posture across the fleet
* Document exceptions and compensating controls where full compliance isn't feasible, with appropriate risk sign\-off


**Vulnerability \& Patch Management**
* Monitor vulnerability feeds and scan findings to identify critical vulnerabilities requiring emergency patching
* Own the end\-to\-end process for expedited patching of critical/high\-severity vulnerabilities, including testing, deployment, and validation
* Maintain a regular patch cycle for standard/lower\-severity vulnerabilities across Linux and Windows environments
* Track patch compliance SLAs and report on remediation timelines and outstanding exposure
* Continuously improve processes to reduce manual effort and mean\-time\-to\-remediate


**Cross\-Team Collaboration**
* Partner with Linux and Windows platform teams to plan, test, and roll out patches and hardening changes with minimal disruption
* Work with security teams to prioritize remediation based on risk, exploitability, and business impact
* Participate in vulnerability triage and incident response when critical issues are identified
* Communicate compliance status, risks, and remediation plans to stakeholders and leadership
* Act as the primary point of contact during audits, preparing and collecting evidence and providing validation or proof of compliance as required

You’ll see how your contributions towards developing and supporting leading\-edge hardware and software technologies make a firm\-wide impact that makes us all smarter, faster, and better.

 For many of our roles, we don’t expect you to have prior industry experience in proprietary trading or financial services to succeed at Susquehanna International Group. We’re looking for people who are naturally curious, relentless problem solvers, and have the desire to continuously innovate, learn, and grow.

 Susquehanna offers a wide array of competitive employee perks \& benefits.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience with vulnerability management and patch management tools and processes
* Hands\-on experience with Tenable Security Center (or similar vulnerability management platforms, e.g., Qualys, Nessus)
* Understanding of vulnerability scoring (CVSS) and risk\-based prioritization
* Excellent cross\-functional communication skills, comfortable working with distributed teams


**Preferred**
* Experience across both Enterprise Linux and Windows Server environments
* Proficiency in Bash and/or PowerShell scripting
* Familiarity with additional scripting languages (Python)
* Experience with version control systems (Git, Perforce, or similar)
* Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins for automation and deployment workflows
* Experience with configuration management/patch tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, SCCM, WSUS, etc.)
* Experience with regulatory/compliance frameworks (NIST, PCI\-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2\) as they relate to system hardening
* Relevant certifications (Security\+, RHCSA, MCSE, CISSP, or similar)
* Familiarity with Group Policy (GPO) configuration, including troubleshooting precedence and conflict


**About Susquehanna**
 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm founded by a group of friends who share a passion for game theory and probabilistic thinking. We have incorporated this approach into our culture, where you will find relentless problem solvers within each of our core disciplines: Trading, Technology, and Quantitative Research. From offices around the world, our employees collaborate to make optimal decisions and are driven by the desire to achieve winning results together.

title: Help Desk Agent - Operations
description:
About Signant Health
 



  





 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
 



  





 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
 



  





 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking a motivated and customer\-oriented Tier 1 Help Desk Agent to join our Help Desk team. In this role, you will be the first point of contact for users interacting with AI\-driven Tier 0 systems in the context of clinical trial products. You will provide technical assistance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure seamless operations for Signant Health systems and applications.
 



  





 This role requires strong problem\-solving skills, empathy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. Candidates must be flexible to work rotational 24/7 shift timings and must be available to work onsite.
 



  





**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function** 




  




* Collaborate with AI\-driven Tier 0 support systems to diagnose and escalate issues, ensuring smooth transitions between automated responses and human support.
* Provide first\-line technical support for users — clinical trial teams, researchers, patients, and others — experiencing issues with Signant Health\-related products, applications, and software tools.
* Log and track support requests, ensuring timely resolution, and escalate unresolved issues to Tier 2 or other relevant technical teams.
* Troubleshoot basic hardware, software, and network issues related to clinical trial products and systems.
* Assist users in navigating Signant Health products, ensuring they have the resources and support to use systems effectively.
* Maintain detailed records of troubleshooting efforts, solutions provided, and user interactions, including proper documentation for recurring issues and resolutions.
* Maintain clear and concise communication with users, keeping them updated on the status of their support request and ensuring satisfaction with the outcome.
* Work closely with resolver groups to identify recurring issues, suggest improvements, and support the success of trial operations.
* Stay current on new tools, technology, and best practices in clinical trial management and IT support.
* Work rotational 24/7 shift timings and be available for onsite work as required.



  





**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES** 




  





**Essential:** 



* At least 1–2 years of experience in a help desk or IT support role, preferably in the healthcare or clinical trials sector.
* Understanding of AI\-driven support tools and how they interact with human agents to ensure a smooth user experience and issue resolution.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to think critically when troubleshooting technical issues.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non\-technical users.
* Understanding of common IT issues related to software, hardware, networking, and databases.
* High attention to detail, ensuring accurate logging and resolution of issues.
* Willingness and ability to work flexible, rotational 24/7 shift timings and to work onsite.
* High school diploma or equivalent required.








**Desirable:**

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

**Job Description**

title: Access Specialist
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility\-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data\-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
   

  

**Come Join Our Team!**
* As part of our robust Rewards \& Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance\-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards


**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**
 The Access Specialist is responsible for managing system access across EMR platforms, billing systems, and payer portals to support onboarding, operational needs, and access maintenance activities.
   

  

 This role coordinates access requests, maintains access documentation, troubleshoots access\-related issues, and works closely with operational teams to ensure colleagues have the appropriate system access needed to perform their roles. The Access Specialist helps support access readiness, compliance requirements, and ongoing operational efficiency through accurate and timely access management.
   

  

**Essential Functions And Tasks**
* Provision and maintain access for EMR systems, billing applications, and payer portals.
* Process new user setups, account modifications, password resets, and terminations.
* Assign and validate role\-based access permissions.
* Maintain access documentation, audit logs, and tracking records.
* Utilize ticketing systems to manage and monitor requests through completion.
* Support onboarding and offboarding activities.
* Troubleshoot routine access issues and escalate when necessary.
* Perform access audits and reconciliation activities.
* Support process improvement initiatives, testing, and system implementations.
* Partner with operational teams and Access Leads to ensure timely access delivery.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* High School Diploma or equivalent required.
* Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Experience in healthcare operations, medical billing, access administration, healthcare support, or related functions preferred.
* Experience working with EMR systems, payer portals, or healthcare technology platforms preferred.


**Core Skills**
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**
* Strong organizational, communication, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Attention to detail and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to handle confidential information appropriately.
* Ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.


**Work Schedule**
* Full\-time position, Monday through Friday.
* Supports U.S. Eastern Time business operations.
* Standard schedule aligns with 8:00 AM \- 5:00 PM Eastern Time.
* India shift hours will adjust as needed to accommodate U.S. Daylight Saving Time changes.
* Flexibility may be required to support onboarding activities, access requests, client implementations, and business\-critical operational needs.


**Compensation**
* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job\-related reasons .
* This position is also eligible for a discretionary incentiv e bon us in accordance with company policies .


**Ventra Health**
**Equal Employment Opportunity (Applicable only in the US)**
 Ventra Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a culturally diverse organization. We strive for inclusiveness and a workplace where mutual respect is paramount. We encourage applications from a diverse pool of candidates, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, or veteran status. We will provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, as needed, to assist them in performing essential job functions.
   

  

**Recruitment Agencies**
 Ventra Health does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Ventra Health is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
   

  

**Solicitation of Payment**
 Ventra Health does not solicit payment from our applicants and candidates for consideration or placement.
   

  

**Attention Candidates**
 Please be aware that there have been reports of individuals falsely claiming to represent Ventra Health or one of our affiliated entities Ventra Health Private Limited and Ventra Health Global Services. These scammers may attempt to conduct fake interviews, solicit personal information, and, in some cases, have sent fraudulent offer letters.
   

  

 To protect yourself, verify any communication you receive by contacting us directly through our official channels. If you have any doubts, please contact us at Careers@VentraHealth.com to confirm the legitimacy of the offer and the person who contacted you. All legitimate roles are posted on https://ventrahealth.com/careers/.
   

  

**Statement of Accessibility**

We continually work to enhance the user experience through ongoing improvements and adherence to accessibility standards. Please review at https://ventrahealth.com/statement\-of\-accessibility/.

title: IT Executive
description:
**Company Description**
**Your Fairmont Journey Starts Here:**
 Are you a someone with a passion for excellence and a flair for exceptional hospitality? Fairmont Udaipur Palace invites you to embark on an unforgettable journey of luxury and join our pre\-opening team.
   

  

 Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo!
 **\#BELIMITLESS**
**Job Description**
* Maintain and troubleshoot computers, laptops, printers, scanners, servers, switches, routers, Wi\-Fi, and other IT equipment.
* Provide day\-to\-day technical support to all hotel departments, including Front Office, Housekeeping, Food \& Beverage, Finance, HR, Sales, and Administration.
* Monitor and maintain the hotel's LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, internet connectivity, and network infrastructure.
* Support and maintain hotel applications such as Property Management System (PMS), Point of Sale (POS), HRMS, accounting systems, and other operational software.
* Assist with installation, configuration, upgrading, and maintenance of hardware and software.
* Manage user accounts, email accounts, passwords, access rights, and system permissions.
* Ensure regular data backup and assist with data recovery when required.
* Monitor antivirus, firewall, endpoint security, and other IT security systems.
* Maintain CCTV, access control, telephone/PBX, IPTV, and other technology systems where applicable.
* Support guest Wi\-Fi and resolve guest technology\-related issues promptly.
* Maintain IT inventory, asset records, software licenses, and equipment documentation.
* Coordinate with external vendors and service providers for maintenance, repairs, and technical support.
* Perform preventive maintenance of IT systems and equipment.
* Ensure IT systems are available and operational during hotel business hours and support emergency issues when required.
* Follow hotel IT policies, cybersecurity procedures, and data protection standards.
* Maintain proper records of incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, and IT assets.
* Assist the IT Manager in implementing new technology projects and system upgrades.
* Provide basic IT training and guidance to hotel employees.
* Ensure minimum downtime of critical hotel systems and escalate major issues to the IT Manager or relevant vendor.


**Qualifications**
* achelor’s/Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Applications, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of IT support experience, preferably in a hotel, resort, or hospitality environment.
* Knowledge of hotel PMS and POS systems is preferred.
* Good understanding of LAN/WAN, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, switches, routers, and basic network troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of Windows OS, Microsoft Office, Active Directory, printers, and hardware troubleshooting.
* Basic knowledge of CCTV, PBX/telephone systems, IPTV, access control, and guest Wi\-Fi is an advantage.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work in shifts, weekends, and holidays as required by hotel operations.
* Good command of English; additional languages are an advantage.
* Hospitality experience with good customer\-service orientation will be preferred.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our Commitment To Diversity \& Inclusion**
 We are an inclusive company, and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.

title: Associate system administrator
description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long\-term care for the patients we serve.
   

  

 With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.
   

  

 If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.
   

  

 Our innovative company is looking to fill the role of Windows / VMware Administrator. Day to day activities include developing and documenting system specifications, implementing hardware and OS, maintaining high operational uptime stringent SLAs, coordinating with applications and database teams and other operational and project\-based tasks.
   

  

**Essential Job Functions**
* Provides systems administration technical expertise in support of core business functions.
* Evaluates end user needs, goals, in conjunction with application parameters to define overall system requirements and technical design.
* Relies on extensive knowledge and professional discretion to achieve goals.
* Evaluates existing systems and designs/flowcharts proposed systems.
* Installs, monitors, and manages servers and customer endpoints, resolves issues as needed Installs system and application patches and performs system backups and recovery.
* Monitors system configuration and manages log files.
* Develops user guides, technical procedures, and technical architecture documentation.
* Ensures system security through proactive security patch management.
* Monitors existing infrastructure and usage, optimizes system to ensure quality user experience.
* Documents internal policies
* Makes recommendation on potential solutions by defining database physical structure and functional capabilities, database security, data backup, and recovery specifications.
* Generates usage reports for submission to leadership.
* Manages upgrades and continually monitors all production servers for performance, business continuity, disaster discovery and security.
* Builds and deploys server and multi\-client images support, including wireless, in conjunction with software and hardware product development.
* Maintain Windows Server 2012 – 2022 and related services E.g. File/Print/DHCP server
* Maintain VMware vSphere platform and related services
* Manage work queues for Windows and VMware incidents, problems, changes, tasks and requests and ensure workload is effectively managed; prioritize and respond to help desk tickets as appropriate.


**Supplemental Job Functions**
 Performs additional duties as directed.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE:
   

  

* 2\-4 years of experience as a Windows \& VMware Administrator
* Good knowledge managing virtualized (VMware) operating systems.
* Experience deploying and maintaining Cloud \& on\-premises platforms.
* Experience with managing proactive monitoring and alerting to assure system uptime.
* Understanding of Major cloud platforms E.g. AWS/Azure/GCP
* High level troubleshooting skills at the OS, virtualization, and hardware layer
* Good understanding of PowerShell Scripting.
* Understanding of networking topology and protocols
* Clear and concise communications both written and verbal.
* Understanding of SLA terms
* Proven track record working in a global and multicultural environment


**Additional Requirements**
* Ready to work in 24X7 Shifts \& on call schedule.


**Training**
* The post holder will be expected to undertake training to ensure that her/his skills are current.


 If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 Accendra is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, religion, disability, age, status as a veteran, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at our Company via email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of our Company. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by our Company as a result of the referral or through other means.*

title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 The Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) is an entry level engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational through proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems and restoring service to clients by managing incidents to resolution.
   

  

 This role has the primary objective is to ensure zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions and focuses on first\-line support for standard and low complexity incidents and service requests.
   

  

 This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Monitors client infrastructure and solutions.
* Identifies problems and errors prior to or when they occur.
* Routinely identifies common incidents and opportunities for avoidance as well as general opportunities for incident reduction.
* Investigates first line incidents assigned and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Fulfils approved requests following agreed procedures.
* Provides telephonic or chat support to clients when required.
* Executes approved maintenance activities including patching and configuration changes.
* Follows the required handover procedures for shift changes to ensure service continuity.
* Reports and escalates incidents where necessary.
* Ensures the efficient and comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests.
* Proactively identifies opportunities for work optimization.
* Updates existing knowledge articles or creates new ones.
* Identifies opportunities for work optimization including opportunities for automation of work, request fulfilment, incident resolution, and other general process improvement opportunities.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.


**Knowledge and Attributes:**
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.
* Additional skills proficiency such as (but not limited to):
+ Pulse Secure SSL VPN / Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls / Cisco Nexus switches, ASR and ISR routers / Cisco ACS, ISE / Meraki switches and access points / Enterprise network architecture / Common routing protocols: BGP,OSPF, EIGRP / Network address translation / Configuring, monitoring and troubleshooting uplinks to ISPs for DIA, MPLS and P2P circuits / Familiarity with common network management and monitoring tools such as SecureCRT, Logic Monitor.


**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Information Technology/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* CCNA or equivalent certification.
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).


**Required Experience:**
* Entry\-level experience or completion of the relevant intern program.
* Entry\-level experience with troubleshooting and providing the support required in network / data center / systems / storage administration and monitoring Services within a medium to large ICT organization.
* Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and products within the supported technical domain (i.e. Network, Data Centre, Telephony, Exchange, Storage, Cloud, Backup, etc.).


**Workplace type:**
 On\-site Working
   

  

**About NTT DATA**
 NTT DATA is a $30\+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long\-term success. We invest over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture

This role focuses on alarm monitoring, incident and fault management, and first\-level triage while ensuring seamless coordination with resolver teams. The individual will support a diverse set of roaming services including SS7 signalling, LTE/5G signalling, VoLTE, CAMEL, and value\-added services such as Steering of Roaming (SoR), Virtual Home Environment (VHE), and Welcome Roaming SMS (WRSMS), delivering reliable connectivity across global Vodafone markets.

* Analyse network KPIs and investigate quality degradation and customer complaints
* Support automation initiatives by identifying process improvement opportunities to reduce manual effort
* Contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes and service reliability

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with attention to detail
* Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal
* Educational background: Engineering graduate
* Technical expertise in core network technologies such as SS7, SMS/SMPP, LTE
* Working knowledge of core platforms including STP and DRA/DEA
* Understanding of roaming platform integration with traditional telecom networks (2G/3G/4G/VoLTE)
* Ability to operate in a fast\-paced, 24x7 support environment with collaborative working style

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
   

  

**What's In It For You**
 Opportunity to work on global roaming platforms across multiple Vodafone markets
   

  

* Exposure to advanced telecom technologies including LTE, VoLTE, and 5G
* A collaborative and inclusive work environment focused on continuous improvement
* Experience in managing critical network operations impacting customer experience
* Opportunity to contribute to automation and operational efficiency initiatives


**What Skills You Will Learn**
 Advanced troubleshooting and incident management in telecom networks
   

  

* Deep understanding of international roaming architecture and interworking systems
* Hands\-on exposure to core network signalling technologies and platforms
* Analytical techniques for network performance monitoring and KPI optimisation
* Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder coordination in global operations


**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio\-economic background.
   

  

**Join Us**
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
   

  

 We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  




**Description**
 Are you ready to be the decision\-maker for the global network backbone of a world\-class cloud platform?
   

  

 We are searching for a mid level engineer ready to take complete ownership of our rapidly expanding data center network across multiple continents. This is an empowering role where you will be instrumental in designing, architecting, and optimizing our complex global connectivity.
   

  

 You will dive deep into cutting\-edge technologies, including Juniper EVPN\-VXLAN, and advanced routing protocols (BGP). Critically, while you will own the network domain, you will also be deeply embedded in the wider Infrastructure team. This provides a clear, defined path for you to grow into all areas of our Infra stack—from Linux compute and storage to Kubernetes and site reliability engineering (SRE).
   

  

 If you are passionate about building resilient, secure, and scalable networks, and are eager for a role where your expertise acts as the core architectural decision\-maker with clear opportunities to expand your career into overall infrastructure leadership, we can’t wait to connect with you.
   

  

 This is a 5\-day in\-office position built for maximum impact. Direct, high\-bandwidth collaboration is key to the level of Network Ownership and accelerated cross\-functional growth we offer. Be in the room to influence architecture, partner with senior leadership, and make immediate, high\-stakes decisions that drive the business forward. We believe that we are better together than apart.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 This role is for an engineer who will support network architecture while contributing across the broader infrastructure.
 * Implement, optimize, and scale the global data center backbone to ensure high availability and security.
* Contribute to the implementation and refinement of Juniper EVPN\-VXLAN fabric for scalable overlay networks in our cloud environment.
* Configure and manage mission\-critical routing protocols (BGP,IPSec,ICCP) to ensure resilient, high\-performance global connectivity.
* Configure and maintain security policies using enterprise\-grade firewalls (Fortinet, or similar).
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, SRE, and Development teams to integrate networking solutions with compute, storage and cloud systems (Kubernetes/Ceph).
* Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python,Bash,Ansible) to streamline network provisioning and scaling.
* Utilize and support network observability tools (Prometheus,Grafana) for infrastructure monitoring and insight.
* Provide effective troubleshooting and resolution for network incidents of varying complexity to minimize downtime.


**Requirements**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience as a Network Engineer proficient in Juniper EVPN\-VXLAN, advanced routing, and enterprise firewalls.
* Working knowledge of core routing protocols BGP/IPSec for scaling global data center networks.
* Strong proficiency in Linux and proven ability to automate tasks using Python, Bash, or Ansible.
* Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for proactive network monitoring and actionable insights.
* Experience in configuring firewalls and implementing network security best practices.
* Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues.
* Proactive approach to learning and adopting new technologies across the infrastructure stack.
* Willingness to occasionally travel to data centers for on\-site deployments and maintenance.


**Nice to Have:**
* Advanced troubleshooting utilities: grep, awk, sed, and tcpdump.
* ​​​​​​​Implementing Anycast for scalable network resilience.
* ​​​​​​​Integrating network solutions with Kubernetes and CNI.
* Optimizing performance on Juniper QFX series switches.


**About Brivo**
 Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises.
   

  

 As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.
   

  

 With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.
   

  

*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

 2\-5 years

* Consistent success in NOC or in an IT helpdesk within a high traffic, global enterprise environment.
* Experience with Zendesk, Jira or ticket tracking best practices
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Experience with diagnostic tools and reading and interpreting logs
* Excellent organization skills
* A curious mindset and a passion for continued learning, staying abreast of new technology and techniques
* Service Performance indicators and their interpretation.
* Working experience in either Access, Core, Transport networks
* Knowledge of routers/switches/firewall desired but is not mandatory

* Must possess good communication skills and fluent in English speaking and Writing.
* Must possess strong interpersonal skills and have the ability to interact with all levels of employees in a professional manner.
* Strict adherence to company policies, confidentiality, and mature judgment must be always demonstrated
* Desire to excel, capability to drive the solution of a problem and flexibility in work schedule
* Consistent attention to detail
* High level of commitment
* Team Player Customer focus approach and sense of urgency
* Ready to work in shifts 24x7
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience with AI tools and technologies, with a commitment to leveraging artificial intelligence to drive innovation, enhance security, and optimize performance.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Refold** 




  





 Refold is building the next\-generation AI platform that replaces enterprise integration and consultants. We’re pioneering autonomous AI agents that understand complex enterprise systems, generate production\-ready code, and operate at a scale no consulting firm can match. Today, we’re starting with integrations—a $50B market. Tomorrow, we’re building towards a world where AI agents handle any complex cognitive work.
 



  





 Traction: Serving 20\+ enterprise customers with Fortune 500 deployments, processing 10M\+ API calls/day. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia \& Abhishek Kumar, who sold their previous startup to Netmeds; they have also been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30\. They have experience at organisations such as Nomura, JioMart, InstaMojo, IIT Kharagpur, and IIT Roorkee. We are funded by marquee investors, including Eniac Ventures, Tidal Ventures, Karman Ventures, Ahead VC \& Better Capital.
 



  





**We’re assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one.** 




  





**The Role:** 




  





 As a forward\-deployed engineer, you turn the hardest enterprise integration problems into production\-grade systems on our agentic platform. You’ll take ambiguous, real\-world requirements; messy APIs; undocumented systems; and edge cases nobody anticipated and reason from first principles to ship production\-grade integrations.
 



  





 You’re a curious, hands\-on builder with a customer\-first mindset and a real passion for AI already on the frontier of agentic tooling and vibe coding and eager to point that energy at real customer problems. You think like a solutions engineer: the goal isn’t to build; it’s to solve. Mostly delivery, with time as the technical engine behind our highest\-stakes POCs — and the patterns you uncover shape the platform itself.
 



  




* **Team:** 
 Small, high\-calibre technical team working directly with architects, product, and founders.
* **Building:** 
 Agentic AI workflows, connectors, and high\-throughput integration pipelines.
* **You’ll work with i** 
 ntegration leaders and engineering teams at high\-growth SaaS companies and Fortune 500 enterprises.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* **Solve hard integration problems.** 
 Take ambiguous, real\-world enterprise requirements and reason from first principles to design integrations that work, including the problems for which no playbook exists yet.
* **Build agentic workflows end\-to\-end.** 
 Implement complete integrations on Refold’s AI\-native integration platform, orchestration logic, agentic decision\-making, data transformations, and system connectivity against live enterprise systems.
* **Drive product direction from the field.** 
 You’re one of our highest\-signal sources of product truth. Surface gaps, friction, and missing capabilities you hit while building and validate new platform features through real customer workflows.
* **Power high\-stakes POCs.** 
 Partner with the pre\-sales team to execute the technical work behind proofs\-of\-concept, building and validating integrations that prove value during the sales cycle.
* **Codify what works.** 
 Turn hard\-won learnings into reference architectures, integration patterns, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base.
* **Evolve agentic capabilities.** 
 Contribute to the evolution of Refold's agentic workflows — decision\-making logic, tool invocation, and autonomous execution within integrations — and feed every implementation back into the skills/graph layer so the platform's agents get measurably smarter with each integration you ship.



  





**Required Skills \& Abilities:** 




  




* 2\-4 years in solutions engineering, integration engineering, product engineering, or a similar hands\-on technical role.
* A curious, hands\-on builder, you reason about systems from first principles, love getting your hands dirty, and are energised by ambiguity.
* Genuine passion for AI: you already build with cutting\-edge tools (LLMs, agentic frameworks, and vibe coding) for fun, not just at work, and you stay on the frontier as it moves.
* With a customer\-first, solutions\-engineering mindset, you measure yourself by the problem solved and the outcome delivered, not the code shipped.
* Strong foundation in APIs, distributed systems, and common integration patterns.
* Hands\-on proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js).



  





**Nice to Have:** 




  




* Experience with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or ServiceNow.
* Familiarity with iPaaS or workflow automation platforms (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Zapier, Merge).
* Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure) and containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes).
* Hands\-on experience building with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open\-source models, agent orchestration).
* Background at an early\-stage startup where product and engineering responsibilities were tightly coupled.



  





**Why Join Refold AI?** 




  




* Fast\-growing seed\-stage company (raised $6\.5M from Eniac Ventures \& Tidal Ventures)
* Founding team opportunity to shape engineering culture and technical direction from day one
* Cutting\-edge AI \+ infrastructure tech solving complex, high\-value enterprise problems
* Early traction with Fortune 500 clients and high\-growth software companies
* Direct line of sight to leadership and future engineering management path
* Work with a small, exceptional team that ships fast and celebrates bold ideas

description:
**About Us**




 Scapia! A credit card that's out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We're a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don't stop until we're proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We've worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



  





**About the Role**




 We are looking for Flutter Engineers with 2 to 6 years of experience to join the frontend team at Scapia.You will be placed in a pod based on where your strengths fit. You will work across surfaces spanning card onboarding and servicing, UPI and bill payments, travel
 



 search and checkout, rewards, and the shared design system beneath them. You will collaborate closely with design, backend, product and our bank and supplier partner teams to take a surface from spec through to a staged production rollout.
 



  





**What You'll Do**




  





**Feature Ownership** 



* Own customer\-facing surfaces end to end, from problem definition and technical design through rollout, adoption metrics and the on\-call that follows.
* Set the technical direction for your surface and make the architecture calls that keep it changeable a year from now.
* Partner with design, product and backend to turn ambiguous problem statements into shipped, measured experiences.



  





**Cards and Payments** 



* Build and scale the card experience across onboarding, activation, limits, statements, EMI and rewards.
* Deliver payment experiences that are fast, reliable and compliant, spanning UPI, bill payments and card transactions.
* Shape how the app adapts to multiple bank partners, so that a single change ships safely across every programme.



  





**Travel Commerce** 



* Build high\-converting search, booking and checkout journeys across flights, stays, trains, buses, visas and experiences.
* Create discovery and merchandising surfaces that help customers evaluate options and choose with confidence.
* Own post\-booking experiences spanning cancellations, refunds, rewards and customer communication.



  





**App Health and Performance** 



* Continuously improve app performance, stability and size across ANRs, crashes, startup time and memory.
* Strengthen observability through crash reporting, instrumentation and analytics that teams can act on.
* Advance release engineering, including staged rollouts, remote kill switches and over\-the\-air patching on Android and iOS.

**Job Description**
 We are seeking a Knowledge Engineer to support the development of MAV for structured ingestion, reasoning, and retrieval of complex mining and asset information. The successful candidate will design and implement end\-to\-end knowledge extraction and ingestion pipelines, transforming unstructured and semi\-structured technical documents (PDFs, reports, drawings) into RDF\-based knowledge graphs, and enabling graph\-native retrieval and reasoning workflows (GraphRAG). This role sits at the intersection of knowledge engineering, AI\-driven extraction (LLM \+ vision), ontology design, and graph analytics.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Knowledge Extraction \& Ingestion
   

  

* Design and implement automated extraction pipelines for technical tailings storage facility (TSF) documents (PDFs, scanned reports, tables, figures).
* Apply LLM\-based and vision\-based extraction techniques (OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models) to identify entities, attributes, relationships, and evidence.
* Develop validation and normalization logic to ensure extracted knowledge meets quality and consistency requirements.


 Knowledge Schema \& Ontology Design
   

  

* Design and evolve domain ontologies and knowledge schemas to support structured storage of TSF, risk, asset, and operational data.
* Implement schemas using RDF/OWL, including classes, properties, constraints, and semantic relationships.
* Align schemas with industry standards and internal MAV data models.


 Knowledge Graph Development
   

  

* Build and manage RDF\-based knowledge graphs in graph repositories (e.g., GraphDB, RDFox, Neptune, or equivalent).
* Implement ingestion workflows that map extracted content into graph structures with traceability to source documents.
* Support versioning, provenance, and evidence linking within the knowledge graph.


 Retrieval \& GraphRAG Pipelines
   

  

* Design and implement graph\-native retrieval pipelines, combining SPARQL queries, reasoning, and embeddings where appropriate.
* Develop GraphRAG architectures that leverage structured graph context rather than flat text retrieval.
* Enable natural\-language querying over the knowledge graph for downstream AI assistants and analytics tools.


 Collaboration \& Integration
   

  

* Work closely with development team, domain experts, and AI engineers to refine extraction logic and schema requirements.
* Support integration with cloud AI services (e.g., Azure AI, OpenAI models, document processing services).


**Qualifications**
* Proven experience as a Knowledge Engineer, Ontology Engineer, or Knowledge Graph Engineer.
* Strong understanding of RDF, OWL, SPARQL, and semantic data modeling.
* Hands\-on experience with RDF\-based graph repositories (GraphDB, RDFox, Apache Jena, Neptune, etc.).
* Experience designing automated knowledge extraction pipelines using LLMs.
* Familiarity with vision\-based document processing (OCR, layout analysis, multimodal extraction).

title: Robotics Engineer (Universal Robots, India)
description:
**Our Purpose**
 TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Our employees are supported to innovate and learn something new every day. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation and delivers better business results.
   

  

 Universal Robots, part of Teradyne Robotics, is the world market leader in collaborative robots (cobots), making products that empower our customers and positively transform the way they work. Teradyne Robotics is a division of Teradyne and includes Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR). Our global R\&D organization of 200\+ engineers builds the software and systems behind every cobot we ship.
   

  

**Opportunity Overview**
 You will join a team of talented and passionate engineers developing, testing, and optimizing the software and firmware running on our various robot platforms.
   

  

 As a Robotics Engineer on the Simulation team, you will build the pipelines and infrastructure that let us simulate UR cobots and MiR mobile robots at scale — before a single unit is deployed on a customer floor. Simulation is central to how we reduce integration time, validate fleet behaviour, and let customers model their own environments and workflows ahead of deployment.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on engineering role sitting at the intersection of robotics and software infrastructure. You will work with ROS2, physics engines, and GPU\-accelerated simulation to turn real robotic systems into faithful virtual ones, and you will build the tooling, services, and pipelines that make those simulations reliable, repeatable, and fast. You will collaborate closely with research scientists working on world models and 3D scene generation, with application engineers who understand real customer deployments, and with the wider R\&D organization in Denmark and Bangalore.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities And Tasks Include**
* Design, build, and maintain the simulation pipeline and supporting infrastructure used to model UR and MiR robot platforms in virtual environments.
* Develop and maintain accurate robot models — kinematics, dynamics, sensors, and controllers — ensuring simulated behaviour faithfully reflects real hardware.
* Implement and optimise ROS2\-based integrations so simulated robots interoperate seamlessly with the same software stack that runs on physical systems.
* Build scalable simulation infrastructure across cloud and on\-premises GPU environments, including job orchestration, environment versioning, and resource management.
* Develop tooling and services that allow engineers, application teams, and customers to configure, launch, monitor, and analyse simulation runs.
* Build capabilities for importing customer models and environments, and for creating custom scenarios and workflows.
* Contribute to multi\-agent simulation supporting fleet\-level coordination, zone layout, and multi\-robot interaction scenarios.
* Establish automated testing, validation, and benchmarking frameworks that measure simulation fidelity and tie results to integration time and fleet performance.
* Work with research scientists to integrate world models and generated 3D scenes into production simulation workflows.
* Write clean, well\-tested, and documented code, and participate actively in code reviews to uphold engineering standards across the team.
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment tooling that keep simulation systems reliable and continuously validated.
* Partner with product, application, and customer\-facing teams to translate real deployment challenges into simulation capabilities.


**All About You**
 We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you're ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.
   

  

 We value diversity in culture, competence, and experience. We expect you to bring a number of qualifications to be considered for this role.
   

  

**Mandatory Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 2\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent working on robotics systems.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and C\+\+, with a demonstrated ability to write production\-quality, maintainable code.
* Hands\-on experience with ROS or ROS2, including building nodes, working with the middleware, and integrating with robot hardware or simulators.
* Practical experience with at least one robotics simulation environment (e.g. Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Webots, or CoppeliaSim).
* Solid understanding of robotics fundamentals — kinematics, dynamics, control, coordinate transforms, and sensor modelling.
* Experience building and maintaining software infrastructure: APIs, services, containerisation, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Comfortable working in a Linux environment with version control, automated testing, and modern development workflows.


**Proficiency required in at least five of the following qualifications:**
* GPU\-accelerated simulation and rendering, including experience with CUDA or NVIDIA Isaac Sim / Omniverse.
* Physics engines and their tuning for contact\-rich or high\-fidelity robotic interaction (PhysX, Bullet, ODE, MuJoCo).
* Cloud infrastructure and orchestration — AWS, Azure, or GCP, with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Mobile robotics concepts including SLAM, navigation stacks, path planning, and fleet management.
* Manipulator robotics including motion planning, trajectory generation, and collision checking.
* 3D geometry, scene representation, and asset pipelines (USD, URDF, SDF, mesh processing).
* Multi\-agent or fleet\-scale simulation and the coordination challenges it introduces.
* Backend service development and distributed systems design.
* Data pipelines and time\-series or large\-scale sensor data handling.
* Machine learning workflows and experience deploying trained models into production systems.
* Digital twin development and sim\-to\-real validation methodologies.
* Real\-time systems, embedded software, or robot firmware development.


**Personal Attributes**
 Candidates should demonstrate ambition, organizational skills, and adaptability. Independence, initiative, responsibility, and ownership are vital. A pragmatic approach, commitment to continuous learning, and dedication to work quality are expected.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 At Universal Robots we set a high bar and in return we provide an exciting career in a fast\-growing, technology\-driven company where you work alongside skilled and talented colleagues from around the world.
   

  

* Global team, local impact — Be part of a world\-class R\&D organisation managed from Denmark while making a tangible difference from our Bangalore office every day.
* Growth and development — A manager with continuous focus on team spirit, employee development, and skill building.
* Empowerment — Ownership of your work and the products you help create; we trust our engineers to make informed decisions that benefit the organisation.
* Health insurance and additional benefits.
* On\-site collaboration with co\-located product and software teams, fostering strong working relationships and rapid feedback


 We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.
   

  

 This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

 We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard\-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
   

  

**We are looking for System Integration Engineer – Power Transmission**
 As a System Integration Engineer for Power Transmission, you will play a crucial role in building and integrating activities across traction, brake, hybrid and auxiliary systems. You will qualify on all key elements of the power transmission subsystem, building the technical foundation to grow into senior positions across multiple engineering domains.
   

  

**You’ll make a difference by**
**System Integration**
* Bring traction, brake, hybrid, and auxiliary software together to life in end\-to\-end Software\-in\-the\-Loop (SiL) and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop (HiL) simulations as well as train\-level integration testing – partnering closely with senior experts to ensure a seamless, system level integration.
* Perform initial sanity checks on simulation results and log files to quickly identify anomalies, validate expected behavior, and flag issues early for further analysis.


 Verification
   

  

* Execute reference test steps across SiL, HiL, and system\-level testing in line with approved test instructions – and continuously enhance and expand the test automation toolchain.
* Ensure end\-to\-end consistency and traceability of requirements from system to software level, and prepare comprehensive verification documentation (e.g., traceability tables, screenshots, and structured evidence collection) to support audits and release readiness.


**Agile Engineering Process**
* Thrive in an agile setup by turning system integration findings into clear, actionable change requests for the responsible domains. Stay tightly aligned with the global engineering team by actively contributing in stand\-ups and cross\-functional engineering meetings.


**Technical Documentation \& Process Compliance**
* Prepare and continuously update core system documentation (architecture overviews, interface descriptions, parameter lists, checklists), and collect, structure, and pre\-check technical inputs for design reviews, integration meetings, and validation planning. Maintain all documentation in a consistent, audit\-ready structure using the defined toolchain.


**Cross\-Site Collaboration \& Knowledge Transfer**
* Work closely with global engineering teams – especially with the headquarters in Germany – to align technical topics across sites. Support structured knowledge transfer by supporting training materials creation and keeping guidelines and documentation up to date.


**Desired Skills**

* Basic skills for automation and/or data handling
* Ability to read electrical and pneumatic schematics and block diagrams
* Basic software and/or systems engineering concepts
* Interest in system integration, verification \& validation (V\&V), testing, and technical documentation

title: Product Associate Intern
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Product Associate Intern
   

**Location:** 
 Pune, Maharashtra, India
   

**Position Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

**Experience Level:** 
 0\-2 years
   

  

**About the role**
 You'll work directly with a Product Manager across a portfolio of enterprise AI and SaaS products, acting as their second pair of hands and second opinion. The work splits roughly across three things: helping shape and run product development, supporting day\-to\-day product management, and contributing to bids and proposals for public sector and commercial clients.
   

  

 It's a broad role by design. In a single week you might sit in an architecture discussion, work through a competitor's product, chase a delivery blocker, interview a user, and draft a section of a tender response. It suits someone who'd rather be useful across the whole picture than specialised in one slice of it.
   

  

 This is an early\-career role. We care more about how you think than what you've shipped.
   

  

  

  

  

 Requirements
   

  

**What you'll do**
**Product development**
 • Turn ideas and requirements into clear, well\-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and specifications
   

 • Sit in on engineering and architecture discussions, follow the technical reasoning, and capture decisions and their implications
   

 • Track progress, chase dependencies, and surface blockers and risks before they become delivery problems
   

 • Coordinate between engineering, design, QA, and business stakeholders
   

  

**Product management support**
 • Gather and synthesise user needs from customers, support channels, delivery teams, and product usage data
   

 • Research the market, competitors, and emerging AI capabilities; assess what's relevant to our products
   

 • Prepare roadmap materials, briefings, and stakeholder updates
   

 • Maintain product documentation, backlogs, and internal knowledge assets
   

  

**Bid and proposal support**
 • Contribute to RFP and tender responses: research, requirement mapping, drafting, and evidencing product capability against buyer requirements
   

 • Help maintain a reusable library of product and capability content for bids
   

  

**What we're looking for**
 • 0–2 years of experience in a product, analyst, consulting, delivery, or technical role. Internships, side projects, and strong academic work count.
   

 • An analytical mindset: you break problems down, look for evidence, and can tell a real signal from a loud one
   

 • Strong people skills. Much of this job is getting clarity out of busy people across different functions, and being someone they're glad to hear from.
   

 • Technical fluency: you understand APIs, databases, cloud services, and how software is built and deployed. You don't need to code, but you should follow an engineering conversation without needing it translated.
   

 • Fluent use of AI tools in your own work: you use them to research, draft, and analyse faster, and you know where their output needs checking
   

 • Clear, structured writing. A large share of your output is documents other people rely on.

title: UX Designer (2 to 4 years)
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high\-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
   

  

**Position Summary:** 
 Design is evolving as AI blurs the boundaries between research, UX design, product thinking, prototyping and development. In this role, you will help shape human\-centered design in an AI\-native product environment, using AI\-assisted and specification\-driven development (SDD) practices while ensuring evidence, creativity and human judgment remain central.
   

  

 You will solve complex healthcare problems involving interconnected systems, large amounts of information and decisions where clarity and accuracy matter. The primary focus is document interoperability—helping healthcare professionals find, review, understand and act on clinical information—as well as referrals and other cross\-organization experiences.
   

  

 Research is central to the role. You will work with healthcare professionals, practice staff, clients and clinical/domain experts, combining research insights with product and behavioral data to make evidence\-based design decisions.
   

  

**About the Team:** 
 You will be part of a collaborative team working closely with
 **Design, Product, Engineering, clients and clinical/domain experts** 
 to create clear, accurate and usable healthcare experiences.
   

  

 The team is exploring how
 **AI** 
 can support research, synthesis, problem framing, specification, exploration, prototyping and validation. You will contribute to evolving
 **SDD practices** 
 and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for
 **accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value** 
 .
   

  

 Together, the team works on complex, data\-rich healthcare workflows where users need to understand information, make decisions and take action across interconnected systems.
   

  

**Essential Job Responsibilities**
* Use AI across research, synthesis, problem framing, specification, exploration, prototyping and validation as part of an AI\-native design approach.
* Contribute to evolving specification\-driven development (SDD) practices and critically evaluate AI\-generated output for accuracy, evidence, bias, usability and human value.
* Help plan and conduct user research with healthcare professionals, practice staff, clients, clinical experts and domain experts.
* Ask thoughtful questions, build rapport, listen closely and identify meaningful patterns from qualitative research and customer feedback.
* Combine qualitative insights with product and behavioral data to understand both what users do and why they do it.
* Translate research and evidence into clear problem definitions, workflows, experience principles and product concepts that help the team determine what to build and why.
* Design understandable enterprise experiences, including user flows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and detailed interface designs.
* Design for document interoperability, referrals and cross\-organization healthcare workflows, accounting for different users, dense information, edge cases and system constraints.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Design, clients and domain experts to evaluate trade\-offs and build shared understanding.
* Drive clearly scoped work forward, communicate progress and risks, seek feedback and take on increasing complexity as your capabilities grow.


**Additional Job Responsibilities**
* Develop a strong understanding of complex healthcare systems and workflows, even without prior U.S. healthcare expertise.
* Apply human\-centered judgment to determine where AI should and should not influence an experience.
* Experiment with AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration and other creative practices, adapting approaches based on learnings.
* Reason about complex systems, data, relationships, constraints and downstream consequences.
* Use evidence to separate assumptions from validated insights and respond constructively when new information challenges your initial thinking.
* Communicate clearly with users and colleagues across different disciplines, cultures and levels of technical knowledge.
* Show initiative, follow through on commitments, seek feedback and maintain a high standard for the quality and consequences of design decisions.
* Work directly with U.S.\-based healthcare professionals and clinical experts as part of research activities.
* Maintain planned evening availability in India when required for scheduled research sessions with U.S.\-based users.
* Continue developing UX capabilities and take on increasing levels of responsibility and complexity as your capabilities grow.


**Expected Education \& Experience**
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in UX design, product design, UX research, service design, data, engineering, healthcare, psychology, customer experience or another related discipline.
* Experience researching or designing complex, data\-rich products and workflows involving multiple users, constraints and dependencies.
* Experience in healthcare, health technology, fintech, insurance, enterprise software, logistics, security, data products or another systemic or regulated environment is valuable.
* Ability to use qualitative research, customer feedback and/or behavioral product data to inform product, service or design decisions.
* Curiosity about analytics tools such as Amplitude is valuable, even if you are not currently a quantitative researcher.
* Ability to communicate ideas through workflows, information architecture, wireframes, prototypes and/or detailed interface designs.
* Demonstrated experimentation with AI in research, design, prototyping, technical exploration or another creative practice, with an ability to adapt based on what you learn.
* Healthcare or health technology experience is a plus, particularly familiarity with clinical workflows, document exchange, interoperability, referrals or care coordination.
* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Psychology, Computer Science, Business or a related discipline is welcomed; equivalent skills developed through practical experience are also valued.
* We care more about the quality of your thinking, research instincts, curiosity and ability to grow than a specific job title or list of tools.

title: UI/UX Design Engineer
description:
**UI/UX Design Engineer** 




 Location: India (Remote)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Company: GoStride Ventures
 



  





**Company Description** 




 Welcome to GoStride Ventures. We are your partners in innovation and entrepreneurship. Our mission is to unlock opportunities, fuel ventures, and empower success. We focus on growth, innovation, and strategic partnerships to build scalable, tech\-driven solutions. Join us as we shape the future together.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We are looking for a UI/UX Design Engineer who can design and build the user\-facing side of a data\-rich ERP platform end to end. This is a full\-time, remote role for someone who designs in Figma, builds the front end themselves in React, and ships to production. Our product is dashboard\-heavy and module\-based, serving trading and SME businesses, so we need someone who understands how complex business software should look, flow, and feel.
 



 Our design bar is high. We are not looking for static screens. We expect Framer\-level, motion\-rich interfaces: animated transitions, micro\-interactions, and dynamic elements that respond to the user. If your work is polished but static, this is not the right fit.
 



 You will design and build dashboards, dense data tables, reporting templates, and multi\-step forms across ERP modules such as inventory, sales, purchase, accounting, and CRM. You will translate real business workflows into interfaces that are clean, fast, animated, and genuinely usable by non\-technical staff. We care more about design sensibility, motion craft, ERP understanding, and front\-end instinct than about years of experience.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design and build motion\-rich, dynamic interfaces: animated transitions, micro\-interactions, and state changes that respond to user actions, not static screens.
* Design and build dashboards, dense data tables, reporting templates, and multi\-step forms across modules such as inventory, sales, purchase, accounting, and CRM.
* Implement animation in production using tools and libraries such as Framer, Framer Motion, or GSAP, keeping motion smooth and performant.
* Translate business workflows and user requirements into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and finished production UI.
* Build and maintain responsive, accessible interfaces using React, TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6\+), Tailwind CSS, and semantic HTML.
* Design clear reporting layouts and data visualisations using libraries such as Recharts, ECharts, or D3\.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools and IDEs, such as Claude in VS Code, Cursor, or Google Antigravity, to accelerate build and review cycles while maintaining code quality.
* Deploy and maintain front\-end applications on modern hosting platforms, owning the path from local build to live site.
* Contribute to and maintain a shared design system: design tokens, component library, and documentation.
* Integrate front\-end interfaces with REST and GraphQL APIs provided by the backend team.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Demonstrated UI/UX experience, with a portfolio showing strong design sensibility and attention to usability.
* Demonstrable experience producing Framer\-level, animated, dynamic interfaces, with portfolio examples of motion and micro\-interactions you designed and shipped.
* Hands\-on experience designing for ERP, B2B SaaS, or complex admin or dashboard products.
* Experience designing dashboards, dense data tables, and reporting templates.
* Proficiency with Figma, including auto\-layout, variants, component properties, and variables.
* Working experience with React and TypeScript, or strong JavaScript with a clear ability to grow into React.
* Solid experience with JavaScript (ES6\+), HTML, CSS, and Tailwind CSS.
* Comfortable working in modern IDEs and AI\-assisted development environments (for example VS Code, Cursor, or Google Antigravity), and with AI app builders such as Lovable.
* Practical experience deploying to production on platforms such as Vercel, Netlify, or Cloudflare.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs and how front\-end interfaces consume them.



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Motion design: animated transitions, micro\-interactions, and dynamic, responsive interfaces.
* UI and UX design for complex, data\-heavy business software.
* ERP module interfaces: inventory, sales, purchase, accounting, CRM.
* Dashboard design, reporting templates, and data visualisation.
* Dense data tables, forms, and form validation.
* React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
* Design systems, design tokens, and component libraries.
* Accessibility (WCAG AA, ARIA, keyboard navigation).



  





**Strong Signals** 



* A portfolio that links to live, deployed work you designed and built yourself
* Live work that shows real motion design: animated transitions, micro\-interactions, and dynamic elements (Framer, Framer Motion, or GSAP).
* Direct experience on ERP modules (inventory, sales, purchase, accounting, or CRM).
* Fluency across the modern AI build\-and\-ship stack: AI\-assisted IDEs (VS Code, Cursor, Antigravity), AI app builders (Lovable), and deployment platforms (Vercel).
* Performance awareness: Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, virtualisation for large tables.
* Git and code review.



  





**Compensation** 




 INR 3\.0 to 4\.2 LPA, with room to grow as you take on more
 



  





**How to Apply** 




**Send your CV and portfolio (design portfolio, GitHub, or live project links) to:** 
 hr@gostride.ventures. Subject Line: Design Engineer Application – Your Name
 



 We look forward to welcoming a talented designer who shares our passion for building impactful, well\-designed solutions. If you are ready to take the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply.
