description:
* Location: Gurgaon
* Experience Range: 0–2 Years
* Employment Type: Full\-Time
* Reports to: Tech Lead


 Role Summary
   

  

 "Advanced supply chain capability live in weeks, at a fraction of enterprise cost to serve".
   

  

 We are building the Supply Chain Operating System for India's manufacturers and distributors that run their operations on homegrown ERPs but lack real\-time visibility into inventory health, order flow, or logistics performance. Our system sits on top of existing ERPs and WMSs, creates a unified operational data model, and turns inventory data into better decisions through an intelligent pooling of AI agents and deterministic models. The result is a single, always\-on system that gives supply chain teams enterprise\-grade intelligence, without an enterprise\-grade IT lift.
   

  

 As an AI Engineer, you will build the intelligence and conversational layer of the product: trusted answers, alerts, recommendations and workflows grounded in each customer's operational data. You will combine deterministic logic, statistical models and LLMs deliberately to solve customer's problems.
   

  

 What You Will Do
   

  

* Own the evolution of the product's agentic architecture.
* Build the intelligence that turns customer operational data into trusted answers, alerts, recommendations and workflows.
* Work closely with the Supply Chain Data Scientist to make advanced supply chain intelligence accessible through reliable, explainable AI services.
* Build conversational experiences across web and WhatsApp.
* Establish strong practices for AI evaluation, observability and continuous improvement.
* Work across the product and engineering team to determine where deterministic logic, statistical models and generative AI provide the best solution to a problem.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience in applied AI/ML engineering, graph/data systems or backend engineering for AI products.
* Strong Python and experience building APIs, data pipelines and production services.
* Hands\-on experience with LLM applications: RAG/retrieval, embeddings, function/tool calling, structured outputs, agent workflows and evaluation.
* Strong software\-engineering habits: modular code, testing, version control, observability and documentation.
* Comfortable working with ambiguous problems and turning them into reliable, testable AI systems.
* Experience with graph databases, LangGraph or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks, conversational systems, AI observability or supply\-chain/enterprise workflows is a plus.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 We have spent 30 years managing supply chains across cold chain, beverages, packaged food \& manufacturing for Fortune 500 clients such as ITC, Nestle, Coca Cola, Dupont and many others, as well as hundreds of SMEs in India. Our expertise lies in solving supply chain problems and applying best practices using technology and operations.
   

  

 With decades of operational experience, our industry first model will give you the opportunity to:
   

  

* Build AI that operates on real business data and produces decisions users can trust.
* Shape the agentic and conversational experience of an operational intelligence product from its first production release.
* Work alongside supply\-chain experts and data scientists on problems with direct customer and cash\-flow impact

title: System Validation Engineer (New Grads)
description:
**About SiFive**
*As the pioneers who introduced RISC\-V to the world, SiFive is transforming the future of compute by bringing the limitless potential of RISC\-V to the highest performance and most data\-intensive applications in the world. SiFive’s unrivaled compute platforms are continuing to enable leading technology companies around the world to innovate, optimize and deliver the most advanced solutions of tomorrow across every market segment of chip design, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, automotive, data center, mobile, and consumer. With SiFive, the future of RISC\-V has no limits.*
 At SiFive, we are always excited to connect with talented individuals, who are just as passionate about driving innovation and changing the world as we are.
   

  

 Our constant innovation and ongoing success is down to our amazing teams of incredibly talented people, who collaborate and support each other to come up with truly groundbreaking ideas and solutions. Solutions that will have a huge impact on people's lives; making the world a better place, one processor at a time.
   

  

 Are you ready?
   

  

 To learn more about SiFive’s phenomenal success and to see why we have won the GSA’s prestigious Most Respected Private Company Award (for the fourth time!), check out our website and Glassdoor pages.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**The Role:**
 The successful candidate will join SiFive's System Validation team, which is responsible for the validation of SiFive's RISC\-V CPUs utilizing FPGA\-based platforms. This role extends beyond FPGA platforms to include development and bring\-up boards.
   

  

 This position offers significant exposure to RISC\-V processors, the RISC\-V software ecosystem, and various development boards, providing exceptional learning opportunities for engineers pursuing a career in the RISC\-V domain.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Execute root cause and failure analysis across RISC\-V CPU hardware and software components.
* Utilize ILA and JTAG debuggers to troubleshoot and validate FPGA designs.
* Develop failure hypotheses through systematic, step\-by\-step elimination of potential causes.
* Create and support Python\-based scripts to enhance and automate debug workflows.


**Requirements**
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Electronics and Communication Engineering is required.
* A strong comprehension of Computer Architecture and logic design is essential.
* Prior exposure to logic design using Verilog and the subsequent porting of designs onto FPGA platforms is necessary.
* Practical experience with Linux\-based operating systems and scripting languages such as Python and BASH is mandatory.
* Candidates must possess a positive attitude, a proactive approach to continuous learning, and a commitment to achieving excellence in their work.


**Additional Information:**
 This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in:
   

  

 Taiwan
   

  

 Any offer of employment for this position is also contingent on the Company verifying that you are a authorized for access to export\-controlled technology under applicable export control laws or, if you are not already authorized, our ability to successfully obtain any necessary export license(s) or other approvals.
   

  

 SiFive is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
